platform: Direct (University of Melbourne online application) or VTAC
deadline_note: Main intake is Semester 1 (late February 2027). Melbourne's official dates page blocks automated checks; third-party guides cite 31 October 2026 for most Semester 1 2027 undergraduate courses, with later dates for some. Confirm on study.unimelb.edu.au.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by course (roughly A$45,000–60,000 a year for most bachelor's degrees); check the course's international fee on study.unimelb.edu.au.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships only: the Melbourne International Excellence Scholarship (Undergraduate) gives a fee remission to eligible international students starting a bachelor's from 2027 and needs no separate application; a few higher-value Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarships also exist.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement as such: you are assessed on your secondary qualification (IB, A-levels, a US diploma with SAT/ACT/AP, etc.) against each course's entry score. English: the University's undergraduate English standard, with IELTS Academic the usual test; some courses set higher bands. Official score tables could not be verified automatically.

summary.en: Australia's oldest university in Victoria and one of the country's highest-ranked, placed 22nd in the world by QS 2026. Undergraduates take broad bachelor's degrees in arts, commerce, science, biomedicine, design or music, then often move into professional graduate study under the 'Melbourne Model'.
summary.ka: ვიქტორიის შტატის უძველესი და ავსტრალიის ერთ-ერთი წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 22-ე. სტუდენტები ფართო ბაკალავრიატს გადიან ხელოვნებაში, კომერციაში, მეცნიერებაში, ბიომედიცინაში, დიზაინსა თუ მუსიკაში, შემდეგ კი ხშირად პროფესიულ მაგისტრატურაში გადადიან „მელბურნის მოდელით“.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة في ولاية فيكتوريا ومن أعلى الجامعات الأسترالية تصنيفاً، إذ تحتل المرتبة 22 عالمياً في QS 2026. يدرس الطلاب بكالوريوس واسع النطاق في الآداب أو التجارة أو العلوم أو الطب الحيوي أو التصميم أو الموسيقى، ثم ينتقل كثيرون إلى دراسات عليا مهنية وفق «نموذج ملبورن».

about.en:
Founded in 1853, the University of Melbourne sits on a city-edge campus in Parkville and is a member of Australia's Group of Eight research universities. Its undergraduate offer is deliberately broad: a small set of generalist bachelor's degrees (Arts, Commerce, Science, Biomedicine, Design, Music, Fine Arts and others) with majors chosen as you go, after which many students enter professional graduate degrees such as the Juris Doctor, Doctor of Medicine or engineering master's.

International students apply directly online or via an agent, with admission based on the entry score for their secondary qualification plus English proficiency. Fees are high and set per course, but the University automatically considers international applicants for fee-remission scholarships, and a few larger merit awards are available.

label.en: English test meeting the University's undergraduate standard
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Entry is by course-specific scores for your qualification (e.g. high IB totals or strong A-level grades); competitive courses like Biomedicine and Commerce need top results.

platform: Direct (ANU application portal); UAC International for students finishing Australian Year 12, IB in Australia or NCEA
deadline_note: Direct applications for Semester 1, 2027 close 15 December 2026 (some college programs close earlier, 31 October 2026); Semester 2, 2027 closes 15 May 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Annual indicative international fee for the Bachelor of Science; other programs differ. Application fee A$150 for direct applications.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships: the ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship (partial tuition reduction, applicants assessed for the highest award they qualify for) and other faculty awards. No need-based aid for internationals.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; you need an accepted secondary qualification meeting the indicative entry score for your program. English (ANU policy): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, TOEFL iBT 80 (TOEFL iBT Australia only for tests from 21 Jan 2026), PTE Academic 64, Cambridge C1/C2 176. At-home/online test versions are not accepted. Some programs set higher requirements.

summary.en: Australia's national research university in Canberra, ranked 29th in the world by QS 2026 and especially strong in politics, international relations, Asia-Pacific studies and the natural sciences. International students apply directly, with Semester 1 2027 applications closing on 15 December 2026.
summary.ka: ავსტრალიის ეროვნული კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი კანბერაში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 29-ე, განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი პოლიტიკაში, საერთაშორისო ურთიერთობებში, აზია-წყნარი ოკეანის კვლევებსა და საბუნებისმეტყველო მეცნიერებებში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები პირდაპირ აპლიკაციას აკეთებენ; 2027 წლის პირველ სემესტრზე მიღება 2026 წლის 15 დეკემბერს იხურება.
summary.ar: الجامعة البحثية الوطنية لأستراليا في كانبرا، تحتل المرتبة 29 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز في السياسة والعلاقات الدولية ودراسات آسيا والمحيط الهادئ والعلوم الطبيعية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة، ويُغلق التقديم للفصل الأول من 2027 في 15 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
ANU was founded by the Australian Parliament in 1946 as the country's national university and remains one of its most research-intensive institutions, with a compact campus in central Canberra. It is known for the Crawford School of Public Policy, the Coral Bell School of Asia Pacific Affairs, the Research School of Astronomy and Astrophysics and strong programs in computing, economics and law; flexible double degrees are common.

International applicants apply directly through the ANU portal (A$150 fee) and are assessed against indicative entry scores for their secondary qualification, plus ANU's English standard (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 80). Everyone is automatically considered for the Chancellor's International Scholarship, and residential colleges house most first-year students.

label.en: Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Assessed against ANU's indicative entry score for your qualification (high IB/A-level results for competitive programs); some programs add selection criteria.

en: Bachelor of Politics, Philosophy and Economics

platform: Direct (Monash online application) or authorised Monash education agent
deadline_note: International undergraduate applications are assessed on a rolling basis; Semester 1 starts late February 2027. Apply several months ahead to allow time for a visa.

tuition_intl.note: 2027 international annual fee for the Bachelor of Science (S2000); fees vary by course.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships (e.g. Monash International Merit Scholarship, Monash International Leadership Scholarship) and International Study Grants of up to A$10,000; no need-based aid for internationals.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement as such; entry is by your secondary qualification against course minimums. English Level A (most courses): IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in every band, or an equivalent approved test. Medicine (direct entry) also requires the UCAT ANZ (or ISAT for international applicants) and an interview.

summary.en: Australia's largest university, based in Melbourne and ranked 31st in the world by QS 2026, with world-leading pharmacy and strong medicine, engineering and business. Most courses need IELTS 6.5 (6.0 per band) and applications are taken on a rolling basis.
summary.ka: ავსტრალიის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი მელბურნში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 31-ე, მსოფლიო დონის ფარმაციით და ძლიერი მედიცინით, ინჟინერიითა და ბიზნესით. კურსების უმეტესობას სჭირდება IELTS 6.5 (თითო კომპონენტში 6.0), განაცხადები კი მიიღება უწყვეტად.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في أستراليا، مقرها ملبورن وتحتل المرتبة 31 عالمياً في QS 2026، وتتميز عالمياً في الصيدلة ولديها برامج قوية في الطب والهندسة والأعمال. تتطلب معظم البرامج IELTS 6.5 (6.0 في كل مهارة)، ويُقبل التقديم بشكل متواصل.

about.en:
Monash is a Group of Eight research university with its main campus at Clayton in south-east Melbourne, further Victorian campuses, and international campuses in Malaysia and Indonesia. It is internationally known for pharmacy and pharmaceutical sciences, and offers large programs in medicine, engineering, IT, business, law and education, many as double degrees.

International students apply directly or through an authorised agent and are assessed on their secondary qualification plus English Level A (IELTS 6.5, no band under 6.0) for most courses. Direct-entry medicine additionally requires the UCAT ANZ or ISAT and an interview. Merit scholarships and study grants partly offset high fees.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.5, min 6.0 per band, or equivalent)
Interview and UCAT ANZ/ISAT for medicine only
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Course-specific minimum scores for your qualification; Medicine, Pharmacy and Law are the most competitive.

scholarships.name: Monash International Merit and Leadership Scholarships

platform: Direct (SNU Office of Admissions online application, Global Talent Special Admission)
deadline_note: International (Global Talent) undergraduate admission runs twice a year. Spring 2027 applications closed 9 July 2026. The Fall 2027 guide is not yet published; the Fall 2026 online window was 3–5 March 2026, so expect early March 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Spring 2027 first-semester fees: KRW 2,442,000 (humanities, social sciences, business) to KRW 2,998,000 (engineering) and KRW 3,653,000 (fine arts). Application fee KRW 70,000.

aid_intl.en: Merit and need-based tuition scholarships for international students (e.g. SNU Global Scholarship, Korean Government Scholarship Program/GKS); availability varies by semester.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement; standardized results (SAT, ACT, AP, IB, A-level, IGCSE) may be submitted as supporting evidence. Language: Korean (TOPIK level 3+) or English (TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS Academic 6.0 or TEPS 269); TOEFL Home Edition and IELTS Online accepted. Most courses are taught in Korean. Art, music and PE applicants have practical exams/interviews.

summary.en: South Korea's flagship national university, ranked 38th in the world by QS 2026 and the most selective in the country. Foreign students enter through the twice-yearly Global Talent admission and need TOPIK 3 or an English test such as TOEFL 80 or IELTS 6.0.
summary.ka: სამხრეთ კორეის წამყვანი ეროვნული უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 38-ე და ქვეყანაში ყველაზე შერჩევითი. უცხოელები წელიწადში ორჯერ მიიღებიან Global Talent-ის სპეციალური მიღებით და სჭირდებათ TOPIK 3 ან ინგლისურის ტესტი (მაგ. TOEFL 80 ან IELTS 6.0).
summary.ar: الجامعة الوطنية الرائدة في كوريا الجنوبية، تحتل المرتبة 38 عالمياً في QS 2026 وهي الأكثر انتقائية في البلاد. يُقبل الطلاب الأجانب عبر برنامج «المواهب العالمية» مرتين سنوياً ويحتاجون إلى TOPIK 3 أو اختبار إنجليزية مثل TOEFL 80 أو IELTS 6.0.

about.en:
Seoul National University is Korea's top public research university, with its main Gwanak campus in southern Seoul and 16 undergraduate colleges spanning humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, engineering, business, medicine, agriculture, music and fine arts. Teaching is mainly in Korean, though English-taught courses are growing, and graduates dominate Korean academia, government and industry.

Foreign nationals (with non-Korean parents) apply through the Global Talent Special Admission for Spring (March) or Fall (September) entry. You submit a personal statement and study plan, school records, recommendation letters and proof of Korean or English proficiency; some majors interview. Tuition is low by international standards, and scholarships are available.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
TOPIK 3+, or TOEFL iBT 80 / IELTS 6.0 / TEPS 269
Portfolio/practical exam for art, music and PE only
Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Interview if required by the department

gpa_note.en: Holistic document review of school performance, study plan and recommendations; admitted students are typically top of their class.

platform: Direct (Underwood International College online application for international students)
deadline_note: Underwood International College (English-taught): the Spring 2027 round closed 22 Sept 2026 (interviews 11–12 Dec 2026). The Fall 2027 round is scheduled for March 2027; exact dates not yet published.

tuition_intl.note: Underwood International College first-semester tuition for international students (plus KRW 61,000 miscellaneous fees).

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships: all international UIC applicants are automatically considered for admissions scholarships up to full tuition for four years; further merit scholarships each semester.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement. UIC requires proof of English proficiency (TOEFL, IELTS, CEFR certificate, IB English A, AP English or English-medium schooling) with no minimum score. Selection is by document review plus an interview. Korean-taught Yonsei programmes require TOPIK instead.

summary.en: One of Korea's elite 'SKY' private universities, ranked 42nd in the world by QS 2026. International students usually enter its English-taught Underwood International College, which considers every applicant for scholarships up to full tuition.
summary.ka: კორეის ერთ-ერთი ელიტური კერძო „SKY“ უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 42-ე. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები ძირითადად ინგლისურენოვან Underwood International College-ში ირიცხებიან, რომელიც ყველა აპლიკანტს განიხილავს სრულ სასწავლო გრანტამდე.
summary.ar: إحدى جامعات «SKY» الخاصة النخبوية في كوريا، تحتل المرتبة 42 عالمياً في QS 2026. يلتحق الطلاب الدوليون عادة بكلية أندروود الدولية التي تُدرّس بالإنجليزية وتنظر في منح جميع المتقدمين منحاً تصل إلى كامل الرسوم.

about.en:
Founded in 1885 by missionaries, Yonsei is one of Korea's oldest and most prestigious private universities, with its main Sinchon campus in Seoul and an International Campus in Songdo. It is strong in medicine (Severance Hospital), business, economics and engineering, and its Underwood International College (UIC) offers four-year English-taught liberal-arts degrees in fields such as economics, international studies, political science, life science and technology, and creative technology management.

International applicants to UIC apply online in a spring or fall round, submit school records, essays and recommendations, prove English proficiency, and are interviewed. Every international applicant is considered for admissions scholarships that can cover full tuition for four years.

label.en: Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/IB/AP or English-medium certificate; no minimum)
Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents

gpa_note.en: Holistic document review (200 points) plus interview; strong academic records and English writing are expected.

scholarships.name: UIC Admissions Scholarship (up to full tuition, 4 years)

platform: Direct (ZJU Online Application System for International Students)
deadline_note: The 2027 guide is not yet published. For 2026 entry the window ran 1 Dec 2025 – 28 Feb 2026 (some majors until 31 May 2026), so expect a similar December 2026 – February 2027 window. A valid CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the undergraduate programme catalogue; application fee RMB 800 (non-refundable).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship and Zhejiang Government Scholarship (Chinese-taught programmes only); programme-specific scholarships for some English-taught programmes (ZJU-UoE Institute, Global Communication and Management, MBBS).

tests.en: SAT/ACT/IB/A-level or national exam results are submitted if applicable (not mandatory). From 2026/27 all international undergraduate applicants must submit a valid CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report. Chinese-taught programmes need an HSK certificate; English-taught programmes need TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent (no published minimum). Shortlisted applicants have a video interview.

summary.en: One of China's top C9 research universities, based in Hangzhou and ranked 47th in the world by QS 2026, with very strong engineering, computer science and agriculture. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in Chinese, with a smaller set of English-taught options.
summary.ka: ჩინეთის ერთ-ერთი წამყვანი C9 კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ხანჯოუში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 47-ე, ძალიან ძლიერი ინჟინერიით, კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებითა და აგრარული დარგებით. საბაკალავრო პროგრამების უმეტესობა ჩინურად ისწავლება, ინგლისურენოვანი არჩევანი კი უფრო მცირეა.
summary.ar: إحدى جامعات C9 البحثية الرائدة في الصين، مقرها هانغتشو وتحتل المرتبة 47 عالمياً في QS 2026، وتتميز بقوة في الهندسة وعلوم الحاسوب والزراعة. تُدرَّس معظم برامج البكالوريوس بالصينية مع عدد أقل من البرامج بالإنجليزية.

about.en:
Zhejiang University is a comprehensive research university with several campuses in Hangzhou (Zijingang is the largest) plus the ZJU International Campus in Haining, home to joint institutes with the University of Edinburgh and the University of Illinois. It is particularly known for engineering, computer science and AI, agriculture and medicine, and for close links with Hangzhou's tech industry.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, a study plan, language certificates and, from 2026/27, a CSCA report; shortlisted candidates are interviewed by video and must prepay first-year tuition to confirm a place. Chinese-taught programmes require HSK, while English-taught ones require TOEFL/IELTS.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
TOEFL/IELTS for English-taught programmes; HSK for Chinese-taught

gpa_note.en: Competitive selection on senior-high academic performance, language proficiency, CSCA results and interview.

platform: Direct (CityUHK online application for non-JUPAS/international applicants)
deadline_note: International (non-JUPAS) applications for September 2027 entry are made online through CityUHK; the official deadline could not be verified automatically (the admissions site blocks automated access). Check cityu.edu.hk/admo.

tuition_intl.note: Non-local undergraduate tuition applies (set annually).

aid_intl.en: Entrance scholarships for outstanding non-local students (partial to full tuition), awarded on merit.

tests.en: SAT/ACT may be used by applicants with US-curriculum qualifications; most international applicants are assessed on IB, A-level or national exam results. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) is required for non-native speakers. Minimum scores could not be verified.

summary.en: A fast-rising public university in Kowloon, ranked 52nd in the world by QS 2026, with strengths in engineering, computing, business and creative media. All teaching is in English, and it admits international students directly.
summary.ka: სწრაფად მზარდი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი კოულუნში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 52-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტინგში, ბიზნესსა და შემოქმედებით მედიაში. სწავლება მთლიანად ინგლისურადაა და საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს პირდაპირ იღებს.
summary.ar: جامعة حكومية سريعة الصعود في كولون، تحتل المرتبة 52 عالمياً في QS 2026، وتتميز في الهندسة والحوسبة والأعمال والإعلام الإبداعي. التدريس كله بالإنجليزية، وتقبل الطلاب الدوليين مباشرة.

about.en:
City University of Hong Kong is a research university on a compact campus in Kowloon Tong. It has colleges of engineering, business, liberal arts and social sciences, science, computing, creative media and Hong Kong's only veterinary school, and is known for applied research and close ties with industry in the Greater Bay Area.

International applicants apply online as non-JUPAS candidates with their school-leaving results and English proficiency evidence. Teaching is entirely in English, and merit-based entrance scholarships are offered to strong non-local applicants.

label.en: Secondary school results (IB, A-level, SAT/AP or national exams)
English test (IELTS/TOEFL) if not a native speaker

gpa_note.en: Competitive results in IB/A-level or equivalent are expected.

platform: Direct (Korea University international admissions online application)
deadline_note: International freshman admission runs twice a year (Spring and Fall rounds); exact dates for 2027 could not be verified automatically. Check the Korea University admissions site.

tuition_intl.note: Tuition varies by college (charged per semester).

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships for international students (admission scholarships covering part or all of tuition) and GKS government scholarships.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may be submitted as supporting evidence). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4 or higher); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.

summary.en: One of Korea's elite 'SKY' universities, a private institution in Seoul ranked 52nd in the world by QS 2026 and known for business, law and international studies. International students apply in spring and fall rounds with TOPIK or English scores.
summary.ka: კორეის ერთ-ერთი ელიტური „SKY“ უნივერსიტეტი, კერძო დაწესებულება სეულში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 52-ე, ცნობილი ბიზნესით, სამართლითა და საერთაშორისო კვლევებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები გაზაფხულისა და შემოდგომის რაუნდებში TOPIK-ით ან ინგლისურის ქულებით აკეთებენ განაცხადს.
summary.ar: إحدى جامعات «SKY» النخبوية في كوريا، مؤسسة خاصة في سيول تحتل المرتبة 52 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتشتهر بالأعمال والقانون والدراسات الدولية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون في جولتي الربيع والخريف بدرجات TOPIK أو الإنجليزية.

about.en:
Founded in 1905, Korea University is one of Korea's most prestigious private universities, with its Anam campus in north-east Seoul and a second campus in Sejong. It is particularly strong in business (Korea University Business School), law, political science and international studies (Division of International Studies), engineering, and medicine.

Foreign students apply through the international admission track for March or September entry, submitting school records, a study plan and Korean or English proficiency. Many programmes are Korean-taught, while the Division of International Studies and some business tracks teach in English.

label.en: Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Bank statement for the D-2 visa

gpa_note.en: Holistic document review of school records and study plan; interviews for some programmes.

platform: Direct (UM MAYA online application, 'Undergraduate – for International' channel)
deadline_note: International undergraduate applications for the Semester II (March) intake of 2026/2027 run 7 Sept 2026 – 30 Jan 2027. The main October intake (2026/2027) closed 30 Aug 2026 (MBBS 9 June 2026); the 2027/2028 window is expected to open around February 2027.

tuition_intl.note: International fees are set per programme (see UM's undergraduate brochure and programme pages).

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for international undergraduates; most international students are self-funded or sponsored by their governments.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is by your pre-university qualification (A-levels, IB, foundation, etc.). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent; minimum varies by programme). Official minimum scores could not be confirmed.

summary.en: Malaysia's oldest and highest-ranked university, in Kuala Lumpur and placed 56th in the world by QS 2026. It admits international undergraduates twice a year, with the March 2027 intake open until 30 January 2027.
summary.ka: მალაიზიის უძველესი და ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი კუალა-ლუმპურში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 56-ე. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს წელიწადში ორჯერ იღებს; 2027 წლის მარტის ნაკადზე განაცხადი 2027 წლის 30 იანვრამდეა ღია.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة في ماليزيا وأعلاها تصنيفاً، في كوالالمبور وتحتل المرتبة 56 عالمياً في QS 2026. تقبل طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين مرتين سنوياً، ويظل التقديم لدفعة مارس 2027 مفتوحاً حتى 30 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Founded in 1905 as a medical college in Singapore, Universiti Malaya is Malaysia's premier research university, with a large green campus in Kuala Lumpur. It offers bachelor's degrees across engineering, medicine and dentistry, business and accountancy, computer science, law, science, arts and education, with many programmes taught in English.

International students apply directly through UM's online portal for either the October (main) or March intake, submitting pre-university results, English test scores and passport details. Fees are modest by global standards and Kuala Lumpur's cost of living is low, though scholarships for international undergraduates are limited.

gpa_note.en: Strong pre-university results are expected; medicine, dentistry, law and pharmacy are most competitive.

platform: Direct (University of Auckland online application)
deadline_note: Semester One 2027 undergraduate closing date is 8 December 2026 for most programmes; international applicants must apply by 1 December to be considered for special admission. Later applications are considered only if places remain.

tuition_intl.note: 2027 estimated international fees for a full-time year: Bachelor of Arts NZ$42,236.40, Commerce NZ$51,020.40, Engineering (Hons) NZ$60,909.60.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships such as the University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship (partial tuition); no need-based aid for internationals.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry is by your secondary qualification (IB, A-levels, NCEA, US diploma with SAT/ACT/AP, etc.). English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no band below 5.5 is the general undergraduate minimum (One Skill Retake accepted); each programme page lists its own IELTS level. TOEFL iBT, PTE and others accepted at equivalent levels.

summary.en: New Zealand's largest and highest-ranked university, ranked 67th in the world by QS 2026, on a city-centre campus in Auckland. International students apply directly, with Semester One 2027 applications closing on 8 December 2026.
summary.ka: ახალი ზელანდიის უდიდესი და ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 67-ე, ოკლენდის ცენტრში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები პირდაპირ აკეთებენ განაცხადს; 2027 წლის პირველ სემესტრზე მიღება 2026 წლის 8 დეკემბერს იხურება.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في نيوزيلندا وأعلاها تصنيفاً، تحتل المرتبة 67 عالمياً في QS 2026، في حرم بوسط مدينة أوكلاند. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة، ويُغلق التقديم للفصل الأول من 2027 في 8 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Founded in 1883, the University of Auckland is New Zealand's leading research university, with its main campus in central Auckland and faculties of arts, business, creative arts and industries, education, engineering, law, medical and health sciences, and science. Its engineering, business and health programmes are especially well regarded, and conjoint degrees let students combine two fields.

International applicants apply online and are assessed on their secondary results and English (IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 at minimum). Most programmes close on 8 December for February entry. Fees range from about NZ$42,000 to NZ$61,000 a year, with partial merit scholarships available.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.0, no band below 5.5, or programme-specific level)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

gpa_note.en: Programme-specific rank scores for your qualification; Engineering, Health Sciences and Law (Part II) are most competitive.

scholarships.name: University of Auckland International Student Excellence Scholarship

platform: Direct (UWA online application) or authorised agent
deadline_note: UWA does not publish a single international undergraduate deadline; apply well before Semester 1 (late February 2027) to allow for offer and visa processing.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by course; use UWA's fee calculator. Application fee A$150 for direct and agent applications.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships including the Global Excellence Scholarship (fee reduction for high-achieving international students) and the UWA International Student Award.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry is by your secondary qualification against UWA entry standards. English (minimum standard): IELTS Academic 6.5 with no band below 6.0; Duolingo 125 (Speaking 115, Writing 125, Reading 115, Listening 110); Cambridge C1/C2 170 overall. Some courses require a higher standard.

summary.en: Western Australia's leading research university in Perth, ranked 77th in the world by QS 2026 and strong in marine science, earth sciences and mining-related engineering. Most courses require IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0.
summary.ka: დასავლეთ ავსტრალიის წამყვანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი პერთში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 77-ე, ძლიერი საზღვაო და დედამიწის მეცნიერებებში და სამთო ინჟინერიაში. კურსების უმეტესობას სჭირდება IELTS 6.5, არცერთი კომპონენტი 6.0-ზე ნაკლები.
summary.ar: الجامعة البحثية الرائدة في غرب أستراليا بمدينة بيرث، تحتل المرتبة 77 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز في علوم البحار وعلوم الأرض وهندسة التعدين. تتطلب معظم البرامج IELTS 6.5 دون أي مهارة أقل من 6.0.

about.en:
Founded in 1911, UWA is a Group of Eight university on a riverside campus in Perth. Its bachelor's degrees (Arts, Science, Commerce, Philosophy (Honours), Advanced Computer Science, Biomedical Science and others) feed into professional master's programmes, and it is internationally known for earth and marine sciences, agriculture, and mining and petroleum engineering.

International students apply directly (A$150 fee) or through an agent and are assessed against UWA's entry standards for their qualification plus English competence (IELTS 6.5, no band below 6.0, or Duolingo 125). High achievers are considered for the Global Excellence Scholarship.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.5, no band below 6.0 / Duolingo 125)
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Assessed against UWA entry standards for your qualification (e.g. IB or A-level equivalents of the required ATAR).

platform: Direct (Adelaide University online application), via an education agent (required for some regions), or SATAC
deadline_note: Closing dates are set per degree; check the degree page. Semester 1 starts late February 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by degree; listed on each degree page.

aid_intl.en: Merit-based international scholarships (partial tuition reductions); no need-based aid for internationals.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry is by secondary qualification. English requirements are degree-specific, from IELTS Academic 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 60 / PTE 60 at the lowest level, rising to IELTS 6.5 (TOEFL 79, PTE 64) or 7.0 (TOEFL 94, PTE 72) for many degrees. Only tests taken at official centres are accepted. Medicine and dentistry require the UCAT ANZ (or ISAT for international applicants).

summary.en: Adelaide University is the new institution formed in 2026 from the merger of the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia, ranked 79th in the world by QS. It offers a wide range of degrees in South Australia's capital, with English requirements from IELTS 6.0 depending on the degree.
summary.ka: ადელაიდის უნივერსიტეტი 2026 წელს ადელაიდის უნივერსიტეტისა და სამხრეთ ავსტრალიის უნივერსიტეტის შერწყმით შეიქმნა და QS-ში მსოფლიოში 79-ეა. სამხრეთ ავსტრალიის დედაქალაქში ფართო არჩევანს გთავაზობთ; ინგლისურის მოთხოვნა IELTS 6.0-დან იწყება, პროგრამის მიხედვით.
summary.ar: جامعة أديلايد هي المؤسسة الجديدة التي تأسست عام 2026 من اندماج جامعة أديلايد وجامعة جنوب أستراليا، وتحتل المرتبة 79 عالمياً في QS. تقدم مجموعة واسعة من البرامج في عاصمة جنوب أستراليا، بمتطلبات إنجليزية تبدأ من IELTS 6.0 حسب البرنامج.

about.en:
Adelaide University began teaching in 2026, combining the research strength of the Group of Eight University of Adelaide with the industry-focused University of South Australia. It is organised into colleges covering health and medicine, engineering, business, education and social sciences, creative industries and science (including the renowned wine and agricultural sciences at Waite and Roseworthy).

International students apply directly, through SATAC or (from some countries) through an agent, and must meet the degree's academic and English requirements, from IELTS 6.0 up to 7.0 or more. Medicine and dentistry additionally need the UCAT ANZ or ISAT and an interview.

label.en: English test meeting the degree's level (IELTS 6.0–7.0+ / TOEFL iBT 60–94 / PTE 60–72)
UCAT ANZ/ISAT and interview for medicine and dentistry
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Degree-specific minimum results for your qualification; health and medicine are the most competitive.

en: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery

platform: Direct (UTS international online application) or authorised agent
deadline_note: UTS assesses international undergraduate applications on a rolling basis; apply several months before the Autumn session (late February 2027) or Spring session (July 2027).

tuition_intl.note: Varies by course; see the UTS tuition fees search.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships such as the UTS Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship (partial tuition); US students can use US federal loans.

tests.en: SAT is one accepted basis for US-curriculum applicants (at a competitive standard, no published minimum); otherwise entry is by your secondary qualification. English (standard): IELTS Academic 6.5 with writing 6.0; TOEFL iBT 79 with writing 21 (or 4/4.5 on the new 1–6 scale); PTE 58 with writing 50; Cambridge C1/C2 176. Some courses (e.g. nursing, education) require more.

summary.en: A young, industry-focused technology university in central Sydney, ranked 87th in the world by QS 2026 and strong in engineering, IT, design and business. Standard English entry is IELTS 6.5 (writing 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 79.
summary.ka: ახალგაზრდა, ინდუსტრიაზე ორიენტირებული ტექნოლოგიური უნივერსიტეტი სიდნეის ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 87-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, IT-ში, დიზაინსა და ბიზნესში. ინგლისურის სტანდარტული მოთხოვნაა IELTS 6.5 (წერა 6.0) ან TOEFL iBT 79.
summary.ar: جامعة تقنية حديثة موجهة نحو الصناعة في وسط سيدني، تحتل المرتبة 87 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز في الهندسة وتقنية المعلومات والتصميم والأعمال. متطلب الإنجليزية المعتاد هو IELTS 6.5 (الكتابة 6.0) أو TOEFL iBT 79.

about.en:
UTS is a public university on a compact, architecturally striking campus in Sydney's Ultimo tech precinct. It focuses on practice-based learning in engineering, IT, design, architecture, business, communication, health, law and science, and many degrees include internships or a Diploma in Professional Engineering Practice.

International applicants apply online, directly or via an agent, with their secondary results and an English test (IELTS 6.5 with writing 6.0 is the standard level). Applications are assessed on a rolling basis, and the Vice-Chancellor's International Undergraduate Scholarship rewards high achievers.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.5, writing 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 79, writing 21)
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Course-specific selection ranks converted from your qualification; engineering and IT are competitive.

platform: Direct (Nanjing University online application for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admission period has not been published yet; applications for September entry usually run in the first half of the year. A CSCA report is required, with tests in January, March, April, June and December.

tuition_intl.note: RMB 21,000/yr liberal arts; 24,000 science and business; 32,000 Software Institute; 42,000 Medical School. Online application fee RMB 500.

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship, Nanjing Municipal Scholarship and International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship.

tests.en: SAT, ACT, AP, IB, A-level or AST scores may be submitted (valid two years) but are not mandatory. From 2026/27 a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report is required. Most programmes are Chinese-taught and need HSK level 5 with at least 180. English-major applicants need IELTS 5.5 or TOEFL 70. Admission includes a written exam and interview.

summary.en: One of China's oldest and most prestigious C9 universities, in Nanjing and ranked 90th in the world by QS 2026, with standout physics, chemistry, earth sciences and humanities. Most undergraduate teaching is in Chinese, so HSK 5 (180+) and a CSCA report are needed.
summary.ka: ჩინეთის ერთ-ერთი უძველესი და პრესტიჟული C9 უნივერსიტეტი ნანკინში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 90-ე, გამორჩეული ფიზიკით, ქიმიით, დედამიწის მეცნიერებებითა და ჰუმანიტარული დარგებით. სწავლება ძირითადად ჩინურადაა, ამიტომ საჭიროა HSK 5 (180+) და CSCA-ის ანგარიში.
summary.ar: إحدى أقدم جامعات C9 وأعرقها في الصين، في نانجينغ وتحتل المرتبة 90 عالمياً في QS 2026، وتتميز في الفيزياء والكيمياء وعلوم الأرض والإنسانيات. التدريس في الغالب بالصينية، لذا يلزم HSK 5 (180 فأكثر) وتقرير CSCA.

about.en:
Nanjing University traces its roots to 1902 and is one of China's leading research universities, with its main Xianlin campus in Nanjing. It is known for physics, astronomy, chemistry, geology, Chinese language and literature, history and computer science, and runs a well-established institute for international students.

International applicants submit school records, HSK results, a CSCA report, two recommendation letters and a personal statement online, then take a written exam and interview. Tuition is low (from RMB 21,000 a year), and Chinese Government and Nanjing Municipal scholarships are available.

label.en: HSK 5 (180+) for Chinese-taught programmes; IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 70 for English majors

gpa_note.en: Selection on high school record, HSK level, CSCA results, written exam and interview.

platform: Direct (e-apply.jp registration for the English-taught programmes); Japanese-taught degrees via the privately financed international student exam (EJU-based)
deadline_note: Human Sciences International Undergraduate Degree Program (English-taught, October 2027 entry): online registration 1 Dec 2026 (10:00 JST) – 5 Jan 2027 (23:59 JST); fee also due 5 Jan; documents must arrive by post by 8 Jan 2027. From the 2028 intake the window moves to 1 Nov – 5 Dec 2027.

tuition_intl.note: National-university tuition (same for domestic and international students); see Osaka's tuition page for the current amount.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships including Japanese Government (MEXT) scholarships and JASSO/private foundation awards; tuition exemptions possible after enrolment.

tests.en: English-taught Human Sciences programme: applicants submit a copy of a standardized academic test result (e.g. SAT, ACT, AP, IB or A-level) plus proof of English; screening is document-based, with interviews for some. Japanese-taught degrees require the EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission) and Japanese proficiency.

summary.en: One of Japan's former imperial universities, near Osaka and ranked 95th in the world by QS 2026, strong in engineering, medicine and the life sciences. International students can take English-taught degrees in human sciences or science, with the next human sciences window running 1 December 2026 – 5 January 2027.
summary.ka: იაპონიის ერთ-ერთი ყოფილი იმპერიული უნივერსიტეტი ოსაკასთან, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 95-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, მედიცინასა და სიცოცხლის მეცნიერებებში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ ინგლისურენოვანი ხარისხი ადამიანის მეცნიერებებში ან საბუნებისმეტყველო მეცნიერებებში; შემდეგი მიღება 2026 წლის 1 დეკემბრიდან 2027 წლის 5 იანვრამდეა.
summary.ar: إحدى الجامعات الإمبراطورية السابقة في اليابان قرب أوساكا، تحتل المرتبة 95 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز في الهندسة والطب وعلوم الحياة. يمكن للطلاب الدوليين دراسة برامج بالإنجليزية في العلوم الإنسانية أو العلوم، وتمتد نافذة التقديم القادمة للعلوم الإنسانية من 1 ديسمبر 2026 إلى 5 يناير 2027.

about.en:
The University of Osaka (formerly Osaka University) is a leading national research university with campuses in Suita, Toyonaka and Minoh. It is known for engineering, medicine, immunology, chemistry and the sciences, and most of its eleven undergraduate schools teach in Japanese.

For students without Japanese, two English-taught bachelor's routes exist: the Human Sciences International Undergraduate Degree Program and the International Undergraduate Program in Science (chemistry-biology). These start in October, assess applicants mainly on documents (school records, standardized test results such as SAT/IB/A-level, English proof), and charge Japan's national-university tuition, which is low by international standards.

label.en: Secondary school diploma (or conditional offer for IB/A-level in progress)
Standardized test result (SAT, ACT, AP, IB or A-level)

gpa_note.en: Comprehensive document screening; strong grades and standardized results are expected.

en: Human Sciences International Undergraduate Degree Program

platform: Direct (Science Tokyo admissions; GSEP online application for the English-taught programme)
deadline_note: The English-taught Global Scientists and Engineers Program (GSEP) for April 2027 has already completed its preliminary screening (results 16 Sept 2026). The GSEP 2028 call is expected in mid-2027; check admissions.isct.ac.jp.

tuition_intl.note: Bachelor's tuition ¥635,400/yr; admission fee ¥282,000 (Science Tokyo tuition page).

aid_intl.en: MEXT and JASSO scholarships plus university scholarships for international students; tuition exemption/deferment possible.

tests.en: GSEP (English-taught) uses a two-stage document screening followed by later selection; strong maths and science and English proficiency are required. Japanese-taught programmes for privately financed international students require the EJU and Japanese ability. Exact score thresholds are not published.

summary.en: Formed in 2024 by merging Tokyo Tech and Tokyo Medical and Dental University, Science Tokyo is ranked 97th in the world by QS 2026 and is a powerhouse in engineering, materials and medicine. Its English-taught Global Scientists and Engineers Program admits international undergraduates for April entry.
summary.ka: 2024 წელს Tokyo Tech-ისა და ტოკიოს სამედიცინო და სტომატოლოგიური უნივერსიტეტის შერწყმით შექმნილი Science Tokyo QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 97-ეა და ძლიერია ინჟინერიაში, მასალათმცოდნეობასა და მედიცინაში. ინგლისურენოვანი Global Scientists and Engineers Program აპრილის ნაკადზე იღებს საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს.
summary.ar: تأسس معهد طوكيو للعلوم عام 2024 بدمج معهد طوكيو للتكنولوجيا وجامعة طوكيو الطبية وطب الأسنان، ويحتل المرتبة 97 عالمياً في QS 2026 ويُعد قوة في الهندسة والمواد والطب. يقبل برنامج «العلماء والمهندسون العالميون» بالإنجليزية طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين للالتحاق في أبريل.

about.en:
Institute of Science Tokyo combines Japan's top engineering university (Tokyo Institute of Technology) with a leading medical and dental university. Its Ookayama and Yushima campuses host schools of science, engineering, materials and chemical technology, computing, life science and technology, medicine and dentistry, with a strong research culture and close industry ties.

Most bachelor's teaching is in Japanese, but the Global Scientists and Engineers Program (GSEP) offers an English-taught route into chemistry and chemical engineering-related fields with Japanese-language training. Tuition is ¥635,400 a year, low by global standards, and MEXT and university scholarships are available.

gpa_note.en: Very strong mathematics and science preparation is expected.

name.en: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)

platform: Direct (POSTECH international undergraduate admissions)
deadline_note: POSTECH runs international undergraduate rounds for Spring and Fall entry (the Spring 2027 guideline is published); check adm-iu.postech.ac.kr for the next round's dates.

tuition_intl.note: Set per semester; POSTECH and GKS scholarships cover tuition for many students.

aid_intl.en: Generous scholarships: POSTECH scholarships and Global Korea Scholarship (GKS) for international undergraduates.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement stated; selection by document review and, if necessary, interview. Strong maths and science records and English proficiency are expected; exact minimums are in POSTECH's admission guideline.

summary.en: A small, elite science and engineering university in Pohang, ranked 106th by QS 2026, founded with steelmaker POSCO. It teaches most courses in English and supports many students with full scholarships.
summary.ka: მცირე, ელიტური მეცნიერებისა და ინჟინერიის უნივერსიტეტი პოჰანგში, QS 2026-ში 106-ე, დაარსებული ფოლადის კომპანია POSCO-ს მიერ. კურსების უმეტესობა ინგლისურადაა და ბევრ სტუდენტს სრული სტიპენდია აქვს.
summary.ar: جامعة نخبوية صغيرة للعلوم والهندسة في بوهانغ، تحتل المرتبة 106 في QS 2026، أسستها شركة الصلب POSCO. تُدرَّس معظم المقررات بالإنجليزية وتدعم كثيراً من الطلاب بمنح كاملة.

about.en:
POSTECH was founded in 1986 by POSCO as Korea's first research-oriented university and remains small (roughly 1,400 undergraduates), with a high faculty-to-student ratio. It is strongest in materials science, chemistry and chemical engineering, physics (with the Pohang Accelerator Laboratory), life sciences and computer science.

International applicants apply online with transcripts, recommendation letters and essays, followed by document review and interviews if necessary. The university operates as a bilingual campus with most courses in English, and scholarships are widely available.

label.en: Financial documents for the D-2 visa

gpa_note.en: Very strong mathematics and science preparation is expected.

platform: Direct (SKKU global admissions online application)
deadline_note: International freshman admission for Spring and Fall semesters; 2027 dates not verified. Check admission-global.skku.edu.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by college.

aid_intl.en: Admission and merit scholarships for international students (partial to full tuition), plus GKS.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may be submitted as supporting evidence). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4 or higher); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.

summary.en: A historic Seoul university dating to 1398 and backed by Samsung, ranked 108th by QS 2026, with strengths in semiconductors, engineering and business. International students enter through spring and fall global admission rounds.
summary.ka: ისტორიული სეულის უნივერსიტეტი, რომლის ფესვები 1398 წლიდან მოდის და Samsung-ის მხარდაჭერით სარგებლობს, QS 2026-ში 108-ე, ძლიერი ნახევარგამტარებში, ინჟინერიასა და ბიზნესში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები გაზაფხულისა და შემოდგომის გლობალური მიღებით ირიცხებიან.
summary.ar: جامعة تاريخية في سيول تعود جذورها إلى عام 1398 وتدعمها سامسونغ، تحتل المرتبة 108 في QS 2026 وتتميز في أشباه الموصلات والهندسة والأعمال. يلتحق الطلاب الدوليون عبر جولات القبول العالمية في الربيع والخريف.

about.en:
Sungkyunkwan University traces its origins to the Joseon dynasty's royal academy and is today a private research university supported by Samsung. Its humanities and social sciences campus is in central Seoul and its natural sciences campus in Suwon, with notable strength in semiconductor engineering, electronics, computing, business and pharmacy.

International students apply through SKKU's global admissions office for March or September entry with school records, a study plan and TOPIK or English scores. Admission and merit scholarships are available.

label.en: Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Bank statement for the D-2 visa

gpa_note.en: Holistic document review; strong school records expected.

platform: Direct (MSU admission for foreign citizens) or Russian government quota
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Russian government quota places (tuition-free) for selected foreign applicants; otherwise fee-paying contracts.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Teaching is in Russian: foreign applicants take MSU's entrance examinations (or apply via the government quota) and need Russian proficiency; a preparatory faculty offers a Russian-language foundation year.

summary.en: Russia's oldest and largest classical university, founded in 1755 and ranked 115th by QS 2026, with world-famous mathematics and physics faculties. Teaching is in Russian, with entrance exams for foreign applicants.
summary.ka: რუსეთის უძველესი და უდიდესი კლასიკური უნივერსიტეტი, დაარსებული 1755 წელს, QS 2026-ში 115-ე, მსოფლიოში ცნობილი მათემატიკისა და ფიზიკის ფაკულტეტებით. სწავლება რუსულადაა, უცხოელებისთვის კი მისაღები გამოცდებია.
summary.ar: أقدم وأكبر جامعة كلاسيكية في روسيا، تأسست عام 1755 وتحتل المرتبة 115 في QS 2026، وتشتهر عالمياً بكليتي الرياضيات والفيزياء. التدريس بالروسية مع امتحانات قبول للمتقدمين الأجانب.

about.en:
Lomonosov Moscow State University (MSU) occupies the iconic Main Building on the Sparrow Hills and has more than 40 faculties. It is renowned for mechanics and mathematics, physics, chemistry, computational mathematics and cybernetics, and also teaches economics, law, journalism and languages.

Foreign citizens apply directly with school documents and sit MSU's entrance tests, or are nominated via the Russian government quota; Russian proficiency is essential, and the preparatory faculty offers a foundation year. Applicants should check current visa and banking conditions for studying in Russia.

label.en: Secondary school transcripts (legalised, translated into Russian)
Secondary school diploma with recognition in Russia

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name.ar: المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا في دلهي (IIT Delhi)

platform: JEE (Advanced) + JoSAA counselling
deadline_note: JEE (Advanced) 2027 registration dates are announced on jeeadv.ac.in (in 2026, JoSAA allotment rounds ran through July). Foreign nationals register directly for JEE (Advanced); watch for the 2027 information brochure.

tuition_intl.note: Foreign nationals pay a higher tuition rate set by the IIT; see the institute's fee page/JoSAA business rules.

aid_intl.en: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.

summary.en: India's highest-ranked university in QS 2026 (118th), in New Delhi, with elite computer science and engineering. Foreign nationals enter B.Tech programmes through JEE (Advanced) without needing JEE (Main).
summary.ka: ინდოეთის ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი QS 2026-ში (118-ე), ნიუ-დელიში, ელიტური კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებითა და ინჟინერიით. უცხოელები B.Tech პროგრამებზე JEE (Advanced)-ით ირიცხებიან, JEE (Main)-ის გარეშე.
summary.ar: أعلى جامعة هندية تصنيفاً في QS 2026 (المرتبة 118)، في نيودلهي، وتتميز بعلوم الحاسوب والهندسة على مستوى النخبة. يلتحق الأجانب ببرامج B.Tech عبر JEE (Advanced) دون الحاجة إلى JEE (Main).

about.en:
IIT Delhi, established in 1961, is one of India's premier engineering institutes on a campus in Hauz Khas, south Delhi. It is renowned for computer science, electrical, mechanical and chemical engineering, mathematics and computing, and for a strong startup culture among alumni.

Undergraduate admission is entirely through JEE (Advanced) rank and JoSAA counselling. Foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and compete for supernumerary seats; all teaching is in English.

label.en: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

gpa_note.en: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

platform: Direct (UC special admission for foreign secondary-school graduates) or national PAES
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Merit and need-based scholarships mainly for students admitted through the national system; limited options for foreign applicants.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; Chilean applicants use the national PAES test, while foreign secondary-school graduates use UC's special admission route (school record, international exams such as IB, and possibly interviews). Teaching is in Spanish.

summary.en: Latin America's top-ranked university in QS 2026 (119th), a private Catholic university in Santiago with leading engineering, business, medicine and law. Teaching is in Spanish; foreign students use a special admission route.
summary.ka: ლათინური ამერიკის ყველაზე მაღალრეიტინგული უნივერსიტეტი QS 2026-ში (119-ე), კერძო კათოლიკური უნივერსიტეტი სანტიაგოში, წამყვანი ინჟინერიით, ბიზნესით, მედიცინითა და სამართლით. სწავლება ესპანურადაა; უცხოელები სპეციალური მიღების გზით ირიცხებიან.
summary.ar: أعلى جامعة في أمريكا اللاتينية تصنيفاً في QS 2026 (المرتبة 119)، جامعة كاثوليكية خاصة في سانتياغو ببرامج رائدة في الهندسة والأعمال والطب والقانون. التدريس بالإسبانية، ويلتحق الأجانب عبر مسار قبول خاص.

about.en:
Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, founded in 1888, has several campuses in Santiago (San Joaquín, Casa Central, Lo Contador, Oriente) and one in Villarrica. It is particularly strong in engineering, economics and business, medicine, law, architecture and communications.

Most students enter through Chile's national PAES exam, while graduates of foreign secondary schools apply via special admission with their school records and international qualifications. Teaching is in Spanish.

label.en: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (RMIT international online application) or authorised agent
deadline_note: Semester 1, 2027 starts in March. RMIT asks international students needing a visa to apply and accept an offer at least 4 weeks before the course start date; some courses have earlier dates.

tuition_intl.note: Set per course (see the course page); RMIT may raise fees by up to 7.5% a year.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships for international students, including regional Academic Merit Scholarships and joint scholarships with national funding bodies (e.g. Colfuturo, China Scholarship Council).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry is by secondary qualification against course minimums. English: course-specific IELTS (Academic) or equivalent, listed on each course page. Some design and media courses require a folio or selection task.

summary.en: A large, practice-oriented technology and design university in central Melbourne, ranked 119th in the world by QS 2026 and especially strong in art and design. International students can start in March or July.
summary.ka: დიდი, პრაქტიკაზე ორიენტირებული ტექნოლოგიისა და დიზაინის უნივერსიტეტი მელბურნის ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 119-ე, განსაკუთრებით ძლიერი ხელოვნებასა და დიზაინში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ სწავლის დაწყება მარტში ან ივლისში.
summary.ar: جامعة كبيرة للتكنولوجيا والتصميم ذات توجه تطبيقي في وسط ملبورن، تحتل المرتبة 119 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز خصوصاً في الفن والتصميم. يمكن للطلاب الدوليين البدء في مارس أو يوليو.

about.en:
RMIT (Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology) is a dual-sector public university with a city campus woven into Melbourne's CBD, plus campuses in Vietnam and a presence in Spain. It is internationally known for art and design, architecture, communication and media, and also offers engineering, IT, aviation, business and health degrees with a strong emphasis on industry projects and work-integrated learning.

International students apply online directly or through an agent, meeting course-specific academic and English requirements; creative programmes may require a folio. Semester 1 starts in March and Semester 2 in July, and merit scholarships are available for many regions.

label.en: English test meeting the course's IELTS level
Folio or selection task for some design/media courses
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Course-specific minimums for your qualification; design courses also weigh the folio.

scholarships.name: RMIT international scholarships (Academic Merit and joint scholarships)

platform: Direct (Studenti Online) plus Universitaly pre-enrolment for non-EU students needing a visa
deadline_note: Each degree programme publishes its own call for applications, often with several selection rounds (international programmes typically from late autumn to spring). Non-EU students must also pre-enrol on Universitaly for a visa. Check the call on the programme website.

tuition_intl.note: Income-based fees: fixed instalment €157.04 plus a variable contribution up to the programme maximum (roughly up to €3,000+); full exemption from the variable part if the family financial indicator is €27,000 or less.

aid_intl.en: Need-based ER.GO regional grants and fee exemptions open to international students; Unibo Action 1&2 study grants for international students on some programmes.

tests.en: Admission tests vary by programme and are set out in each call: many English-taught bachelor's accept SAT or TOLC results; medicine/dentistry in English use the IMAT. Language: proof of English (often B2) for English-taught programmes, Italian for Italian-taught ones.

summary.en: Founded in 1088, Bologna is the oldest university in the Western world and is ranked 123rd by QS 2026, with campuses across Emilia-Romagna. It offers a growing number of English-taught bachelor's degrees, and fees are income-based, from about €157 a year.
summary.ka: 1088 წელს დაარსებული ბოლონია დასავლეთის უძველესი უნივერსიტეტია და QS 2026-ში 123-ეა, კამპუსებით ემილია-რომანიაში. გთავაზობთ ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატის მზარდ რაოდენობას, საფასური კი შემოსავალზეა დამოკიდებული და წელიწადში დაახლოებით €157-დან იწყება.
summary.ar: تأسست عام 1088 وهي أقدم جامعة في العالم الغربي، وتحتل المرتبة 123 في QS 2026 ولها فروع في إقليم إميليا-رومانيا. تقدم عدداً متزايداً من برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية، والرسوم مرتبطة بالدخل وتبدأ من نحو 157 يورو سنوياً.

about.en:
The University of Bologna is a large public multi-campus university with sites in Bologna, Cesena, Forlì, Ravenna and Rimini. It is strong across economics, law, political science, medicine, engineering, agriculture and the humanities, and teaches a growing list of international first-cycle degrees in English, such as Business and Economics, Economics and Finance, and Genomics.

Each programme sets its own call for applications, admission test (SAT, TOLC, IMAT or programme-specific) and deadlines. Fees depend on family income, so many international students pay little, and the regional ER.GO agency awards need-based grants and housing.

label.en: School-leaving diploma (12 years of schooling) with Declaration of Value/CIMEA statement if required
Admission test per programme call (e.g. SAT, TOLC or IMAT)
English proficiency for English-taught programmes (often B2)
Universitaly pre-enrolment (non-EU students needing a visa)
ISEE or foreign income documents for fee reductions

gpa_note.en: Selection usually combines school grades with the admission test score set in each programme's call.

platform: Direct (Macquarie international application) or authorised agent
deadline_note: International applications are assessed on a rolling basis; apply well before Session 1 (late February 2027) to allow for visa processing.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by course.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships such as the Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarship (partial tuition).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English (most undergraduate courses): IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band; some courses (e.g. Laws, Clinical Science, Exercise and Sports Science) require 7.0 with 6.5 per band.

summary.en: A campus university in Sydney's tech corridor, ranked 126th by QS 2026, known for actuarial studies, linguistics, business and environmental sciences. Most courses require IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 in each band.
summary.ka: კამპუსური უნივერსიტეტი სიდნეის ტექნოლოგიურ დერეფანში, QS 2026-ში 126-ე, ცნობილი აქტუარული საქმით, ლინგვისტიკით, ბიზნესითა და გარემოს მეცნიერებებით. კურსების უმეტესობას სჭირდება IELTS 6.5, თითო კომპონენტში 6.0.
summary.ar: جامعة ذات حرم في ممر التكنولوجيا بسيدني، تحتل المرتبة 126 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالعلوم الاكتوارية واللسانيات والأعمال والعلوم البيئية. تتطلب معظم البرامج IELTS 6.5 مع 6.0 لكل مهارة.

about.en:
Founded in 1964, Macquarie University sits on a large green campus in Macquarie Park, alongside a business park home to many tech and pharmaceutical companies. It is known for actuarial studies, applied finance, linguistics, psychology, earth and environmental sciences, and media, and has its own private hospital.

International applicants apply online with their secondary results and English scores (IELTS 6.5 with 6.0 bands for most courses). Applications are assessed on a rolling basis for February and July starts, and merit scholarships are offered.

label.en: English test at the course's level
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Course-specific entry ranks converted from your qualification.

platform: Direct (USM international undergraduate application)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for international undergraduates; most are self-funded or government-sponsored.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified.

summary.en: Malaysia's only APEX (accelerated excellence) university, based in Penang and ranked 128th by QS 2026, with more than 60 undergraduate programmes from engineering to health sciences. International students have a dedicated admission channel.
summary.ka: მალაიზიის ერთადერთი APEX სტატუსის უნივერსიტეტი პენანგში, QS 2026-ში 128-ე, 60-ზე მეტი საბაკალავრო პროგრამით ინჟინერიიდან ჯანდაცვამდე. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებისთვის ცალკე მიღების არხი არსებობს.
summary.ar: الجامعة الماليزية الوحيدة الحاصلة على تصنيف APEX، مقرها بينانغ وتحتل المرتبة 128 في QS 2026، وتقدم أكثر من 60 برنامج بكالوريوس من الهندسة إلى العلوم الصحية. للطلاب الدوليين قناة قبول خاصة.

about.en:
Universiti Sains Malaysia was founded in 1969 and has its main campus in Penang, an engineering campus in Nibong Tebal and a health campus in Kelantan. It offers over 60 undergraduate programmes across natural and applied sciences, engineering, medical and health sciences, arts, humanities, and business and management.

International students apply through USM's international channel with pre-university results and English proficiency evidence. Tuition and living costs in Penang are modest by global standards.

label.en: Documents for the Malaysian student pass (EMGS)

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (UKM online application)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for international undergraduates; most are self-funded or government-sponsored.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified.

summary.en: The National University of Malaysia, near Kuala Lumpur and ranked 130th by QS 2026, strong in medicine, engineering and social sciences. Many programmes are taught in Malay, with growing English-medium options.
summary.ka: მალაიზიის ეროვნული უნივერსიტეტი კუალა-ლუმპურთან, QS 2026-ში 130-ე, ძლიერი მედიცინაში, ინჟინერიასა და სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში. ბევრი პროგრამა მალაიურადაა, ინგლისურენოვანი არჩევანი კი იზრდება.
summary.ar: الجامعة الوطنية الماليزية قرب كوالالمبور، تحتل المرتبة 130 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الطب والهندسة والعلوم الاجتماعية. تُدرَّس برامج كثيرة بالملايوية مع تزايد الخيارات بالإنجليزية.

about.en:
Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia was founded in 1970 to champion Malay as a language of higher learning. Its main campus is in Bangi, south of Kuala Lumpur, with a medical campus in Cheras, and it is strong in medicine, engineering and built environment, social sciences, Islamic studies and environmental science.

International students apply online with pre-university results and English (or Malay) proficiency; programme language should be checked before applying.

label.en: Documents for the Malaysian student pass (EMGS)

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (UiO / Søknadsweb); Norwegian-taught bachelor's via Samordna opptak
deadline_note: UiO has only one English-taught bachelor's programme; all others are in Norwegian and require documented Norwegian proficiency. Check the programme page for the current international application deadline.

tuition_intl.note: Citizens of countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland pay tuition fees (amount set per programme); EU/EEA students pay only the semester fee. Living-cost proof for 2026/27: NOK 170,368.

aid_intl.en: None: UiO does not offer scholarships for full bachelor's or master's degree students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Norwegian-taught bachelor's require proof of Norwegian proficiency (UiO offers no preparatory Norwegian courses before admission). The English-taught bachelor's requires English proficiency as set in its admission rules.

summary.en: Norway's oldest and largest university, ranked 131st in the world by QS 2026 and strong in law, humanities and the natural sciences. Almost all bachelor's degrees are taught in Norwegian, and non-EU/EEA students pay tuition with no university scholarships.
summary.ka: ნორვეგიის უძველესი და უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 131-ე, ძლიერი სამართალში, ჰუმანიტარულ და საბუნებისმეტყველო მეცნიერებებში. თითქმის ყველა ბაკალავრიატი ნორვეგიულ ენაზეა, ხოლო ევროკავშირის/EEA-ს გარეთ მყოფი სტუდენტები სწავლის საფასურს იხდიან უნივერსიტეტის სტიპენდიების გარეშე.
summary.ar: أقدم وأكبر جامعة في النرويج، تحتل المرتبة 131 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتتميز في القانون والإنسانيات والعلوم الطبيعية. تُدرَّس جميع برامج البكالوريوس تقريباً بالنرويجية، ويدفع الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي والمنطقة الاقتصادية الأوروبية رسوماً دون منح جامعية.

about.en:
Founded in 1811, the University of Oslo is Norway's leading research university, with its main Blindern campus and a historic law faculty in central Oslo. It has eight faculties spanning law, humanities, social sciences, mathematics and natural sciences, medicine, dentistry, education and theology.

For international undergraduates the options are narrow: one English-taught bachelor's programme, while all other bachelor's degrees require Norwegian. Since 2023 students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland pay tuition, and UiO offers no degree scholarships, though the master's level has many more English-taught programmes.

label.en: Secondary school diploma meeting Norwegian general entrance requirements
English proficiency (English-taught programme) or Norwegian proficiency (Norwegian-taught)
Proof of funds for the residence permit (NOK 170,368 for 2026/27) and tuition

gpa_note.en: Competitive programmes rank applicants by school grade points (converted for foreign qualifications).

platform: FUVEST entrance exam, ENEM/SISU, or USP selection routes for international students
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: Tuition-free (public university).

aid_intl.en: Tuition-free public university; student-support programmes (housing, meals) are available on a means-tested basis.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Undergraduate entry is mainly through the FUVEST vestibular exam or ENEM/SISU; some international selection routes exist. Teaching is in Portuguese, so proficiency (e.g. Celpe-Bras) is expected.

summary.en: Brazil's largest and most prestigious public university, in São Paulo and ranked 133rd by QS 2026, tuition-free and strong across medicine, engineering and law. Entry is mainly through the competitive FUVEST exam, and teaching is in Portuguese.
summary.ka: ბრაზილიის უდიდესი და ყველაზე პრესტიჟული საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი სან-პაულოში, QS 2026-ში 133-ე, უფასო და ძლიერი მედიცინაში, ინჟინერიასა და სამართალში. მიღება ძირითადად კონკურენტული FUVEST გამოცდით ხდება, სწავლება კი პორტუგალიურადაა.
summary.ar: أكبر وأعرق جامعة حكومية في البرازيل، في ساو باولو وتحتل المرتبة 133 في QS 2026، مجانية وقوية في الطب والهندسة والقانون. القبول أساساً عبر امتحان FUVEST التنافسي، والتدريس بالبرتغالية.

about.en:
The University of São Paulo, founded in 1934, has campuses in São Paulo city and across the state (São Carlos, Ribeirão Preto, Piracicaba and others). It leads Latin America in research output and is strong in medicine, engineering (Poli-USP), law, agricultural sciences (ESALQ), economics and the arts.

As a public university it charges no tuition. Admission is highly competitive via FUVEST or ENEM/SISU, and international students must be ready to study in Portuguese.

label.en: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name.ar: المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا في بومباي (IIT Bombay)

platform: JEE (Advanced) + JoSAA counselling
deadline_note: JEE (Advanced) 2027 registration dates are announced on jeeadv.ac.in (in 2026, JoSAA allotment rounds ran through July). Foreign nationals register directly for JEE (Advanced); watch for the 2027 information brochure.

tuition_intl.note: Foreign nationals pay a higher tuition rate set by the IIT; see the institute's fee page/JoSAA business rules.

aid_intl.en: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.

summary.en: One of India's most sought-after engineering institutes, in Mumbai, ranked 134th by QS 2026 and especially famous for computer science. Admission is through JEE (Advanced), which foreign nationals can take directly.
summary.ka: ინდოეთის ერთ-ერთი ყველაზე მოთხოვნადი საინჟინრო ინსტიტუტი მუმბაიში, QS 2026-ში 134-ე, განსაკუთრებით ცნობილი კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებით. მიღება JEE (Advanced)-ით ხდება, რომლის ჩაბარებაც უცხოელებს პირდაპირ შეუძლიათ.
summary.ar: من أكثر معاهد الهندسة طلباً في الهند، في مومباي وتحتل المرتبة 134 في QS 2026، وتشتهر خصوصاً بعلوم الحاسوب. القبول عبر JEE (Advanced) الذي يمكن للأجانب التقدم له مباشرة.

about.en:
IIT Bombay, founded in 1958 with UNESCO and Soviet support, sits on a lakeside campus in Powai, Mumbai. Its computer science programme attracts India's top JEE rankers, and it is also strong in electrical, aerospace, chemical and mechanical engineering, engineering physics and industrial design.

Undergraduates are admitted through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA; foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and take supernumerary seats. Campus life is vibrant, with the Mood Indigo and Techfest festivals.

label.en: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

gpa_note.en: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

name.en: University of Science and Technology of China (USTC)

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.

summary.en: A top C9 university in Hefei founded by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, ranked 134th by QS 2026 and renowned for physics, quantum science and mathematics. Most undergraduate teaching is in Chinese, and a CSCA report is required.
summary.ka: C9-ის წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი ხეფეიში, დაარსებული ჩინეთის მეცნიერებათა აკადემიის მიერ, QS 2026-ში 134-ე, ცნობილი ფიზიკით, კვანტური მეცნიერებითა და მათემატიკით. სწავლება ძირითადად ჩინურადაა და საჭიროა CSCA-ის ანგარიში.
summary.ar: جامعة رائدة في رابطة C9 بمدينة خفي أسستها الأكاديمية الصينية للعلوم، تحتل المرتبة 134 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بالفيزياء وعلوم الكم والرياضيات. التدريس الجامعي غالباً بالصينية ويُشترط تقرير CSCA.

about.en:
Founded in 1958 by the Chinese Academy of Sciences, USTC is one of China's most science-focused universities, with campuses in Hefei. It is a world leader in quantum information (including the Micius quantum satellite team), physics, mathematics, chemistry and computer science, and sends a high share of graduates to PhD study.

International undergraduates mostly study in Chinese and need HSK plus a CSCA report; selection considers school records and may include tests or interviews. CSC scholarships are available.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: Direct (UPM online application)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for international undergraduates; most are self-funded or government-sponsored.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified.

summary.en: Malaysia's leading agricultural university in Serdang near Kuala Lumpur, ranked 138th by QS 2026, also strong in veterinary medicine, food science and engineering.
summary.ka: მალაიზიის წამყვანი აგრარული უნივერსიტეტი სერდანგში, კუალა-ლუმპურთან, QS 2026-ში 138-ე, ასევე ძლიერი ვეტერინარიაში, კვების მეცნიერებასა და ინჟინერიაში.
summary.ar: الجامعة الزراعية الرائدة في ماليزيا في سيردانغ قرب كوالالمبور، تحتل المرتبة 138 في QS 2026، وتتميز أيضاً في الطب البيطري وعلوم الأغذية والهندسة.

about.en:
Universiti Putra Malaysia began as an agricultural school in 1931 and is today a broad research university on a large campus in Serdang. It is best known for agriculture, forestry, veterinary medicine, food science and biotechnology, and also offers engineering, computer science, economics and education.

International students apply online with pre-university results and English proficiency evidence; UPM's moderate fees and campus location near Kuala Lumpur make it a popular choice.

label.en: Documents for the Malaysian student pass (EMGS)

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: uni-assist / HU application portal
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees; students pay only the semester contribution (covering administration, student services and usually a public-transport ticket).

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: A historic Berlin university founded in 1810 on Wilhelm von Humboldt's model of research-led teaching, ranked 140th by QS 2026 and strong in humanities and social sciences. Bachelor's study is in German and tuition-free.
summary.ka: ისტორიული ბერლინის უნივერსიტეტი, დაარსებული 1810 წელს ვილჰელმ ფონ ჰუმბოლდტის კვლევაზე დაფუძნებული სწავლების მოდელით, QS 2026-ში 140-ე, ძლიერი ჰუმანიტარულ და სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში. ბაკალავრიატი გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: جامعة تاريخية في برلين تأسست عام 1810 وفق نموذج فيلهلم فون هومبولت للتعليم القائم على البحث، تحتل المرتبة 140 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الإنسانيات والعلوم الاجتماعية. الدراسة بالألمانية ومجانية.

about.en:
Humboldt University is one of Berlin's three major universities, with its main building on Unter den Linden and science campus in Adlershof; its alumni and faculty include dozens of Nobel laureates. It is strong in history, philosophy, literature, social sciences, law, economics, life sciences and mathematics, and shares the Charité medical school with FU Berlin.
