International applicants usually apply via uni-assist and need German C1; there are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution that includes a public-transport ticket.

label.en: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

gpa_note.en: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

platform: Direct (u:space online application)
deadline_note: Non-EU/EEA applicants for bachelor's programmes without entrance exams: summer semester 2027 application period 16 Nov 2026 – 7 Jan 2027; winter semester 2026/27 period was 22 June – 3 Aug 2026 (expect a similar window for winter 2027/28). Programmes with entrance exams/aptitude tests have earlier registration deadlines.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA students: tuition €726.72 + Students' Union fee €26.20 per semester; EU/EEA students pay only the union fee within the standard study period.

aid_intl.en: No general university scholarships for full degree students from abroad; some external grants (e.g. OeAD) and fee waivers for certain countries.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Almost all bachelor's programmes are taught in German: you can apply with German at A2 level, but need C1 German before you can enrol (the university's preparatory programme can bridge the gap). A few programmes require English proficiency. Some subjects (e.g. psychology, business, computer science, education) have entrance exams/aptitude tests.

summary.en: Founded in 1365, the University of Vienna is the oldest university in the German-speaking world and is ranked 140th by QS 2026. Bachelor's degrees are taught in German and cost non-EU students about €753 a semester.
summary.ka: 1365 წელს დაარსებული ვენის უნივერსიტეტი გერმანულენოვანი სამყაროს უძველესი უნივერსიტეტია და QS 2026-ში 140-ეა. ბაკალავრიატი გერმანულად ისწავლება და ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფ სტუდენტებს სემესტრში დაახლოებით €753 უჯდებათ.
summary.ar: تأسست جامعة فيينا عام 1365 وهي أقدم جامعة في العالم الناطق بالألمانية، وتحتل المرتبة 140 في QS 2026. تُدرَّس برامج البكالوريوس بالألمانية وتكلّف الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي نحو 753 يورو للفصل.

about.en:
The University of Vienna is Austria's largest university, with around 90,000 students spread across historic buildings in central Vienna. It covers nearly every academic field, from philosophy, history and linguistics to physics, mathematics, life sciences, psychology, business and law, with a strong research profile in the humanities and natural sciences.

International bachelor's applicants apply online in the semester's application period, have their school-leaving certificate checked for equivalence, and must reach German C1 before enrolment (A2 is enough to apply). Fees are very low by international standards, though student-visa holders must show proof of funds.

label.en: School-leaving certificate and transcripts (legalised/translated if required)
Proof of general university entrance qualification (country-specific requirements)
German A2 to apply, C1 before enrolment (English for English-taught programmes)
Entrance exam/aptitude test for restricted programmes
Proof of funds for the Austrian residence permit

gpa_note.en: Admission is open to holders of an equivalent university entrance qualification; restricted subjects select via entrance exams.

platform: Direct (NTHU international degree admission online application)
deadline_note: International degree-seeking students apply directly to the university for the Fall (September) intake; application windows for Taiwanese universities usually run from winter to early spring. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education/Foreign Affairs) and university scholarships for international degree students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).

summary.en: A top Taiwanese research university in Hsinchu, next to Taiwan's semiconductor science park, ranked 142nd by QS 2026. It is especially strong in electrical engineering, materials and physics.
summary.ka: ტაივანის წამყვანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი სინჩუში, ნახევარგამტარების სამეცნიერო პარკის გვერდით, QS 2026-ში 142-ე. განსაკუთრებით ძლიერია ელექტროინჟინერიაში, მასალათმცოდნეობასა და ფიზიკაში.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية تايوانية رائدة في هسينتشو بجوار مجمع أشباه الموصلات العلمي، تحتل المرتبة 142 في QS 2026، وتتميز خصوصاً في الهندسة الكهربائية والمواد والفيزياء.

about.en:
National Tsing Hua University was re-established in Taiwan in 1956 and sits beside the Hsinchu Science Park, home of TSMC. It is known for electrical engineering and semiconductors, materials science, physics, chemistry, nuclear science and computer science, and merged with National Hsinchu University of Education in 2016.

International degree students apply directly for September entry with transcripts, a study plan, recommendations and language proof (TOCFL for Chinese-taught, TOEFL/IELTS for English-taught programmes). Tuition is low by international standards and Taiwan Scholarships are available.

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: OUAC (Ontario Universities' Application Centre, 105 form)
deadline_note: Submit your OUAC application by 15 January 2027 for equal consideration for Fall 2027. Ivey AEO also due 15 January; National Scholarship applications 14 February 2027.

tuition_intl.note: International tuition varies by faculty; see Western's fee schedules.

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships for international students, including Western's National Scholarships and entrance awards; no need-based aid for most internationals.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required; international high-school curricula are assessed on grades (AP/IB considered). English for Fall 2027 (tests taken from 1 Jan 2025, before March 2027): IELTS Academic 6.5 with 6.0 in each section; TOEFL iBT 83 with 20 in each section; Duolingo 115. Lower scores can qualify for the English Boost Program.

summary.en: A research-intensive university in London, Ontario, ranked 142nd in the world by QS 2026 and known for its Ivey Business School and classic campus experience. International students apply through OUAC by 15 January 2027 and need IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 83.
summary.ka: კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ლონდონში (ონტარიო), QS 2026-ში მსოფლიოში 142-ე, ცნობილი Ivey ბიზნეს-სკოლით და კლასიკური კამპუსით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები OUAC-ით 2027 წლის 15 იანვრამდე აკეთებენ განაცხადს; საჭიროა IELTS 6.5 ან TOEFL 83.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية في لندن بمقاطعة أونتاريو، تحتل المرتبة 142 عالمياً في QS 2026 وتشتهر بكلية آيفي للأعمال وتجربة الحرم الجامعي الكلاسيكية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر OUAC حتى 15 يناير 2027 ويحتاجون IELTS 6.5 أو TOEFL 83.

about.en:
Western University is one of Canada's leading research universities, with a large, traditional campus in London, Ontario, guaranteed first-year residence and a strong student culture. It has 11 faculties and is best known for the Ivey Business School's HBA programme, medicine and health sciences, engineering, media studies and music.

International students apply through OUAC, are assessed on their high-school grades (SAT/ACT not required) and English proficiency (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 83 / Duolingo 115), and are considered for entrance and national scholarships. Many students pursue Ivey through Advanced Entry Opportunity status from first year.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.5, 6.0 per section / TOEFL iBT 83, 20 per section / Duolingo 115)
Ivey AEO application or programme supplements where required
Proof of funds for the Canadian study permit

gpa_note.en: Competitive high-school grades required; most programmes admit in the high-80s % range equivalent and above.

platform: UNAM admission exam (concurso de selección) or pase reglamentado
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Nominal tuition; UNAM scholarships are mainly for enrolled students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's entry for applicants from outside the UNAM high-school system is through UNAM's competitive admission exam; foreign certificates need revalidation. Teaching is in Spanish.

summary.en: Latin America's largest university and a UNESCO World Heritage campus in Mexico City, ranked 145th by QS 2026. Tuition is nominal, admission is via a competitive exam, and teaching is in Spanish.
summary.ka: ლათინური ამერიკის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი, იუნესკოს მსოფლიო მემკვიდრეობის კამპუსით მეხიკოში, QS 2026-ში 145-ე. სწავლის საფასური სიმბოლურია, მიღება კონკურენტული გამოცდით ხდება, სწავლება კი ესპანურადაა.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في أمريكا اللاتينية بحرم مدرج في التراث العالمي لليونسكو في مكسيكو سيتي، تحتل المرتبة 145 في QS 2026. الرسوم رمزية، والقبول عبر امتحان تنافسي، والتدريس بالإسبانية.

about.en:
UNAM, with roots in 1551 and refounded in 1910, enrols hundreds of thousands of students; its Ciudad Universitaria campus is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It covers almost every discipline and is especially influential in the humanities, social sciences, medicine, engineering, architecture and the sciences.

Applicants outside UNAM's own high-school system sit a competitive admission exam; foreign students must revalidate their secondary studies and study in Spanish. Tuition is nominal.

label.en: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.

summary.en: A leading Shanghai university, ranked 146th by QS 2026, famous for architecture, urban planning and civil engineering, with deep ties to Germany. International undergraduates mostly study in Chinese and must submit a CSCA report.
summary.ka: შანხაის წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 146-ე, ცნობილი არქიტექტურით, ქალაქგეგმარებითა და სამოქალაქო ინჟინერიით, გერმანიასთან მჭიდრო კავშირებით. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრები ძირითადად ჩინურად სწავლობენ და CSCA-ის ანგარიში სჭირდებათ.
summary.ar: جامعة رائدة في شنغهاي، تحتل المرتبة 146 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالعمارة والتخطيط العمراني والهندسة المدنية، ولها روابط عميقة مع ألمانيا. يدرس معظم طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين بالصينية ويجب عليهم تقديم تقرير CSCA.

about.en:
Tongji University was founded in 1907 by German physicians and keeps strong German links (including the Chinese-German College). It is one of the world's top schools for architecture and urban planning and for civil and transportation engineering, with additional strength in automotive engineering, environmental science and design.

International applicants apply online with school records, HSK (or English scores for the few English-taught options) and a CSCA report. CSC and Shanghai Government scholarships help with costs.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: Studielink plus programme-specific online application
deadline_note: Numerus fixus programmes such as International Business Administration (IBA): register in Studielink between 1 Oct 2026 and 15 Jan 2027 and complete the RSM online application by 31 Jan 2027. Non-fixus programmes have later deadlines (typically spring).

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA students pay the institutional fee, which varies by programme; EU/EEA students pay the statutory fee.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for non-EEA students (e.g. Holland Scholarship and Erasmus-specific awards).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English and mathematics minimums depend on your diploma type and are listed per programme. Numerus fixus programmes (e.g. IBA, 650 places) rank applicants by grades (75%) and motivation.

summary.en: A Rotterdam research university ranked 148th by QS 2026 and famous for its Rotterdam School of Management and economics. English-taught bachelor's like International Business Administration are selective numerus fixus programmes with a 15 January 2027 deadline.
summary.ka: როტერდამის კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 148-ე, ცნობილი როტერდამის მენეჯმენტის სკოლითა და ეკონომიკით. ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატი, მაგ. International Business Administration, შერჩევითი numerus fixus პროგრამაა, ვადით 2027 წლის 15 იანვარი.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية في روتردام تحتل المرتبة 148 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بكلية روتردام للإدارة والاقتصاد. برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية مثل إدارة الأعمال الدولية انتقائية بعدد مقاعد محدود وموعدها النهائي 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Erasmus University Rotterdam is a specialised research university focused on business, economics, law, medicine, social sciences, history and philosophy. Its Rotterdam School of Management (RSM) and Erasmus School of Economics are among Europe's best known, and the Erasmus MC medical centre is one of the largest in the Netherlands.

International bachelor's options include International Business Administration, International Bachelor in Economics and Business Economics, econometrics, communication and media, psychology and liberal arts at Erasmus University College. Numerus fixus programmes require Studielink registration by 15 January and select by grades and motivation.

label.en: Secondary school diploma (meeting the programme's diploma requirements)
English proficiency as required for your diploma type
Motivation questions in the programme application
Studielink registration and programme online application form

gpa_note.en: For IBA, grades count 75% of selection points; high averages and strong maths are needed.

en: International Bachelor Economics and Business Economics
Liberal Arts and Sciences (Erasmus University College)

platform: Direct (UGent online application, with Qualification Check verification of diplomas)
deadline_note: Students who need a visa: online application October – March, submit before 1 April 2027. Students who don't need a visa: October – May. Programmes with their own procedures (e.g. medicine entrance exam) have separate deadlines.

tuition_intl.note: Flemish public tuition; non-EEA students pay a higher rate set annually by UGent.

aid_intl.en: Very limited for bachelor's students; most UGent scholarships target master's and PhD students from developing countries.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. All UGent bachelor's programmes are taught in Dutch, and you need Dutch at B2 on enrolment (C1 for Applied Language Studies). Medicine, dentistry and veterinary medicine require passing the Flemish inter-university entrance exam with a favourable ranking; some programmes require a positioning test.

summary.en: One of Belgium's largest research universities, in Flanders and ranked 150th by QS 2026, strong in life sciences, veterinary medicine and engineering. All its bachelor's degrees are taught in Dutch, so international students need B2 Dutch.
summary.ka: ბელგიის ერთ-ერთი უდიდესი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ფლანდრიაში, QS 2026-ში 150-ე, ძლიერი სიცოცხლის მეცნიერებებში, ვეტერინარიასა და ინჟინერიაში. ყველა ბაკალავრიატი ნიდერლანდურ ენაზეა, ამიტომ საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს B2 დონე სჭირდებათ.
summary.ar: إحدى أكبر الجامعات البحثية في بلجيكا، في إقليم فلاندرز وتحتل المرتبة 150 في QS 2026، وتتميز في علوم الحياة والطب البيطري والهندسة. تُدرَّس جميع برامج البكالوريوس بالهولندية، لذا يحتاج الطلاب الدوليون مستوى B2 فيها.

about.en:
Founded in 1817, Ghent University is a large Flemish public university with eleven faculties spread across the historic city of Ghent. It is internationally recognised for veterinary medicine, bioscience engineering, agriculture, pharmacy, medicine and engineering, and has a growing number of English-taught master's programmes.

At bachelor's level, however, every programme is taught in Dutch. International applicants apply online with a verified diploma, must show Dutch at B2 upon enrolment, and those needing a visa must apply before 1 April. Medicine-related degrees require the Flemish entrance exam.

label.en: Secondary school diploma verified through Qualification Check
Dutch B2 certificate (C1 for Applied Language Studies)
Flemish entrance exam for medicine/dentistry/veterinary medicine
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa

gpa_note.en: Open admission for holders of a recognised secondary diploma (plus proof of acceptance at a university at home for some countries); medicine is selective via the entrance exam.

platform: Direct (University of Basel online application)
deadline_note: Bachelor's applications for foreign-qualification holders have published deadlines for the fall and spring semesters on the university's Application Deadlines page; Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Few bachelor's-level scholarships for international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's teaching is mainly in German, so German proficiency is required. Foreign school-leaving certificates must meet Swiss recognition criteria (IB Diploma and European Baccalaureate have specific rules). Medicine requires the Swiss aptitude test.

summary.en: Switzerland's oldest university (1460), in Basel's life-sciences hub, ranked 150th by QS 2026 and strong in pharmacy, biomedicine and nanoscience. Bachelor's study is mainly in German.
summary.ka: შვეიცარიის უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი (1460), ბაზელის სიცოცხლის მეცნიერებების ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში 150-ე, ძლიერი ფარმაციაში, ბიომედიცინასა და ნანომეცნიერებაში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة في سويسرا (1460)، في مركز علوم الحياة ببازل، تحتل المرتبة 150 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الصيدلة والطب الحيوي وعلوم النانو. الدراسة في البكالوريوس بالألمانية أساساً.

about.en:
The University of Basel was founded in 1460 and is closely connected to Basel's pharmaceutical industry (Roche, Novartis). It is known for the Biozentrum life-sciences institute, pharmaceutical sciences, medicine, nanoscience, economics and the humanities.

Applicants with foreign qualifications must meet Swiss recognition criteria and show German proficiency for most bachelor's programmes; medicine requires the national aptitude test.

label.en: Secondary school-leaving certificate meeting Swiss recognition criteria (some need an extra exam)
Proof of proficiency in the teaching language (German/French)
Proof of funds for the Swiss residence permit

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (Hanyang international freshman admission)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Admission and merit scholarships for international students plus the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may support an application). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4+); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.

summary.en: A private Seoul university, ranked 155th by QS 2026, known for engineering and for producing many Korean entrepreneurs and CEOs. International students apply in spring and fall rounds with TOPIK or English scores.
summary.ka: კერძო სეულის უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 155-ე, ცნობილი ინჟინერიით და მრავალი კორეელი მეწარმისა და აღმასრულებელი დირექტორის აღზრდით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები გაზაფხულისა და შემოდგომის რაუნდებში TOPIK-ით ან ინგლისურის ქულებით აკეთებენ განაცხადს.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة في سيول تحتل المرتبة 155 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالهندسة وبتخريج كثير من رواد الأعمال والرؤساء التنفيذيين الكوريين. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون في جولتي الربيع والخريف بدرجات TOPIK أو الإنجليزية.

about.en:
Hanyang University, founded in 1939, has its main campus in Seoul and the ERICA campus in Ansan. It built its reputation on engineering and architecture and is also strong in business, entrepreneurship, music and performing arts, with many alumni leading Korean companies.

International freshmen apply for March or September entry with school records, a study plan and TOPIK or English scores; scholarships are offered to strong applicants.

label.en: Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Bank statement for the D-2 visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (G30 International Programs online application); Japanese-taught programmes via school-specific exams
deadline_note: G30 English-taught undergraduate programmes start each October; application rounds and dates are announced on admissions.g30.nagoya-u.ac.jp (not confirmed for 2027 at time of checking).

tuition_intl.note: Undergraduate tuition ¥267,900 per semester (national-university rate, same for international students); admission fee extra; exemptions available.

aid_intl.en: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition/admission-fee exemptions for international students.

tests.en: G30 International Programs (English-taught) are selective and use document screening with standardized test results and English proficiency; exact minimums are set in the G30 application guidelines. Japanese-taught programmes require Japanese fluency and the EJU/school-specific exams.

summary.en: A former imperial university in central Japan, ranked 156th by QS 2026, linked to six Nobel laureates in science and close to the Toyota industrial region. Its G30 International Programs offer English-taught bachelor's degrees starting each October.
summary.ka: ყოფილი იმპერიული უნივერსიტეტი ცენტრალურ იაპონიაში, QS 2026-ში 156-ე, რომელიც დაკავშირებულია ექვს ნობელიანტთან მეცნიერებაში და ახლოსაა Toyota-ს სამრეწველო რეგიონთან. G30 საერთაშორისო პროგრამები ყოველ ოქტომბერს იწყება და ინგლისურენოვან ბაკალავრიატს გთავაზობს.
summary.ar: جامعة إمبراطورية سابقة في وسط اليابان، تحتل المرتبة 156 في QS 2026، ويرتبط بها ستة من حائزي نوبل في العلوم، وتقع قرب منطقة تويوتا الصناعية. تقدم برامج G30 الدولية درجات بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية تبدأ كل أكتوبر.

about.en:
Nagoya University is one of Japan's seven former imperial universities, with its main Higashiyama campus in Nagoya. It is especially strong in physics, chemistry, biology, engineering (including automotive and aerospace, given the Toyota-centred Chubu economy), agriculture and medicine.

Since 2011 its G30 International Programs have offered full English-taught bachelor's degrees in fields such as automotive engineering, physics, chemistry, biological science, social sciences and Japanese culture, starting in October with Japanese-language training. Tuition is the low national-university rate, and MEXT and university scholarships plus fee exemptions help further.

label.en: Secondary school diploma (12 years of schooling)
Standardized test results as specified by G30 (e.g. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level)

gpa_note.en: Selective document review; strong maths and science results expected for science/engineering tracks.

platform: uni-assist / TU Berlin application portal
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees; students pay only the semester contribution (covering administration, student services and usually a public-transport ticket).

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: Berlin's large technical university, ranked 158th by QS 2026, strong in engineering, computer science and architecture. Bachelor's programmes are mainly German-taught and tuition-free.
summary.ka: ბერლინის დიდი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 158-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებასა და არქიტექტურაში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: الجامعة التقنية الكبيرة في برلين، تحتل المرتبة 158 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الهندسة وعلوم الحاسوب والعمارة. برامج البكالوريوس بالألمانية أساساً ومجانية.

about.en:
TU Berlin traces its roots to 1770 and has its main campus in Charlottenburg. It is one of Germany's leading technical universities, with strengths in mechanical, electrical, civil and process engineering, computer science, architecture, urban planning and industrial engineering, and close ties to Berlin's startup scene.

International applicants usually apply via uni-assist and need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes; there are no tuition fees, only a semester contribution.

label.en: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

gpa_note.en: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

platform: Direct (UTM international undergraduate application)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for international undergraduates; most are self-funded or government-sponsored.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement; admission is based on pre-university results (A-levels, IB, foundation or equivalent). International applicants must show English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/MUET or equivalent) at the level set by the university and programme; minimum scores not verified. UTM offers an English preparatory route for applicants below the requirement.

summary.en: Malaysia's leading engineering and technology university, in Johor Bahru near Singapore and ranked 158th by QS 2026. Engineering, computing and built environment are its core strengths.
summary.ka: მალაიზიის წამყვანი საინჟინრო და ტექნოლოგიური უნივერსიტეტი ჯოჰორ-ბაჰრუში, სინგაპურთან ახლოს, QS 2026-ში 158-ე. ძირითადი ძლიერი მხარეებია ინჟინერია, კომპიუტინგი და სამშენებლო გარემო.
summary.ar: الجامعة الماليزية الرائدة في الهندسة والتكنولوجيا، في جوهور بهرو قرب سنغافورة وتحتل المرتبة 158 في QS 2026. الهندسة والحوسبة والبيئة العمرانية هي نقاط قوتها الأساسية.

about.en:
Universiti Teknologi Malaysia traces its roots to 1904 and has its main campus in Skudai, Johor Bahru, plus a Kuala Lumpur campus. It specialises in civil, mechanical, electrical and chemical engineering, computing, architecture and built environment, and science.

International undergraduates apply through UTM's international admission portal with pre-university results and English proficiency (an English preparatory form exists for those below the requirement). Living costs are low, and Singapore is a short trip away.

label.en: Documents for the Malaysian student pass (EMGS)

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name.en: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
name.ar: جامعة نورث كارولاينا في تشابل هيل

platform: Common App
deadline_note: Early Action deadline 15 Oct 2026 has passed; Regular Decision deadline 15 Jan 2027.

tuition_intl.note: 2026-27 out-of-state tuition (Common Data Set) plus about $1,978 required fees; housing and food extra. Application fee $85.

aid_intl.en: No need-based aid for students without US citizenship or permanent residency; a few merit scholarships are open to all applicants.

tests.en: SAT/ACT optional for applicants with a weighted GPA of 2.8+ (otherwise SAT 930+/ACT 17+ required). Middle 50% of enrolled first-years (CDS 2025-26): SAT 1400–1530, ACT 29–34. English proficiency: TOEFL, IELTS, Duolingo or Cambridge C1/C2 accepted (waivable after four years in an English-speaking country); no minimum published.

summary.en: America's first public university, ranked 158th by QS 2026, combining a liberal-arts college feel with top programmes in public health, business and journalism. Admission for out-of-state and international students is very selective, with a 15 January 2027 Regular Decision deadline.
summary.ka: ამერიკის პირველი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 158-ე, რომელიც ლიბერალური ხელოვნების კოლეჯის ატმოსფეროს აერთიანებს საზოგადოებრივ ჯანდაცვაში, ბიზნესსა და ჟურნალისტიკაში წამყვან პროგრამებთან. შტატის გარეთა და საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების მიღება ძალიან შერჩევითია; Regular Decision-ის ვადაა 2027 წლის 15 იანვარი.
summary.ar: أول جامعة حكومية في أمريكا، تحتل المرتبة 158 في QS 2026، وتجمع بين أجواء كلية الفنون الحرة وبرامج رائدة في الصحة العامة والأعمال والصحافة. القبول لطلاب خارج الولاية والطلاب الدوليين انتقائي جداً، والموعد النهائي للقرار العادي 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Chartered in 1789, UNC-Chapel Hill is the flagship of the University of North Carolina system, set in a classic college town within the Research Triangle. It is renowned for its Gillings School of Global Public Health, Kenan-Flagler Business School, Hussman School of Journalism and Media, and strong sciences, and North Carolina law caps out-of-state students at a small share of each class.

International students apply via the Common App with essays, a counselor recommendation and English test results; SAT/ACT are optional for most. Internationals are not eligible for need-based aid and must budget for the full non-resident cost, but a handful of merit scholarships (such as Morehead-Cain) are open to them.

label.en: Completion of the pre-university curriculum (e.g. A-levels, Baccalaureate)
Common App essay and UNC short-answer questions
Proof of funds for the F-1 visa after admission

gpa_note.en: Most admitted students are at the very top of their class with rigorous coursework (AP/IB/A-levels).

platform: Catalan pre-enrolment (preinscripció universitària) after university-access accreditation
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Spanish/Catalan public grants (mostly for residents) and some UB scholarships.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. International applicants need their school-leaving qualification recognised for Spanish university access (e.g. UNEDasiss accreditation, sometimes with PCE specific-competence exams for admission grades) and then apply via Catalonia's pre-enrolment. Most teaching is in Catalan or Spanish.

summary.en: Catalonia's largest and oldest public university, in central Barcelona and ranked 165th by QS 2026, strong in health sciences and humanities. Bachelor's teaching is mainly in Catalan and Spanish.
summary.ka: კატალონიის უდიდესი და უძველესი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი ბარსელონას ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში 165-ე, ძლიერი ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებსა და ჰუმანიტარულ დარგებში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად კატალანურ და ესპანურ ენებზეა.
summary.ar: أكبر وأقدم جامعة حكومية في كتالونيا، في وسط برشلونة وتحتل المرتبة 165 في QS 2026، وتتميز في العلوم الصحية والإنسانيات. التدريس في البكالوريوس بالكتالانية والإسبانية أساساً.

about.en:
Founded in 1450, the University of Barcelona is a large public university with faculties across the city, including the historic building on Plaça Universitat and the Diagonal campus. It is strong in medicine, biology, pharmacy, psychology, economics and business, and the humanities.

International applicants must obtain Spanish university-access recognition (often via UNEDasiss) and then pre-enrol through Catalonia's central system. Public fees are moderate, and most bachelor's degrees are taught in Catalan or Spanish.

label.en: Secondary school diploma with recognition/homologation or UNEDasiss accreditation
Spanish university-entrance route (UNEDasiss accreditation / PCE specific-competence exams) where required
Proof of funds for the Spanish student visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Undergraduate: RMB 20,000/yr humanities, 24,000 science and engineering, 30,000 medicine/stomatology, 23,000 English-medium; application fee RMB 800 (USD 111).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: All international undergraduate applicants must take the CSCA (required by Wuhan University from 2026; used for admission and scholarships). Chinese-taught programmes: new HSK 4 with 180+. English-taught programmes: TOEFL 80+, TOEFL Essentials 8+ or IELTS 6.0+ (exemptions for native speakers or English-medium degrees). SAT/ACT not required.

summary.en: One of China's most beautiful and prestigious universities, on Luojia Hill in Wuhan, ranked 165th by QS 2026 and world-leading in surveying and remote sensing. International applicants need a CSCA report plus HSK 4 (180+) or IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80 for English-taught programmes.
summary.ka: ჩინეთის ერთ-ერთი ყველაზე ლამაზი და პრესტიჟული უნივერსიტეტი ლოძია-შანის ბორცვზე, ვუხანში, QS 2026-ში 165-ე, მსოფლიოში წამყვანი გეოდეზიასა და დისტანციურ ზონდირებაში. საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტებს სჭირდებათ CSCA-ის ანგარიში და HSK 4 (180+) ან ინგლისურენოვან პროგრამებზე IELTS 6.0/TOEFL 80.
summary.ar: من أجمل الجامعات الصينية وأعرقها، على تلة لوجيا في ووهان، تحتل المرتبة 165 في QS 2026 وتتصدر عالمياً في المساحة والاستشعار عن بعد. يحتاج المتقدمون الدوليون إلى تقرير CSCA مع HSK 4 (180 فأكثر) أو IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 للبرامج الإنجليزية.

about.en:
Wuhan University, founded in 1893, is a comprehensive research university famous for its cherry-blossom campus on the shores of East Lake. It leads globally in surveying, mapping and remote sensing, and is also strong in law, Chinese literature and history, economics and management, and medicine.

International undergraduates apply through the School of International Education with school records, a CSCA report and HSK 4 (180+) for Chinese-taught programmes or TOEFL 80/IELTS 6.0 for English-taught ones. 2026 tuition is RMB 20,000–30,000 a year, and CSC and university scholarships are available.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se)
deadline_note: Autumn 2027 first admissions round (for international students) via University Admissions in Sweden: opens 16 Oct 2026, apply and rank programmes by 15 Jan 2027; application fee, fee-exemption proof and supporting documents due 1 Feb 2027; bachelor's results 8 Apr 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries and Switzerland pay tuition (set per programme) plus a SEK 900 application fee; EU/EEA students study free.

aid_intl.en: Few or no bachelor's-level scholarships; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master's students. Some universities offer partial tuition waivers to fee-paying students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply.

summary.en: Sweden's largest university in the capital, ranked 167th by QS 2026, strong in social sciences, law and environmental and natural sciences. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in Swedish, and international applicants use the national round closing 15 January 2027.
summary.ka: შვედეთის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი დედაქალაქში, QS 2026-ში 167-ე, ძლიერი სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში, სამართალსა და გარემოსა და საბუნებისმეტყველო მეცნიერებებში. ბაკალავრიატის უმეტესობა შვედურადაა, საერთაშორისო აპლიკანტები კი ეროვნული რაუნდით აკეთებენ განაცხადს, რომელიც 2027 წლის 15 იანვარს იხურება.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في السويد وتقع في العاصمة، تحتل المرتبة 167 في QS 2026 وتتميز في العلوم الاجتماعية والقانون والعلوم البيئية والطبيعية. تُدرَّس معظم برامج البكالوريوس بالسويدية، ويتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر الجولة الوطنية التي تُغلق في 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Stockholm University, founded in 1878, has its main Frescati campus in the Royal National City Park in northern Stockholm. It is a broad research university known for the social sciences (economics, political science, criminology), law, the Stockholm Resilience Centre, and natural sciences including physics, astronomy and environmental science.

Most bachelor's programmes are in Swedish; English-taught options at bachelor's level are limited, while the master's offer is large. International applicants apply via universityadmissions.se in the first round (deadline 15 January) with transcripts, proof of English 6 and, for non-EU/EEA citizens, the application fee and later tuition.

label.en: English 6 (e.g. IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90) or Swedish 3, depending on the programme
Proof of funds for the Swedish residence permit

gpa_note.en: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.

platform: Direct (UNIGE online application)
deadline_note: Bachelor's applications for the autumn semester are typically due in late winter/spring (earlier for applicants needing a visa); Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Limited bachelor's-level support; some UNIGE and Geneva-based scholarships exist, mainly for master's students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught in French, so French proficiency is required (a French exam may be set for applicants without certified B2/C1). Foreign certificates must meet Swiss recognition criteria. Medicine requires the Swiss aptitude test.

summary.en: A historic French-speaking university in international Geneva, ranked 168th by QS 2026, strong in international relations, law, physics and translation. Bachelor's teaching is in French.
summary.ka: ისტორიული ფრანგულენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი საერთაშორისო ჟენევაში, QS 2026-ში 168-ე, ძლიერი საერთაშორისო ურთიერთობებში, სამართალში, ფიზიკასა და თარგმანში. ბაკალავრიატი ფრანგულადაა.
summary.ar: جامعة تاريخية ناطقة بالفرنسية في جنيف الدولية، تحتل المرتبة 168 في QS 2026، وتتميز في العلاقات الدولية والقانون والفيزياء والترجمة. التدريس في البكالوريوس بالفرنسية.

about.en:
Founded by John Calvin in 1559, the University of Geneva sits in a city full of UN agencies and NGOs, giving it special strength in international relations, international law, human rights and translation and interpreting. It is also a leader in physics and astronomy (including exoplanet discovery and CERN collaboration) and medicine.

International bachelor's applicants apply online, must meet Swiss recognition criteria for their diploma and demonstrate French proficiency. Tuition is low by international standards.

label.en: Secondary school-leaving certificate meeting Swiss recognition criteria (some need an extra exam)
Proof of proficiency in the teaching language (German/French)
Proof of funds for the Swiss residence permit

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: ApplyTexas or Common App
deadline_note: Fall 2027 freshman application deadline is 1 December 2026 (College Station, Galveston, McAllen); additional documents due 15 December 2026. International and domestic timelines are the same.

tuition_intl.note: Non-resident tuition varies by college; see Texas A&M's cost of attendance.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for international students; no need-based federal aid.

tests.en: Test optional: SAT/ACT not required for freshman applicants (scores may be sent). English proficiency: TOEFL iBT 80 (tests before 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 with 4.0 per skill on the new scale; IELTS Academic 6.0; TOEFL Essentials 8.5; or SAT EBRW 560 / ACT English 21. MyBest scores not accepted.

summary.en: One of the largest US universities, in College Station, Texas, ranked 169th by QS 2026 and renowned for engineering, agriculture and veterinary medicine. It is test optional, needs IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 80, and the Fall 2027 deadline is 1 December 2026.
summary.ka: აშშ-ის ერთ-ერთი უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი კოლეჯ-სტეიშენში (ტეხასი), QS 2026-ში 169-ე, ცნობილი ინჟინერიით, აგრარული მეცნიერებითა და ვეტერინარიით. ტესტები არჩევითია, საჭიროა IELTS 6.0 ან TOEFL 80; 2027 წლის შემოდგომის ვადაა 2026 წლის 1 დეკემბერი.
summary.ar: إحدى أكبر الجامعات الأمريكية، في كوليج ستيشن بتكساس، تحتل المرتبة 169 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بالهندسة والزراعة والطب البيطري. الاختبارات اختيارية، وتشترط IELTS 6.0 أو TOEFL 80، والموعد النهائي لخريف 2027 هو 1 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Texas A&M is a flagship land-grant, sea-grant and space-grant university with more than 70,000 students and a famously strong campus culture (the Aggie traditions and Corps of Cadets). It has one of the largest engineering colleges in the US, top programmes in agriculture, veterinary medicine and petroleum engineering, and branch campuses in Galveston, McAllen and Qatar.

International freshmen apply through ApplyTexas or the Common App with transcripts, essays and proof of English (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 80 or SAT/ACT English sections). Testing is optional, and the main Fall deadline is 1 December. Aid for internationals is limited to some merit scholarships.

label.en: Required essay (e.g. a life event that prepared you for college)
English proficiency (IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80 / SAT EBRW 560 / ACT English 21)
Financial documentation for the I-20/F-1 visa

gpa_note.en: Holistic review of academic record and essays; Texas top-6% students are auto-admitted, international applicants compete for remaining places.

name.ar: المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا في مدراس (IIT Madras)

platform: JEE (Advanced) + JoSAA counselling
deadline_note: JEE (Advanced) 2027 registration dates are announced on jeeadv.ac.in (in 2026, JoSAA allotment rounds ran through July). Foreign nationals register directly for JEE (Advanced); watch for the 2027 information brochure.

tuition_intl.note: Foreign nationals pay a higher tuition rate set by the IIT; see the institute's fee page/JoSAA business rules.

aid_intl.en: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.

summary.en: Ranked first in India's national rankings for years and 170th by QS 2026, IIT Madras in Chennai is known for engineering, research parks and an online B.S. in Data Science. Campus B.Tech admission is via JEE (Advanced).
summary.ka: წლების განმავლობაში ინდოეთის ეროვნულ რეიტინგში პირველი და QS 2026-ში 170-ე, IIT Madras ჩენაიში ცნობილია ინჟინერიით, კვლევითი პარკებითა და ონლაინ B.S. მონაცემთა მეცნიერებაში. კამპუსის B.Tech-ზე მიღება JEE (Advanced)-ით ხდება.
summary.ar: تصدّر المعهد التصنيفات الوطنية الهندية لسنوات ويحتل المرتبة 170 في QS 2026، ويشتهر IIT Madras في تشيناي بالهندسة ومجمعات البحث وبرنامج بكالوريوس علوم البيانات عبر الإنترنت. القبول في B.Tech بالحرم عبر JEE (Advanced).

about.en:
IIT Madras, founded in 1959 with West German assistance, has a forested campus in Chennai and the IIT Madras Research Park, a hub for deep-tech startups. It is strong across engineering, computer science, ocean and aerospace engineering, and runs a large online B.S. in Data Science and Applications open to students regardless of JEE.

On-campus B.Tech admission is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA, with foreign nationals able to take JEE (Advanced) directly. The institute has also opened an international campus in Zanzibar.

label.en: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

gpa_note.en: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

en: B.S. in Data Science and Applications

platform: Direct (Kyushu University admissions; International Undergraduate Programs / IUP for English-taught tracks)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition exemptions for international students.

tests.en: Japanese-taught degrees for privately financed international students require the EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission) and Japanese proficiency, plus university-specific exams/interviews. English-taught undergraduate programmes (where offered) use document screening with standardized test results and English proficiency. No SAT/ACT requirement for Japanese-taught tracks.

summary.en: A former imperial university in Fukuoka, ranked 171st by QS 2026, strong in engineering, agriculture and energy research. It offers English-taught undergraduate programmes alongside Japanese-taught degrees.
summary.ka: ყოფილი იმპერიული უნივერსიტეტი ფუკუოკაში, QS 2026-ში 171-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, აგრარულ დარგებსა და ენერგეტიკის კვლევაში. იაპონურენოვან ხარისხებთან ერთად ინგლისურენოვან საბაკალავრო პროგრამებსაც გთავაზობს.
summary.ar: جامعة إمبراطورية سابقة في فوكوكا، تحتل المرتبة 171 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الهندسة والزراعة وأبحاث الطاقة. تقدم برامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية إلى جانب الدرجات باليابانية.

about.en:
Kyushu University, founded in 1911, is the leading research university of western Japan, with its main Ito campus in Fukuoka. It is known for engineering (including hydrogen and energy research), agriculture, medicine, dentistry, economics and design.

International students can enter through English-taught International Undergraduate Programs (e.g. in engineering, agriculture and the School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation) or through Japanese-taught degrees requiring the EJU. Tuition follows the low national-university rate.

label.en: Japanese proficiency or English test (English-taught programmes)

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

en: International Undergraduate Program in Bioresource and Bioenvironment

platform: University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se)
deadline_note: Autumn 2027 first admissions round (for international students) via University Admissions in Sweden: opens 16 Oct 2026, apply and rank programmes by 15 Jan 2027; application fee, fee-exemption proof and supporting documents due 1 Feb 2027; bachelor's results 8 Apr 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries and Switzerland pay tuition (set per programme) plus a SEK 900 application fee; EU/EEA students study free.

aid_intl.en: Few or no bachelor's-level scholarships; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master's students. Some universities offer partial tuition waivers to fee-paying students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply. Swedish-taught engineering programmes also require Swedish 3 plus advanced maths, physics and chemistry.

summary.en: One of Sweden's two leading technical universities, in Gothenburg and ranked 174th by QS 2026, with strong links to industry such as Volvo and Ericsson. Its bachelor's-level engineering programmes are taught almost entirely in Swedish.
summary.ka: შვედეთის ორი წამყვანი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტიდან ერთ-ერთი, გოთენბურგში, QS 2026-ში 174-ე, მჭიდრო კავშირებით ინდუსტრიასთან (Volvo, Ericsson). საბაკალავრო საინჟინრო პროგრამები თითქმის მთლიანად შვედურ ენაზეა.
summary.ar: إحدى الجامعتين التقنيتين الرائدتين في السويد، في غوتنبرغ وتحتل المرتبة 174 في QS 2026، ولها روابط قوية بالصناعة مثل فولفو وإريكسون. تُدرَّس برامج الهندسة على مستوى البكالوريوس بالكامل تقريباً بالسويدية.

about.en:
Chalmers is a private foundation university (state-funded) founded in 1829, with Johanneberg and Lindholmen campuses in Gothenburg. It is known for engineering, architecture, materials, energy, transport and ICT research, and for close collaboration with Swedish industry.

Undergraduate engineering degrees (civilingenjör and högskoleingenjör) are taught in Swedish, so international students without Swedish usually join at master's level, where most teaching is in English. Applications go through universityadmissions.se, with the international round closing on 15 January.

label.en: English 6 (e.g. IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90) or Swedish 3, depending on the programme
Proof of funds for the Swedish residence permit

gpa_note.en: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.

platform: UCAS (Queen's Portal for direct-only international applicants, not for medicine/dentistry/nursing/pharmacy/social work)
deadline_note: Queen's UCAS deadline for international students is 30 June 2027; Medicine and Dentistry applicants had to apply by 15 October 2026. Apply earlier for popular courses and visa time.

tuition_intl.note: International students first enrolling in 2027/28: £24,600 (classroom-based), £28,500 (laboratory), £39,990 (pre-clinical); some Queen's Business School courses differ.

aid_intl.en: Merit-based international scholarships (partial tuition discounts) for undergraduate entrants; no need-based aid.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (US applicants may use SAT/AP for entry). English: IELTS Academic 6.0 with at least 5.5 in each component for most degrees (6.5 for some courses); TOEFL iBT accepted. Medicine and Dentistry require the UCAT.

summary.en: A Russell Group university in Belfast, Northern Ireland, ranked 174th by QS 2026, with strong medicine, law, engineering and cybersecurity. International students apply via UCAS by 30 June 2027 (medicine by 15 October 2026) and need IELTS 6.0 for most courses.
summary.ka: Russell Group-ის უნივერსიტეტი ბელფასტში (ჩრდილოეთ ირლანდია), QS 2026-ში 174-ე, ძლიერი მედიცინით, სამართლით, ინჟინერიითა და კიბერუსაფრთხოებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები UCAS-ით 2027 წლის 30 ივნისამდე აკეთებენ განაცხადს (მედიცინაზე 2026 წლის 15 ოქტომბრამდე); კურსების უმეტესობას IELTS 6.0 სჭირდება.
summary.ar: جامعة من مجموعة راسل في بلفاست بأيرلندا الشمالية، تحتل المرتبة 174 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الطب والقانون والهندسة والأمن السيبراني. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر UCAS حتى 30 يونيو 2027 (الطب حتى 15 أكتوبر 2026) وتحتاج معظم البرامج IELTS 6.0.

about.en:
Founded in 1845, Queen's University Belfast is Northern Ireland's leading research university and a member of the Russell Group. Its campus in south Belfast hosts faculties of medicine, health and life sciences, engineering and physical sciences, and arts, humanities and social sciences, with notable strength in cybersecurity (CSIT), pharmacy and law.

International undergraduates apply through UCAS (Q75) with predicted grades, a personal statement and a reference; medicine and dentistry need the UCAT and an earlier October deadline. 2027/28 international fees start at £24,600, and merit scholarships reduce tuition for many entrants.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.0, min 5.5 per component, or course-specific)
Proof of funds for the UK Student visa (CAS)

gpa_note.en: Typical offers range from ABB to A*AA at A-level (or IB equivalents) depending on the course.

platform: Direct (KazNU international admission)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Kazakh government grants and university scholarships for some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Kazakh applicants use the national UNT; international applicants are admitted through the university's own procedure (interview/entrance testing). Programmes are taught in Kazakh, Russian and, increasingly, English.

summary.en: Kazakhstan's leading classical university, in Almaty and ranked 177th by QS 2026, with programmes in Kazakh, Russian and English. It is strong in sciences, international relations and economics.
summary.ka: ყაზახეთის წამყვანი კლასიკური უნივერსიტეტი ალმათიში, QS 2026-ში 177-ე, პროგრამებით ყაზახურ, რუსულ და ინგლისურ ენებზე. ძლიერია მეცნიერებებში, საერთაშორისო ურთიერთობებსა და ეკონომიკაში.
summary.ar: الجامعة الكلاسيكية الرائدة في كازاخستان، في ألماتي وتحتل المرتبة 177 في QS 2026، ببرامج بالكازاخية والروسية والإنجليزية. تتميز في العلوم والعلاقات الدولية والاقتصاد.

about.en:
Al-Farabi Kazakh National University (KazNU), founded in 1934, has a large campus in Almaty and is Kazakhstan's largest university. It covers natural sciences, mathematics, international relations, journalism, law, economics, philology and biotechnology, and hosts many students from Central Asia and beyond.

International students apply directly to the university, with programmes available in Kazakh, Russian and English; fees and living costs are low compared with Europe.

label.en: Secondary school diploma with recognition in Kazakhstan
Proof of proficiency in the programme language

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name.en: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU)
name.ka: იან მინ ჩიაო ტუნის ეროვნული უნივერსიტეტი (NYCU)
name.ar: جامعة يانغ مينغ تشياو تونغ الوطنية (NYCU)

platform: Direct (NYCU international degree admission online application)
deadline_note: International degree-seeking students apply directly to the university for the Fall (September) intake; application windows for Taiwanese universities usually run from winter to early spring. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education/Foreign Affairs) and university scholarships for international degree students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).

summary.en: Formed in 2021 by merging National Chiao Tung and National Yang-Ming universities, NYCU is ranked 177th by QS 2026 and combines top semiconductor and ICT engineering with medicine. International students apply directly for September entry.
summary.ka: 2021 წელს ჩიაო ტუნისა და იან მინის უნივერსიტეტების შერწყმით შექმნილი NYCU QS 2026-ში 177-ეა და აერთიანებს წამყვან ნახევარგამტარულ და ICT ინჟინერიას მედიცინასთან. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები სექტემბრის ნაკადზე პირდაპირ აკეთებენ განაცხადს.
summary.ar: تأسست NYCU عام 2021 بدمج جامعتي تشياو تونغ ويانغ مينغ الوطنيتين، وتحتل المرتبة 177 في QS 2026، وتجمع بين هندسة أشباه الموصلات وتقنية المعلومات الرائدة والطب. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة للالتحاق في سبتمبر.

about.en:
NYCU has campuses in Hsinchu (former Chiao Tung, strong in electronics, computer science, photonics and management) and Taipei (former Yang-Ming, strong in medicine, dentistry and life sciences), plus a Tainan campus. Its alumni underpin Taiwan's semiconductor and electronics industries.

International degree students apply online for September entry with transcripts, study plan, recommendations and TOCFL or TOEFL/IELTS depending on the programme language. Taiwan Scholarships and university awards are available.

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: UCAS
deadline_note: UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time (medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses: 15 Oct 2026, now passed). Later applications are considered only if places remain; final UCAS date 23 Sept 2027.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by course (listed on each course page).

aid_intl.en: Merit-based international scholarships (partial tuition discounts) for undergraduate entrants.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general (US applicants may use SAT/AP). English: GCSE English C/4 or IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each skill (One Skill Retake accepted, IELTS Online not accepted); PTE Academic 69 is equivalent. Some courses ask for more. Medicine and dentistry require the UCAT.

summary.en: Wales's leading Russell Group university in the capital Cardiff, ranked 179th by QS 2026, known for journalism, medicine, architecture and psychology. International students apply via UCAS by 13 January 2027 and usually need IELTS 6.5 (5.5 per skill).
summary.ka: უელსის წამყვანი Russell Group-ის უნივერსიტეტი დედაქალაქ კარდიფში, QS 2026-ში 179-ე, ცნობილი ჟურნალისტიკით, მედიცინით, არქიტექტურითა და ფსიქოლოგიით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები UCAS-ით 2027 წლის 13 იანვრამდე აკეთებენ განაცხადს და ჩვეულებრივ სჭირდებათ IELTS 6.5 (თითო უნარში 5.5).
summary.ar: الجامعة الرائدة في ويلز ضمن مجموعة راسل في العاصمة كارديف، تحتل المرتبة 179 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالصحافة والطب والعمارة وعلم النفس. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر UCAS حتى 13 يناير 2027 ويحتاجون عادة IELTS 6.5 (5.5 لكل مهارة).

about.en:
Founded in 1883, Cardiff University is a member of the Russell Group with a civic campus around Cathays Park in central Cardiff and a large medical campus at the University Hospital of Wales. It is known for its School of Journalism, Media and Culture, medicine, dentistry and healthcare, architecture (Welsh School of Architecture), psychology, and engineering.

International undergraduates apply through UCAS with predicted grades, a personal statement and a reference. The standard English requirement is IELTS 6.5 with 5.5 in each skill, and medicine and dentistry need the UCAT and an October deadline.

label.en: English test (IELTS 6.5, min 5.5 per skill / PTE 69)
Proof of funds for the UK Student visa (CAS)

gpa_note.en: Typical offers range from ABB to A*AA at A-level (or IB equivalents) depending on the course.

platform: Direct (Hokkaido University admissions; Modern Japanese Studies Program and ISP for English-taught entry)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition exemptions for international students.

tests.en: Japanese-taught degrees for privately financed international students require the EJU (Examination for Japanese University Admission) and Japanese proficiency, plus university-specific exams/interviews. English-taught undergraduate programmes (where offered) use document screening with standardized test results and English proficiency. No SAT/ACT requirement for Japanese-taught tracks.

summary.en: A former imperial university with a vast campus in Sapporo, ranked 179th by QS 2026, famous for agriculture, veterinary medicine and fisheries science. It offers English-taught entry routes such as the Integrated Science Program.
summary.ka: ყოფილი იმპერიული უნივერსიტეტი უზარმაზარი კამპუსით საპოროში, QS 2026-ში 179-ე, ცნობილი აგრარული მეცნიერებით, ვეტერინარიითა და მეთევზეობის მეცნიერებით. გთავაზობს ინგლისურენოვან მიღების გზებს, მაგ. Integrated Science Program.
summary.ar: جامعة إمبراطورية سابقة بحرم واسع في سابورو، تحتل المرتبة 179 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالزراعة والطب البيطري وعلوم مصايد الأسماك. تقدم مسارات قبول بالإنجليزية مثل برنامج العلوم المتكامل.

about.en:
Hokkaido University began in 1876 as Sapporo Agricultural College under William S. Clark ('Boys, be ambitious!') and has one of Japan's largest campuses in central Sapporo. It is renowned for agriculture, veterinary medicine, fisheries and marine science, environmental science, engineering and Japanese studies.

International students can apply to English-taught bachelor's routes such as the Integrated Science Program and the Modern Japanese Studies Program, or to Japanese-taught degrees via the EJU. Tuition is at the national-university rate.

label.en: Japanese proficiency or English test (English-taught programmes)

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct online application and/or uni-assist (for international qualifications)
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees; students pay only the semester contribution (covering administration, student services and usually a public-transport ticket).

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: One of Germany's largest technical universities and a German 'University of Excellence', in Dresden and ranked 185th by QS 2026, with leading microelectronics and engineering. Bachelor's study is mainly in German and tuition-free.
summary.ka: გერმანიის ერთ-ერთი უდიდესი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი და „ექსცელენტობის უნივერსიტეტი“ დრეზდენში, QS 2026-ში 185-ე, წამყვანი მიკროელექტრონიკითა და ინჟინერიით. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: إحدى أكبر الجامعات التقنية في ألمانيا و«جامعة تميز» ألمانية، في دريسدن وتحتل المرتبة 185 في QS 2026، وتتصدر في الإلكترونيات الدقيقة والهندسة. الدراسة بالألمانية أساساً ومجانية.

about.en:
TU Dresden, founded in 1828, is a full-spectrum technical university in Saxony and part of the 'Silicon Saxony' microelectronics cluster. It excels in electrical engineering and microelectronics, mechanical and process engineering, materials science, computer science and medicine, and holds German Excellence University status.

International applicants apply online (often via uni-assist), need German C1 for most bachelor's and Diplom programmes, and pay no tuition, only a semester contribution.

label.en: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

gpa_note.en: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

platform: National PAES admission or special admission for foreign students
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Chilean gratuidad and scholarships mainly for residents; limited options for foreign applicants.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Chilean students enter via the national PAES exam; foreign secondary-school graduates can use special admission routes. Teaching is in Spanish.

summary.en: Chile's oldest and largest public university, in Santiago and ranked 185th by QS 2026, with prestigious medicine, law and engineering. Teaching is in Spanish.
summary.ka: ჩილეს უძველესი და უდიდესი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი სანტიაგოში, QS 2026-ში 185-ე, პრესტიჟული მედიცინით, სამართლითა და ინჟინერიით. სწავლება ესპანურადაა.
summary.ar: أقدم وأكبر جامعة حكومية في تشيلي، في سانتياغو وتحتل المرتبة 185 في QS 2026، ولها برامج مرموقة في الطب والقانون والهندسة. التدريس بالإسبانية.

about.en:
Founded in 1842, Universidad de Chile has educated many Chilean presidents and two Nobel laureates in literature. Its campuses across Santiago host strong faculties of medicine, law, physical and mathematical sciences (engineering), sciences, economics and the arts.

Most students enter through the national PAES; foreign graduates can apply via special admission. All teaching is in Spanish.

label.en: Entrance exam or special admission route for foreign students

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Studielink plus VU application dashboard
deadline_note: 2027-28 applications open 1 Oct 2026. Numerus fixus programmes: 15 Jan 2027. Non-EU/EEA students: 1 Apr 2027. EU/EEA and students not needing a visa: 1 May 2027 (some programmes extended to 15 May or 15 June). The Studielink request, completed dashboard application and any application fee are due by the deadline.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA students pay the institutional fee (varies by programme); EU/EEA students pay the statutory fee.

aid_intl.en: Limited merit scholarships for non-EEA bachelor's students (e.g. Holland Scholarship).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Each bachelor's lists its own admission requirements (e.g. mathematics level) and English requirements for English-taught programmes under its 'Admissions' tab.

summary.en: A broad research university on Amsterdam's Zuidas business district, ranked 185th by QS 2026, with many English-taught bachelor's degrees in business, social sciences, computing and health. Non-EU applicants must apply by 1 April 2027, or by 15 January 2027 for numerus fixus programmes.
summary.ka: ფართოპროფილიანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ამსტერდამის ზიუდასის ბიზნეს-უბანში, QS 2026-ში 185-ე, მრავალი ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატით ბიზნესში, სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში, კომპიუტინგსა და ჯანდაცვაში. ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფმა აპლიკანტებმა განაცხადი 2027 წლის 1 აპრილამდე უნდა გააკეთონ, numerus fixus პროგრამებზე კი 15 იანვრამდე.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية شاملة في حي الأعمال زويداس بأمستردام، تحتل المرتبة 185 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج بكالوريوس عديدة بالإنجليزية في الأعمال والعلوم الاجتماعية والحوسبة والصحة. على المتقدمين من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي التقديم بحلول 1 أبريل 2027، أو 15 يناير 2027 للبرامج ذات المقاعد المحدودة.

about.en:
Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam (VU) was founded in 1880 and has a single city campus in Amsterdam's Zuidas district, next to the Amsterdam UMC medical centre. It offers bachelor's programmes across business and economics, law, social sciences, humanities, science, computer science and AI, and health and behavioural sciences, many fully in English.

International students apply via Studielink and the VU dashboard; numerus fixus programmes close on 15 January, other programmes on 1 April for non-EU/EEA students who need a visa. Programme pages list specific maths and English requirements.

label.en: Secondary school diploma equivalent to Dutch VWO
English proficiency test for English-taught programmes
Studielink registration and VU dashboard application (selection/matching activities for some programmes)
Proof of funds for the residence permit

gpa_note.en: Diploma must be equivalent to Dutch VWO with required subjects; numerus fixus programmes add selection.

platform: Direct (Curtin online application) or authorised agent
deadline_note: International applications are generally rolling; apply several months before the February or July start.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by course (see Curtin's fees and charges).

aid_intl.en: Merit scholarships for international students (e.g. Curtin International Scholarships – Merit) offering partial tuition reductions.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification against course requirements. English proficiency required per course (IELTS/TOEFL/PTE or equivalent); portfolio entry is available for some courses.

summary.en: Western Australia's largest university, in Perth and ranked 189th by QS 2026, internationally known for mining, minerals and earth sciences. It admits international students for February and July starts.
summary.ka: დასავლეთ ავსტრალიის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი პერთში, QS 2026-ში 189-ე, საერთაშორისოდ ცნობილი სამთო საქმით, მინერალებითა და დედამიწის მეცნიერებებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს თებერვლისა და ივლისის ნაკადებზე იღებს.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في غرب أستراليا، في بيرث وتحتل المرتبة 189 في QS 2026، وتشتهر عالمياً بالتعدين والمعادن وعلوم الأرض. تقبل الطلاب الدوليين للبدء في فبراير ويوليو.

about.en:
Curtin University has its main Bentley campus in Perth plus campuses in Malaysia, Singapore, Dubai and Mauritius. Its Western Australian School of Mines is world-renowned, and it is also strong in earth sciences, petroleum and chemical engineering, business, health sciences, architecture and design.

International students apply online with their school results and English test scores at the course's level. Intakes are in February and July, and merit scholarships reduce tuition for high achievers.

label.en: English test at the course's level
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Course-specific minimum results for your qualification.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.

summary.en: A C9 engineering powerhouse in north-east China, ranked 190th by QS 2026 and known for aerospace, robotics and materials science. Undergraduate study is mostly in Chinese and requires a CSCA report.
summary.ka: C9-ის საინჟინრო ძალა ჩრდილო-აღმოსავლეთ ჩინეთში, QS 2026-ში 190-ე, ცნობილი აერონავტიკით, რობოტიკითა და მასალათმცოდნეობით. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად ჩინურადაა და საჭიროა CSCA-ის ანგარიში.
summary.ar: قوة هندسية في رابطة C9 بشمال شرق الصين، تحتل المرتبة 190 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بهندسة الطيران والفضاء والروبوتات وعلوم المواد. الدراسة الجامعية غالباً بالصينية وتتطلب تقرير CSCA.

about.en:
Harbin Institute of Technology (HIT), founded in 1920, is one of China's leading engineering universities, with its main campus in Harbin and branch campuses in Weihai and Shenzhen. It is a core institution for China's space programme and excels in aerospace, robotics, welding and materials, civil engineering and computing.

International undergraduates typically study in Chinese after meeting HSK requirements and submitting a CSCA report; some English-taught options exist. CSC scholarships are available.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: Direct (NCKU international degree admission online application)
deadline_note: International degree-seeking students apply directly to the university for the Fall (September) intake; application windows for Taiwanese universities usually run from winter to early spring. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Taiwan Scholarship (Ministry of Education/Foreign Affairs) and university scholarships for international degree students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (results may strengthen an application). Chinese-taught programmes require Chinese proficiency (TOCFL); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Selection is by document review (transcripts, study plan, recommendations).

summary.en: Taiwan's largest comprehensive university in southern Tainan, ranked 191st by QS 2026, with strong engineering, medicine and architecture. International degree students apply directly for September entry.
summary.ka: ტაივანის უდიდესი მრავალპროფილიანი უნივერსიტეტი სამხრეთ ტაინანში, QS 2026-ში 191-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიით, მედიცინითა და არქიტექტურით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები სექტემბრის ნაკადზე პირდაპირ აკეთებენ განაცხადს.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة شاملة في تايوان في تاينان الجنوبية، تحتل المرتبة 191 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج قوية في الهندسة والطب والعمارة. يتقدم طلاب الدرجات الدوليون مباشرة للالتحاق في سبتمبر.

about.en:
National Cheng Kung University, founded in 1931, has a large campus in the historic city of Tainan. It is one of Taiwan's top engineering schools (mechanical, civil, electrical, aeronautics and astronautics), with a major medical college and hospital, and strong architecture, urban planning and management programmes.

International students apply online for September entry with academic records, study plans, recommendations and language certificates (TOCFL or TOEFL/IELTS). Costs in Tainan are low, and scholarships are available.

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (TU Wien online pre-registration, TISS)
deadline_note: Non-EU/EEA applicants with a foreign school-leaving certificate: summer semester 2027 application window 16 July 2026 – 15 Jan 2027; winter semester 2027/28 window 16 Jan – 15 July 2027. Pre-registration (incl. programme pre-phase) must be completed by 5 Sept (winter) / 5 Feb (summer).

tuition_intl.note: Austrian public-university tuition for non-EU/EEA students (€726.72 per semester plus the Students' Union fee).

aid_intl.en: Few scholarships for international bachelor's students; some OeAD grants and fee waivers for certain countries.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught in German: proof of German at A2 to apply and C1 before admission (the university preparation programme VWU can help). Some foreign certificates require supplementary exams; some programmes (e.g. informatics, architecture) have admission procedures.

summary.en: Austria's largest technical university, in central Vienna and ranked 191st by QS 2026, strong in engineering, architecture and computer science. Bachelor's degrees are taught in German and cost non-EU students about €727 per semester.
summary.ka: ავსტრიის უდიდესი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი ვენის ცენტრში, QS 2026-ში 191-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, არქიტექტურასა და კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებაში. ბაკალავრიატი გერმანულ ენაზეა და ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფ სტუდენტებს სემესტრში დაახლოებით €727 უჯდებათ.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة تقنية في النمسا، في وسط فيينا وتحتل المرتبة 191 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الهندسة والعمارة وعلوم الحاسوب. تُدرَّس برامج البكالوريوس بالألمانية وتكلّف الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي نحو 727 يورو للفصل.

about.en:
TU Wien was founded in 1815 and has campuses across central Vienna, including the historic Karlsplatz main building.
