It has eight faculties covering architecture and planning, civil and environmental engineering, informatics, physics, chemistry, mathematics, electrical engineering and mechanical engineering, with strong research in materials, quantum physics and computing.

International applicants with foreign school-leaving certificates apply online within fixed windows (for non-EU citizens, closing 15 January for the summer semester and 15 July for the winter semester) and must reach German C1. Tuition follows the low Austrian public-university rate.

label.en: Secondary qualification equivalent to the Austrian Matura (supplementary exams if not)
German A2 to apply, C1 before admission
Programme pre-phase/admission procedure for some programmes
Proof of funds for the Austrian residence permit

gpa_note.en: Admission requires a recognised school-leaving certificate; selection procedures apply to some programmes.

platform: Direct (UI international undergraduate admission / International Undergraduate Program)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Some scholarships for international students (e.g. Indonesian government KNB scholarship).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; international applicants are selected on school records and UI's admission tests/interviews. English-taught International Undergraduate Programs require TOEFL/IELTS; Indonesian-taught programmes require Indonesian proficiency. Minimum scores could not be verified.

summary.en: Indonesia's oldest and most prestigious university, in Depok on Jakarta's edge, ranked 191st by QS 2026, with English-taught international programmes in medicine, business and engineering.
summary.ka: ინდონეზიის უძველესი და ყველაზე პრესტიჟული უნივერსიტეტი დეპოკში, ჯაკარტის გარეუბანში, QS 2026-ში 191-ე, ინგლისურენოვანი საერთაშორისო პროგრამებით მედიცინაში, ბიზნესსა და ინჟინერიაში.
summary.ar: أقدم وأعرق جامعة في إندونيسيا، في ديبوك على أطراف جاكرتا، تحتل المرتبة 191 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج دولية بالإنجليزية في الطب والأعمال والهندسة.

about.en:
Universitas Indonesia traces its roots to 1849 and has its main campus in Depok and a medical campus in Salemba, central Jakarta. It is Indonesia's leading university for medicine, economics and business, law, engineering, public health and the social sciences.

International students can apply to English-taught International Undergraduate Programs or to Indonesian-taught programmes, with selection based on school records, tests and interviews.

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (University of Bern online application); medicine via swissuniversities
deadline_note: Application deadlines: spring semester 15 Dec 2026; fall semester 30 Apr 2027. Human, dental and veterinary medicine: apply to swissuniversities by 15 Feb 2027 (aptitude test). Application fee CHF 150.

tuition_intl.note: CHF 909 per semester (incl. Student Union fee); non-Swiss students who were not resident in Switzerland pay an extra CHF 1,700 per semester. Application fee CHF 150.

aid_intl.en: Few scholarships for international bachelor's students; most Swiss excellence scholarships target master's/PhD level.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's teaching is in German (except foreign-language studies), so proof of German is required; some programmes need Latin/Greek. Foreign certificates must meet Swiss recognition criteria. Medicine requires the Swiss aptitude test (EMS) via swissuniversities.

summary.en: The university of Switzerland's capital, ranked 191st by QS 2026, strong in medicine, climate and space science and veterinary medicine. Bachelor's teaching is in German; the next deadline is 15 December 2026 for the spring semester.
summary.ka: შვეიცარიის დედაქალაქის უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 191-ე, ძლიერი მედიცინაში, კლიმატისა და კოსმოსის მეცნიერებებსა და ვეტერინარიაში. ბაკალავრიატი გერმანულადაა; შემდეგი ვადაა 2026 წლის 15 დეკემბერი გაზაფხულის სემესტრისთვის.
summary.ar: جامعة العاصمة السويسرية، تحتل المرتبة 191 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الطب وعلوم المناخ والفضاء والطب البيطري. التدريس في البكالوريوس بالألمانية، والموعد التالي 15 ديسمبر 2026 للفصل الربيعي.

about.en:
The University of Bern, founded in 1834, is a comprehensive university in the Swiss federal capital with eight faculties. It is known for medicine (with the Inselspital university hospital), veterinary medicine, climate and space research (its instruments have flown on lunar and Mars missions), law, economics and theology.

Applicants with foreign certificates apply by 30 April for the fall semester or 15 December for spring, pay a CHF 150 fee, and need German for bachelor's study. Tuition is CHF 909 per semester, plus a CHF 1,700 surcharge per semester for students who came to Switzerland to study.

label.en: Secondary school-leaving certificate meeting Swiss recognition criteria (some need an extra exam)
Proof of proficiency in the teaching language (German/French)
Proof of funds for the Swiss residence permit

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (UOW international application) or authorised agent
deadline_note: Rolling admission for international students; see UOW key dates and apply early for visa processing.

tuition_intl.note: Varies by course (see UOW international fees).

aid_intl.en: International merit scholarships (partial tuition), including UOW Global Excellence awards.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English: IELTS, TOEFL, Pearson, Cambridge and OET results accepted at each course's required level; previous study in English may also qualify.

summary.en: A coastal university south of Sydney, ranked 195th by QS 2026, with strong engineering, business and health programmes. International students can start in February or July.
summary.ka: სანაპირო უნივერსიტეტი სიდნეის სამხრეთით, QS 2026-ში 195-ე, ძლიერი საინჟინრო, ბიზნესისა და ჯანდაცვის პროგრამებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ დაიწყონ თებერვალში ან ივლისში.
summary.ar: جامعة ساحلية جنوب سيدني، تحتل المرتبة 195 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج قوية في الهندسة والأعمال والصحة. يمكن للطلاب الدوليين البدء في فبراير أو يوليو.

about.en:
The University of Wollongong (UOW) is based in the coastal city of Wollongong, about 80 km south of Sydney, with satellite campuses across New South Wales and in Dubai, Hong Kong and Malaysia. It is known for engineering (including materials and steel research), business, IT, nursing and health, and creative arts.

International applicants apply online with secondary results and English evidence at the course's level. UOW accepts major English tests and offers merit scholarships for international students.

label.en: English test at the course's level
Proof of funds for the Australian student visa

gpa_note.en: Course-specific minimum results for your qualification.

platform: Direct (UCLouvain online application)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Limited bachelor's-level aid for international students; reduced fees for students from certain developing countries.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mainly in French (some bilingual French/English), so French proficiency is required; foreign diplomas need equivalence from the French Community of Belgium. Medicine and dentistry require an entrance exam, and civil engineering a maths admission exam.

summary.en: Belgium's largest French-speaking university, centred on the car-free town of Louvain-la-Neuve and ranked 196th by QS 2026, strong in engineering, economics and medicine. Bachelor's study is mainly in French.
summary.ka: ბელგიის უდიდესი ფრანგულენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი, ორიენტირებული უმანქანო ქალაქ ლუვენ-ლა-ნევზე, QS 2026-ში 196-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, ეკონომიკასა და მედიცინაში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად ფრანგულადაა.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة ناطقة بالفرنسية في بلجيكا، مركزها مدينة لوفان-لا-نوف الخالية من السيارات، تحتل المرتبة 196 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الهندسة والاقتصاد والطب. الدراسة في البكالوريوس بالفرنسية أساساً.

about.en:
UCLouvain traces its origins to 1425 and, after the 1968 split of Leuven's university, built the purpose-designed town of Louvain-la-Neuve; it also has campuses in Brussels (Woluwe, medicine), Mons and Tournai. It is strong in engineering, economics and management (LSM), medicine, philosophy, theology and political science.

International applicants need an equivalence for their diploma and French proficiency; medicine requires the Belgian entrance exam and engineering a mathematics admission test.

label.en: Diploma equivalence from the French Community of Belgium
Entrance exam for medicine/dentistry; maths exam for engineering
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (Otago online application)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: International merit scholarships (partial tuition) for high-achieving undergraduates.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent) required for non-native speakers. Health Sciences First Year leads to competitive professional programmes (medicine, dentistry, pharmacy); entry to medicine also involves UCAT ANZ for most applicants.

summary.en: New Zealand's oldest university, in the student city of Dunedin, ranked 198th by QS 2026 and famous for health sciences including the country's only dental school.
summary.ka: ახალი ზელანდიის უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი სტუდენტურ ქალაქ დანედინში, QS 2026-ში 198-ე, ცნობილი ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებით, მათ შორის ქვეყნის ერთადერთი სტომატოლოგიური სკოლით.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة في نيوزيلندا، في مدينة الطلاب دنيدن، تحتل المرتبة 198 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بالعلوم الصحية بما فيها كلية طب الأسنان الوحيدة في البلاد.

about.en:
Founded in 1869, the University of Otago is a residential university with a historic campus in Dunedin and health sciences campuses in Christchurch and Wellington. It is renowned for medicine, dentistry, pharmacy and physiotherapy, and also strong in sciences, law, commerce and humanities.

International students apply directly online with their school results and English evidence; many start with Health Sciences First Year in the hope of entering professional programmes.

label.en: English test at the programme's level
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Madrid regional pre-enrolment after university-access accreditation
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Spanish government and Madrid regional grants (mainly for residents) and UCM scholarships.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. International applicants need Spanish university-access recognition (e.g. UNEDasiss accreditation, with PCE specific-competence exams to raise the admission grade) and then pre-enrol for each degree. Teaching is mainly in Spanish.

summary.en: One of Europe's oldest and largest universities, in Madrid and ranked 199th by QS 2026, strong in medicine, law, political science and the arts. Teaching is mainly in Spanish.
summary.ka: ევროპის ერთ-ერთი უძველესი და უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი მადრიდში, QS 2026-ში 199-ე, ძლიერი მედიცინაში, სამართალში, პოლიტოლოგიასა და ხელოვნებაში. სწავლება ძირითადად ესპანურადაა.
summary.ar: من أقدم وأكبر الجامعات في أوروبا، في مدريد وتحتل المرتبة 199 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الطب والقانون والعلوم السياسية والفنون. التدريس بالإسبانية أساساً.

about.en:
The Complutense University traces its roots to 1293 and today has its main Ciudad Universitaria campus in Madrid and the Somosaguas campus. It is strong in medicine, law, political science and sociology, psychology, fine arts, journalism and veterinary medicine.

International applicants obtain Spanish university-access accreditation (often through UNEDasiss) and apply via Madrid's pre-enrolment; public fees are moderate.

label.en: Secondary school diploma with recognition/homologation or UNEDasiss accreditation
Spanish university-entrance route (UNEDasiss accreditation / PCE specific-competence exams) where required
Proof of funds for the Spanish student visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (KAU admission; international scholarship programme via Study in Saudi)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Scholarships for international students offered through Saudi government programmes (e.g. Study in Saudi), which can cover tuition, housing and a stipend.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement stated; Saudi applicants use national Qudurat/Tahsili tests. International scholarship applicants are selected on academic records and programme requirements. Many science, medicine and engineering programmes use English; others teach in Arabic.

summary.en: A large public university in Jeddah, ranked 200th by QS 2026 and among the Arab world's most research-active, strong in engineering, medicine and marine sciences. International students mainly enrol through Saudi government scholarships.
summary.ka: დიდი საჯარო უნივერსიტეტი ჯიდაში, QS 2026-ში 200-ე და არაბული სამყაროს ერთ-ერთი ყველაზე კვლევაზე ორიენტირებული, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, მედიცინასა და საზღვაო მეცნიერებებში. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები ძირითადად საუდის მთავრობის სტიპენდიებით ირიცხებიან.
summary.ar: جامعة حكومية كبيرة في جدة، تحتل المرتبة 200 في QS 2026 ومن أنشط جامعات العالم العربي بحثياً، وتتميز في الهندسة والطب وعلوم البحار. يلتحق الطلاب الدوليون أساساً عبر منح الحكومة السعودية.

about.en:
King Abdulaziz University was founded in 1967 in Jeddah and has separate campuses for male and female students plus branches across the Makkah region. It is strong in engineering, medicine, marine sciences, earth sciences and business, with high research output.

International undergraduates usually join through Saudi government scholarship programmes, which typically cover tuition and living support; programme language (Arabic or English) varies by faculty.

label.en: English or Arabic proficiency depending on the programme
Scholarship application (Study in Saudi) for international students

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

name.ar: المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا في خراغبور (IIT Kharagpur)

platform: JEE (Advanced) + JoSAA counselling
deadline_note: JEE (Advanced) 2027 registration dates are announced on jeeadv.ac.in (in 2026, JoSAA allotment rounds ran through July). Foreign nationals register directly for JEE (Advanced); watch for the 2027 information brochure.

tuition_intl.note: Foreign nationals pay a higher tuition rate set by the IIT; see the institute's fee page/JoSAA business rules.

aid_intl.en: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.

summary.en: India's first IIT, founded in 1951 in West Bengal, ranked 205th by QS 2026, with the largest campus and the broadest range of disciplines among IITs. Admission is via JEE (Advanced), open directly to foreign nationals.
summary.ka: ინდოეთის პირველი IIT, დაარსებული 1951 წელს დასავლეთ ბენგალში, QS 2026-ში 205-ე, IIT-ებს შორის ყველაზე დიდი კამპუსითა და დისციპლინების ყველაზე ფართო სპექტრით. მიღება JEE (Advanced)-ით ხდება, რომელიც უცხოელებისთვის პირდაპირ ღიაა.
summary.ar: أول معهد IIT في الهند، تأسس عام 1951 في البنغال الغربية، ويحتل المرتبة 205 في QS 2026، ويملك أكبر حرم وأوسع نطاق تخصصات بين معاهد IIT. القبول عبر JEE (Advanced) المتاح مباشرة للأجانب.

about.en:
IIT Kharagpur was the first of the Indian Institutes of Technology, set up in 1951 in a former detention camp at Hijli. Its 2,100-acre campus hosts engineering, architecture, law (Rajiv Gandhi School of IP Law), management, medicine and mining departments, giving it the widest academic range of any IIT.

Undergraduate places are filled through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA counselling; foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and compete for supernumerary seats.

label.en: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

gpa_note.en: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

platform: Direct online application and/or uni-assist (for international qualifications)
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees; students pay only the semester contribution (covering administration, student services and usually a public-transport ticket).

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: A German 'University of Excellence' in the former capital Bonn, ranked 209th by QS 2026, world-renowned for mathematics and economics. Bachelor's study is mostly in German and tuition-free.
summary.ka: გერმანიის „ექსცელენტობის უნივერსიტეტი“ ყოფილ დედაქალაქ ბონში, QS 2026-ში 209-ე, მსოფლიოში ცნობილი მათემატიკითა და ეკონომიკით. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: «جامعة تميز» ألمانية في العاصمة السابقة بون، تحتل المرتبة 209 في QS 2026، وتشتهر عالمياً بالرياضيات والاقتصاد. الدراسة بالألمانية غالباً ومجانية.

about.en:
The University of Bonn, founded in 1818, is housed partly in the Baroque Electoral Palace and is one of Germany's Excellence Universities. Its Hausdorff Center for Mathematics and economics department are among Europe's best, and it is also strong in physics and astronomy, agricultural science, medicine and philosophy.

International applicants apply online or via uni-assist, need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes, and pay only a semester contribution.

label.en: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

gpa_note.en: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

platform: Direct online application and/or uni-assist (for international qualifications)
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees; students pay only the semester contribution (covering administration, student services and usually a public-transport ticket).

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: Northern Germany's largest university, in the port city of Hamburg, ranked 209th by QS 2026 and a German 'University of Excellence' strong in climate research and physics. Bachelor's study is mostly in German and tuition-free.
summary.ka: ჩრდილოეთ გერმანიის უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი საპორტო ქალაქ ჰამბურგში, QS 2026-ში 209-ე, „ექსცელენტობის უნივერსიტეტი“, ძლიერი კლიმატის კვლევასა და ფიზიკაში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: أكبر جامعة في شمال ألمانيا في مدينة هامبورغ الساحلية، تحتل المرتبة 209 في QS 2026 وهي «جامعة تميز» ألمانية قوية في أبحاث المناخ والفيزياء. الدراسة بالألمانية غالباً ومجانية.

about.en:
Universität Hamburg, founded in 1919, is a large comprehensive university and one of Germany's Excellence Universities. It is internationally known for climate and earth-system research, physics (with DESY nearby), economics and business, law, and linguistics.

International applicants apply via the university's online portal or uni-assist, need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes, and pay only a semester contribution, which includes a public-transport ticket.

label.en: University entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German C1 proof (DSH-2 / TestDaF 4x4) for German-taught programmes
uni-assist or university application fee (if applicable)
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

gpa_note.en: Open-admission programmes accept all qualified applicants; restricted (NC) programmes rank by converted school grade.

platform: Direct (Keio admissions; PEARL and GIGA English-taught programmes, plus Japanese-taught entry)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: MEXT and JASSO scholarships, university scholarships and tuition exemptions for international students. Keio offers its own scholarships for international students.

tests.en: English-taught programmes (PEARL in economics, GIGA at Shonan Fujisawa) use document screening with standardized test results (e.g. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level) and English proficiency; Japanese-taught programmes require EJU and Japanese proficiency with faculty exams. Exact thresholds are set in each programme's guidelines.

summary.en: Japan's oldest private university, in Tokyo and ranked 213th by QS 2026, with elite business, economics, law and medicine. International students can study in English through PEARL (economics) or GIGA (policy and environment).
summary.ka: იაპონიის უძველესი კერძო უნივერსიტეტი ტოკიოში, QS 2026-ში 213-ე, ელიტური ბიზნესით, ეკონომიკით, სამართლითა და მედიცინით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს ინგლისურად სწავლა PEARL-ში (ეკონომიკა) ან GIGA-ში (პოლიტიკა და გარემო) შეუძლიათ.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة خاصة في اليابان، في طوكيو وتحتل المرتبة 213 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج نخبوية في الأعمال والاقتصاد والقانون والطب. يمكن للطلاب الدوليين الدراسة بالإنجليزية عبر برنامج PEARL (الاقتصاد) أو GIGA (السياسات والبيئة).

about.en:
Founded in 1858 by Fukuzawa Yukichi, Keio University is one of Japan's two most prestigious private universities, with campuses at Mita, Hiyoshi, Shonan Fujisawa (SFC) and Shinanomachi (medicine). It is known for economics, business, law, medicine and policy studies, and its alumni network dominates Japanese business.

For students without Japanese, Keio offers the PEARL programme in the Faculty of Economics and the GIGA programme at SFC, both taught in English with September entry and document-based selection. Japanese-taught faculties use the EJU and faculty exams.

label.en: Standardized test results (SAT/ACT/IB/A-level) for English-taught programmes

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

en: GIGA (Environment and Information Studies/Policy Management, English-taught)

platform: Direct (Massey online admission application)
deadline_note: Massey publishes admission due dates for international students for 2027 (Semester 1 starts late February); applications continue to be considered after the due date if places remain. Apply early to allow time for the visa.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by qualification; see Massey's fees pages.

aid_intl.en: International merit scholarships (partial tuition), e.g. Massey University International Excellence Scholarships.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English for undergraduate study: Academic IELTS 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 in each band (IELTS Online accepted), or equivalent TOEFL/Duolingo scores; some qualifications have higher requirements.

summary.en: A multi-campus New Zealand university ranked 215th by QS 2026, known for agriculture, veterinary science, aviation and design. Undergraduate entry needs IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5.
summary.ka: ახალი ზელანდიის მრავალკამპუსიანი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 215-ე, ცნობილი აგრარული და ვეტერინარიული მეცნიერებებით, ავიაციითა და დიზაინით. ბაკალავრიატზე საჭიროა IELTS 6.0, არცერთი კომპონენტი 5.5-ზე ნაკლები.
summary.ar: جامعة نيوزيلندية متعددة الفروع تحتل المرتبة 215 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالزراعة والطب البيطري والطيران والتصميم. يتطلب البكالوريوس IELTS 6.0 دون أي مهارة أقل من 5.5.

about.en:
Massey University has campuses in Palmerston North (Manawatū), Auckland and Wellington, plus a large distance-learning offer. It is New Zealand's only provider of veterinary science alongside strong agriculture, food technology and aviation (including a professional pilot pathway), and its Wellington College of Creative Arts is a leading design school.

International students apply directly online, meeting entrance requirements for their qualification and English at IELTS 6.0 (no band below 5.5) for undergraduate study. Semester 1 begins in late February, and merit scholarships are available.

label.en: English test (programme level; IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 is typical)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

gpa_note.en: Entry by your secondary qualification (equivalent to NZ University Entrance); veterinary science and aviation are selective.

platform: Direct (FAU campo application portal)
deadline_note: Non-EU applicants for summer semester 2027: 2 Nov 2026 – 15 Jan 2027. Winter semester 2027/28 applications typically run to 15 July (AI B.Sc. by 31 May).

tuition_intl.note: From summer semester 2027 FAU charges non-EU/EEA students tuition of €1,000–6,000 per semester depending on the programme, plus the €82 semester contribution; €100 application fee per application for non-EU applicants.

aid_intl.en: Germany-wide options such as DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial); FAU fee exemptions in some cases.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in German and require proof of German proficiency (e.g. DSH-2/TestDaF level). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access need the Studienkolleg and its assessment test (Feststellungsprüfung). Medicine and some programmes are restricted.

summary.en: One of Germany's largest universities, with campuses in Erlangen and Nuremberg, ranked 218th by QS 2026 and strong in engineering, medicine and materials. Teaching is mainly in German, and from summer 2027 non-EU students pay €1,000–6,000 per semester.
summary.ka: გერმანიის ერთ-ერთი უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი ერლანგენსა და ნიურნბერგში, QS 2026-ში 218-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, მედიცინასა და მასალათმცოდნეობაში. სწავლება ძირითადად გერმანულადაა, 2027 წლის ზაფხულიდან კი ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფი სტუდენტები სემესტრში €1,000–6,000 იხდიან.
summary.ar: إحدى أكبر الجامعات الألمانية بفروع في إرلانغن ونورنبرغ، تحتل المرتبة 218 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الهندسة والطب وعلوم المواد. التدريس بالألمانية أساساً، وابتداءً من صيف 2027 يدفع الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي 1,000–6,000 يورو للفصل.

about.en:
FAU, founded in 1743, is a large research university in Bavaria with five faculties and close ties to industry partners such as Siemens and Adidas. It is especially strong in engineering (including AI, electrical and mechanical engineering, materials science), medicine, the natural sciences and business and economics in Nuremberg.

International bachelor's applicants apply directly via FAU's campo portal; non-EU applicants for the summer semester apply from 2 November to 15 January. German proficiency is required for most programmes, and from summer semester 2027 FAU introduces tuition for non-EU students and a €100 application fee.

label.en: Higher education entrance qualification recognised in Germany (or Studienkolleg)
German proficiency (DSH-2/TestDaF level) for German-taught programmes
Blocked account/proof of funds for the German student visa

gpa_note.en: Foreign grades are converted with the Bavarian formula; restricted programmes select by grade.

platform: IISc UG admissions portal using JEE / IISER Aptitude Test / NEET scores
deadline_note: IISc's undergraduate admission notice for 2027 is published on its UG admissions page (typically in spring, after national exam registrations open).

tuition_intl.note: Foreign nationals pay a higher tuition rate set by the IIT; see the institute's fee page/JoSAA business rules.

aid_intl.en: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Admission to the B.S. (Research) and B.Tech (Mathematics and Computing) uses national entrance exam ranks (JEE Main/Advanced, IISER Aptitude Test or NEET as specified each year). Teaching is in English.

summary.en: India's premier research institute for science, in Bengaluru, ranked 221st by QS 2026, offering a small four-year B.S. (Research) and a B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing. Undergraduate entry is via national exams such as JEE and IISER Aptitude Test.
summary.ka: ინდოეთის წამყვანი სამეცნიერო კვლევითი ინსტიტუტი ბენგალურუში, QS 2026-ში 221-ე, რომელიც მცირე ოთხწლიან B.S. (Research) პროგრამასა და B.Tech-ს მათემატიკასა და კომპიუტინგში გთავაზობს. ბაკალავრიატზე მიღება ეროვნული გამოცდებით (JEE, IISER Aptitude Test) ხდება.
summary.ar: المعهد البحثي الأول للعلوم في الهند، في بنغالورو ويحتل المرتبة 221 في QS 2026، ويقدم بكالوريوس علوم بحثياً صغيراً لأربع سنوات وB.Tech في الرياضيات والحوسبة. القبول الجامعي عبر امتحانات وطنية مثل JEE واختبار IISER للقدرات.

about.en:
Founded in 1909 with support from Jamsetji Tata, IISc is India's leading research institution in science and engineering, mostly a graduate school. Since 2011 it has offered a highly selective four-year Bachelor of Science (Research) with majors in physics, chemistry, biology, mathematics, materials and earth sciences, and more recently a B.Tech in Mathematics and Computing.

Undergraduate admission uses national entrance exams (JEE Main/Advanced, NEET or the IISER Aptitude Test) as announced each year; international applicants should check eligibility with the institute.

label.en: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

gpa_note.en: Selection by national entrance exam rank; extremely competitive.

name.ar: المعهد الهندي للتكنولوجيا في كانبور (IIT Kanpur)

platform: JEE (Advanced) + JoSAA counselling
deadline_note: JEE (Advanced) 2027 registration dates are announced on jeeadv.ac.in (in 2026, JoSAA allotment rounds ran through July). Foreign nationals register directly for JEE (Advanced); watch for the 2027 information brochure.

tuition_intl.note: Foreign nationals pay a higher tuition rate set by the IIT; see the institute's fee page/JoSAA business rules.

aid_intl.en: Limited for foreign nationals; Indian government schemes (e.g. ICCR/Study in India) may support some international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. B.Tech/B.S. admission at every IIT is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA seat allocation. Foreign nationals (and OCI/PIO cardholders from 4 March 2021 who opt for it) do NOT need JEE (Main) and may register for JEE (Advanced) directly; they compete for supernumerary foreign-national seats. Teaching is in English; no IELTS/TOEFL is required.

summary.en: A leading IIT in Uttar Pradesh, ranked 221st by QS 2026, known for computer science, aerospace and a strong science base. Undergraduate admission is via JEE (Advanced), which foreign nationals can take directly.
summary.ka: წამყვანი IIT უტარ-პრადეშში, QS 2026-ში 221-ე, ცნობილი კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებით, აერონავტიკითა და ძლიერი სამეცნიერო ბაზით. ბაკალავრიატზე მიღება JEE (Advanced)-ით ხდება, რომლის ჩაბარებაც უცხოელებს პირდაპირ შეუძლიათ.
summary.ar: معهد IIT رائد في ولاية أوتار براديش، يحتل المرتبة 221 في QS 2026، ويشتهر بعلوم الحاسوب والطيران وقاعدة علمية قوية. القبول الجامعي عبر JEE (Advanced) الذي يمكن للأجانب التقدم له مباشرة.

about.en:
IIT Kanpur, founded in 1959 with help from a consortium of US universities, pioneered computer science education in India and has its own airstrip for aerospace research. It is strong in computer science, electrical and aerospace engineering, physics, mathematics and economics.

Undergraduate admission is through JEE (Advanced) and JoSAA; foreign nationals can register for JEE (Advanced) directly and take supernumerary seats. All teaching is in English.

label.en: JEE (Advanced) registration and score (foreign nationals may skip JEE Main)
JEE (Advanced) registration fee and JoSAA seat-acceptance fee

gpa_note.en: Admission is by JEE (Advanced) rank; foreign-national seats are allotted on merit among foreign candidates.

platform: Studielink plus UT application portal
deadline_note: Programmes with decentralised selection/numerus fixus: 15 Jan 2027. Other bachelor's: 1 May 2027 for non-EEA nationals (must be eligible by 1 June for visa processing) and 15 June for EEA nationals; a few programmes close 1 May for all.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EEA students pay the institutional fee; an application fee applies to some applicants.

aid_intl.en: University of Twente Scholarship and Holland Scholarship (partial) for selected non-EEA students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. English: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with at least 5.5 per section (IELTS Online, One Skill Retake and Indicator not accepted), or TOEFL iBT 90 with at least 21 per section (MyBest not accepted). Programme-specific maths/physics requirements apply; some programmes have selection or mandatory matching activities.

summary.en: An entrepreneurial technical university on a green campus in Enschede, ranked 223rd by QS 2026, with English-taught bachelor's degrees in engineering, computer science and technology-meets-society. It requires IELTS 6.0 (5.5 per section) or TOEFL iBT 90.
summary.ka: მეწარმეობაზე ორიენტირებული ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი მწვანე კამპუსით ენსხედეში, QS 2026-ში 223-ე, ინგლისურენოვანი ბაკალავრიატით ინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებასა და ტექნოლოგიისა და საზოგადოების კვეთაზე. საჭიროა IELTS 6.0 (თითო ნაწილში 5.5) ან TOEFL iBT 90.
summary.ar: جامعة تقنية ريادية في حرم أخضر بمدينة إنسخيده، تحتل المرتبة 223 في QS 2026، وتقدم برامج بكالوريوس بالإنجليزية في الهندسة وعلوم الحاسوب وتقاطع التكنولوجيا مع المجتمع. تشترط IELTS 6.0 (5.5 لكل قسم) أو TOEFL iBT 90.

about.en:
The University of Twente (UT), founded in 1961, is a campus-based technical university in the east of the Netherlands that brands itself 'the people-first university of technology'. It teaches through project-based learning (the Twente Education Model) and offers English-taught bachelor's degrees in fields like electrical, mechanical and civil engineering, computer science, creative technology, industrial design, technical medicine, international business administration and psychology, plus the ATLAS University College.

International applicants apply via Studielink; selective programmes close on 15 January, while most others close on 1 May for non-EEA students. Admission needs a diploma comparable to Dutch VWO, specific maths/physics, and IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL 90.

label.en: Secondary school diploma comparable to Dutch VWO
English test (IELTS 6.0, min 5.5 per section / TOEFL iBT 90, min 21 per section)
Selection or matching activities for some programmes
Proof of funds for the residence permit

gpa_note.en: Diploma comparable to Dutch VWO with required maths (and physics for engineering).

platform: University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se)
deadline_note: Autumn 2027 first admissions round (for international students) via University Admissions in Sweden: opens 16 Oct 2026, apply and rank programmes by 15 Jan 2027; application fee, fee-exemption proof and supporting documents due 1 Feb 2027; bachelor's results 8 Apr 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries and Switzerland pay tuition (set per programme) plus a SEK 900 application fee; EU/EEA students study free.

aid_intl.en: Few or no bachelor's-level scholarships; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master's students. Some universities offer partial tuition waivers to fee-paying students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply.

en: Business (School of Business, Economics and Law)

summary.en: A large comprehensive university in Sweden's second city, ranked 225th by QS 2026, strong in marine sciences, health and social sciences. A few bachelor's programmes are taught in English; applications close on 15 January 2027.
summary.ka: დიდი მრავალპროფილიანი უნივერსიტეტი შვედეთის მეორე ქალაქში, QS 2026-ში 225-ე, ძლიერი საზღვაო მეცნიერებებში, ჯანდაცვასა და სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში. რამდენიმე ბაკალავრიატი ინგლისურადაა; განაცხადების მიღება 2027 წლის 15 იანვარს სრულდება.
summary.ar: جامعة شاملة كبيرة في ثاني أكبر مدن السويد، تحتل المرتبة 225 في QS 2026 وتتميز في علوم البحار والصحة والعلوم الاجتماعية. يُدرَّس عدد قليل من برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية، ويُغلق التقديم في 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
The University of Gothenburg is one of Scandinavia's largest universities, with faculties spread across central Gothenburg covering arts, education, fine and performing arts, IT, natural sciences, health (Sahlgrenska Academy), social sciences and the School of Business, Economics and Law.

Most bachelor's programmes are Swedish-taught, with a small set in English. International applicants apply through universityadmissions.se by 15 January, submitting transcripts and proof of English 6; non-EU/EEA citizens pay an application fee and tuition.

label.en: English 6 (e.g. IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90) or Swedish 3, depending on the programme
Proof of funds for the Swedish residence permit

gpa_note.en: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.

platform: Direct online application and/or uni-assist (for international qualifications)
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA students without a German university entrance qualification pay Baden-Württemberg's tuition fee for international students per semester, plus the semester contribution.

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: A historic university town in south-west Germany founded in 1477, ranked 230th by QS 2026, known for AI, neuroscience and the humanities. Bachelor's study is mainly in German; non-EU students pay Baden-Württemberg's international tuition fee.
summary.ka: ისტორიული საუნივერსიტეტო ქალაქი სამხრეთ-დასავლეთ გერმანიაში, დაარსებული 1477 წელს, QS 2026-ში 230-ე, ცნობილი ხელოვნური ინტელექტით, ნეირომეცნიერებითა და ჰუმანიტარული დარგებით. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა; ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფი სტუდენტები ბადენ-ვიურტემბერგის საერთაშორისო საფასურს იხდიან.
summary.ar: مدينة جامعية تاريخية في جنوب غرب ألمانيا تأسست جامعتها عام 1477، تحتل المرتبة 230 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالذكاء الاصطناعي وعلوم الأعصاب والإنسانيات. الدراسة بالألمانية أساساً، ويدفع الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي رسوم الطلاب الدوليين في بادن-فورتمبيرغ.

about.en:
The University of Tübingen is one of Germany's oldest universities and an Excellence University, central to a small, student-dominated town on the Neckar. It hosts the Cyber Valley AI research ecosystem and Max Planck institutes, and is strong in machine learning, neuroscience, medicine, theology, philosophy and archaeology.

International applicants need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes; as in all of Baden-Württemberg, non-EU/EEA students without a German entrance qualification pay an international tuition fee each semester.

summary.en: A French-speaking university on the shores of Lake Geneva, ranked 233rd by QS 2026, known for HEC Lausanne business school, forensic science and life sciences. Bachelor's teaching is in French.
summary.ka: ფრანგულენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი ჟენევის ტბის სანაპიროზე, QS 2026-ში 233-ე, ცნობილი HEC Lausanne ბიზნეს-სკოლით, სასამართლო ექსპერტიზით და სიცოცხლის მეცნიერებებით. ბაკალავრიატი ფრანგულადაა.
summary.ar: جامعة ناطقة بالفرنسية على ضفاف بحيرة جنيف، تحتل المرتبة 233 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بكلية HEC Lausanne للأعمال والعلوم الجنائية وعلوم الحياة. التدريس في البكالوريوس بالفرنسية.

about.en:
The University of Lausanne (UNIL) shares a lakeside campus with EPFL. It is known for HEC Lausanne (business and economics), its School of Criminal Justice (forensic science), biology and medicine (with CHUV hospital), geosciences and the environment, and political and social sciences.

International applicants apply online, meet Swiss diploma-recognition rules and prove French proficiency; tuition is low by international standards.

label.en: Secondary school-leaving certificate meeting Swiss recognition criteria (some need an extra exam)
Proof of proficiency in the teaching language (German/French)
Proof of funds for the Swiss residence permit

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

summary.en: China's first modern university (founded 1895), in Tianjin and ranked 235th by QS 2026, with leading chemical engineering and architecture. International undergraduates need a CSCA report and usually HSK.
summary.ka: ჩინეთის პირველი თანამედროვე უნივერსიტეტი (1895), ტიანძინში, QS 2026-ში 235-ე, წამყვანი ქიმიური ინჟინერიითა და არქიტექტურით. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს სჭირდებათ CSCA-ის ანგარიში და ჩვეულებრივ HSK.
summary.ar: أول جامعة حديثة في الصين (تأسست 1895)، في تيانجين وتحتل المرتبة 235 في QS 2026، وتتصدر في الهندسة الكيميائية والعمارة. يحتاج طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليون إلى تقرير CSCA وعادةً HSK.

about.en:
Tianjin University, founded in 1895 as Peiyang University, is a leading engineering-focused research university. It is best known for chemical engineering, architecture, precision instruments and optoelectronics, and civil and hydraulic engineering, and runs a joint campus with Fuzhou.

International applicants apply online with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught options) and a CSCA report, and may be interviewed. CSC and Tianjin scholarships are offered.

Interview or written test if required

summary.en: China's leading university for education and teacher training, in Beijing and ranked 237th by QS 2026, also strong in psychology and Chinese studies. Undergraduate study is mainly in Chinese and requires HSK and a CSCA report.
summary.ka: ჩინეთის წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი განათლებასა და მასწავლებლების მომზადებაში, პეკინში, QS 2026-ში 237-ე, ასევე ძლიერი ფსიქოლოგიასა და ჩინურ კვლევებში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად ჩინურადაა და საჭიროა HSK და CSCA-ის ანგარიში.
summary.ar: الجامعة الصينية الرائدة في التربية وإعداد المعلمين، في بكين وتحتل المرتبة 237 في QS 2026، وتتميز أيضاً في علم النفس والدراسات الصينية. الدراسة الجامعية بالصينية أساساً وتتطلب HSK وتقرير CSCA.

about.en:
Beijing Normal University (BNU) traces its history to 1902 and is China's flagship institution for education research and teacher preparation. It is also highly ranked in psychology, Chinese language and literature, history, geography and environmental science, with a second campus in Zhuhai.

International undergraduates usually study in Chinese (HSK required) and must provide a CSCA report; BNU is a popular choice for Chinese language and education degrees. CSC and Beijing Government scholarships are available.

summary.en: Victoria University of Wellington (Te Herenga Waka) sits in New Zealand's capital, ranked 241st by QS 2026, and is strong in law, public policy, creative arts and earth sciences. Undergraduate English entry is IELTS 6.0 (no band below 5.5), TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105.
summary.ka: ველინგტონის ვიქტორიის უნივერსიტეტი (Te Herenga Waka) ახალი ზელანდიის დედაქალაქშია, QS 2026-ში 241-ე, ძლიერი სამართალში, საჯარო პოლიტიკაში, შემოქმედებით ხელოვნებასა და დედამიწის მეცნიერებებში. ბაკალავრიატისთვის საჭიროა IELTS 6.0 (არცერთი კომპონენტი 5.5-ზე ნაკლები), TOEFL 80 ან Duolingo 105.
summary.ar: تقع جامعة فيكتوريا في ويلينغتون (تي هيرينغا واكا) في عاصمة نيوزيلندا، وتحتل المرتبة 241 في QS 2026، وتتميز في القانون والسياسات العامة والفنون الإبداعية وعلوم الأرض. يتطلب البكالوريوس IELTS 6.0 (دون أي مهارة أقل من 5.5) أو TOEFL 80 أو Duolingo 105.

about.en:
Founded in 1897, Victoria University of Wellington has campuses in central Wellington close to Parliament, the courts and government agencies, giving its law, politics, international relations and public policy programmes a practical edge. It is also known for architecture and design, creative writing (IIML), music, earth sciences and computer science.

International students apply directly online and are assessed on their secondary qualification and English (IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5, TOEFL 80 or Duolingo 105). Trimester 1 starts in late February/March, and international scholarships are available.

summary.ka: პეკინის წამყვანი საინჟინრო უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 243-ე, სპეციალიზებული სატრანსპორტო, აერონავტიკულ და ოპტიკურ ინჟინერიაში. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრები განაცხადს CSCA-ის ანგარიშითა და HSK-ით, ან ინგლისურენოვან პროგრამებზე TOEFL/IELTS-ით აკეთებენ.
summary.ar: جامعة هندسية رائدة في بكين، تحتل المرتبة 243 في QS 2026، متخصصة في هندسة المركبات والطيران والبصريات. يتقدم طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليون بتقرير CSCA مع HSK أو TOEFL/IELTS للبرامج الإنجليزية.

about.en:
Beijing Institute of Technology (BIT), founded in 1940, is one of China's key engineering universities with historic roots in defence technology. It is strong in vehicle and mechanical engineering, aerospace, optics and photonics, information and electronics, and materials, and has campuses in Beijing (Zhongguancun, Liangxiang) and Zhuhai.

International undergraduates can choose Chinese-taught programmes (HSK) or a set of English-taught engineering and business programmes (TOEFL/IELTS), and must submit a CSCA report. CSC and university scholarships are available.

summary.en: A historic research university founded in 1457 in the Black Forest city of Freiburg, ranked 245th by QS 2026 and strong in medicine, humanities and environmental sciences. Bachelor's teaching is mainly in German, and non-EU students pay Baden-Württemberg's international tuition fee.

summary.ar: جامعة بحثية عريقة تأسست عام 1457 في مدينة فرايبورغ بالغابة السوداء، تحتل المرتبة 245 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الطب والإنسانيات والعلوم البيئية. التدريس في البكالوريوس بالألمانية أساساً، ويدفع الطلاب من خارج الاتحاد الأوروبي رسوم الطلاب الدوليين المقررة في ولاية بادن-فورتمبيرغ.

about.en:
The University of Freiburg is one of Germany's oldest universities and a member of the German U15 group of research universities. It covers eleven faculties, with notable strength in medicine, philosophy and history, biology, environment and natural resources, and microsystems engineering at its technical faculty.

International applicants apply online (medicine-related subjects via hochschulstart) and need a high level of German for most bachelor's programmes. As in all of Baden-Württemberg, non-EU/EEA students without a German entrance qualification pay an international tuition fee each semester on top of the semester fee.

Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: A leading technical university near Frankfurt, ranked 250th by QS 2026, strong in electrical engineering, computer science and cybersecurity. Bachelor's study is mainly in German and tuition-free.
summary.ka: წამყვანი ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი ფრანკფურტთან ახლოს, QS 2026-ში 250-ე, ძლიერი ელექტროინჟინერიაში, კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებასა და კიბერუსაფრთხოებაში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: جامعة تقنية رائدة قرب فرانكفورت، تحتل المرتبة 250 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الهندسة الكهربائية وعلوم الحاسوب والأمن السيبراني. الدراسة بالألمانية أساساً ومجانية.

about.en:
TU Darmstadt was founded in 1877 and was the world's first university to establish a chair in electrical engineering. It is one of Germany's TU9 technical universities, with strengths in electrical and information engineering, computer science and cybersecurity (ATHENE centre), mechanical engineering, architecture and materials.

International applicants apply online, need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes, and pay only a semester contribution.

summary.en: Europe's most international Dutch university, ranked 254th by QS 2026 and known for small-group Problem-Based Learning and English-taught degrees in business, law, health and liberal arts. Non-EU bachelor's fees for 2027/28 start at €13,400 a year.
summary.ka: ნიდერლანდების ყველაზე საერთაშორისო უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 254-ე, ცნობილი მცირე ჯგუფებში პრობლემაზე დაფუძნებული სწავლებით და ინგლისურენოვანი პროგრამებით ბიზნესში, სამართალში, ჯანდაცვასა და ლიბერალურ ხელოვნებაში. 2027/28 წლისთვის ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფთათვის ბაკალავრიატი წელიწადში €13,400-დან იწყება.
summary.ar: أكثر الجامعات الهولندية دولية، تحتل المرتبة 254 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بالتعلم القائم على حل المشكلات في مجموعات صغيرة وبرامج بالإنجليزية في الأعمال والقانون والصحة والفنون الحرة. تبدأ رسوم البكالوريوس لغير الأوروبيين لعام 2027/28 من 13,400 يورو سنوياً.

about.en:
Founded in 1976, Maastricht University (UM) sits in a historic city on the Belgian and German borders and has one of the highest shares of international students in Europe. All teaching follows Problem-Based Learning in tutorial groups of about 12–15 students, and most bachelor's programmes are in English, including International Business, Economics and Business Economics, European Law School, European Studies, Psychology, Data Science, Health Sciences and University College Maastricht.

Applicants register via Studielink and the UM portal; deadlines depend on whether a programme is free, selective or fixus. Non-EU/EEA students pay institutional fees (from €13,400 in 2027/28) plus a €100 handling fee.

deadline_note: Fall 2027 freshman deadlines: Early Action I 1 Nov 2026 (decision by 31 Jan), Early Action II 1 Dec 2026 (by 28 Feb), Regular 1 Jan 2027 (by 31 Mar). Complete applications by these dates get full consideration for the Honors Program and scholarships.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded. Applicants complete by the deadlines are considered for merit scholarships.

tests.en: Test optional: freshman applicants through fall 2027 are not required to submit ACT or SAT scores. Non-native English speakers must provide English proficiency evidence (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo or equivalent).

summary.en: Minnesota's flagship public research university in Minneapolis–Saint Paul, ranked 255th by QS 2026, strong in engineering, business and health sciences. It is test optional for fall 2027, with Early Action deadlines of 1 November and 1 December 2026.
summary.ka: მინესოტას წამყვანი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი მინეაპოლის–სენტ-პოლში, QS 2026-ში 255-ე, ძლიერი ინჟინერიაში, ბიზნესსა და ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებში. 2027 წლის შემოდგომისთვის ტესტები არჩევითია; Early Action-ის ვადებია 2026 წლის 1 ნოემბერი და 1 დეკემბერი.
summary.ar: الجامعة البحثية الحكومية الرئيسية في مينيسوتا في مينيابوليس–سانت بول، تحتل المرتبة 255 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الهندسة والأعمال والعلوم الصحية. الاختبارات اختيارية لخريف 2027، ومواعيد القبول المبكر 1 نوفمبر و1 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
The University of Minnesota Twin Cities is a Big Ten land-grant university with campuses straddling the Mississippi River in Minneapolis and in Saint Paul. It is known for chemical engineering, psychology, the Carlson School of Management, public health, medicine, and agricultural and environmental sciences.

Freshmen apply by one of three deadlines (1 November, 1 December, 1 January) for full scholarship and Honors consideration; tests are optional through fall 2027. Admitted freshmen who apply for housing by the deadline are guaranteed on-campus housing.

label.en: Common App essay and any supplements
Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa

name.en: University of Canterbury | Te Whare Wānanga o Waitaha

platform: Direct (myUC online application)
deadline_note: Semester 1, 2027 starts in late February; check UC's key dates for international application closing dates and apply early for visa processing.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by degree.

aid_intl.en: International merit scholarships such as the UC International First-Year Scholarship (partial tuition).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL/other) required for non-native speakers at the level set for each degree.

summary.en: New Zealand's second-oldest university, in Christchurch and ranked 257th by QS 2026, best known for engineering, earth sciences and natural-hazards research. International students apply directly through myUC for February or July entry.
summary.ka: ახალი ზელანდიის მეორე უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი ქრაისტჩერჩში, QS 2026-ში 257-ე, ყველაზე ცნობილი ინჟინერიით, დედამიწის მეცნიერებებითა და ბუნებრივი საფრთხეების კვლევით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები myUC-ით პირდაპირ აკეთებენ განაცხადს თებერვლის ან ივლისის ნაკადზე.
summary.ar: ثاني أقدم جامعة في نيوزيلندا، في كرايستشيرش وتحتل المرتبة 257 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالهندسة وعلوم الأرض وأبحاث المخاطر الطبيعية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون مباشرة عبر myUC للالتحاق في فبراير أو يوليو.

about.en:
Founded in 1873, the University of Canterbury has a large, leafy campus in Christchurch. It is especially strong in engineering (civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical and natural resources), geology and natural hazards, forestry, Antarctic studies, computer science and education, and is known for a lively student culture.

International students apply through myUC with their school results and English evidence, starting in February or July. Merit scholarships for international first-year students are available, and Christchurch offers a lower cost of living than Auckland.

label.en: English test (programme level; IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 is typical)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

gpa_note.en: Entry equivalent to NZ University Entrance; engineering requires strong maths and physics.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.

summary.en: A major comprehensive university in Guangzhou, ranked 258th by QS 2026, with leading medicine and business in the Greater Bay Area. International undergraduates need a CSCA report and HSK or English scores depending on the programme.
summary.ka: დიდი მრავალპროფილიანი უნივერსიტეტი გუანჯოუში, QS 2026-ში 258-ე, წამყვანი მედიცინითა და ბიზნესით დიდი ყურის რეგიონში. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს სჭირდებათ CSCA-ის ანგარიში და HSK ან ინგლისურის ქულები, პროგრამის მიხედვით.
summary.ar: جامعة شاملة كبرى في قوانغتشو، تحتل المرتبة 258 في QS 2026، وتتصدر في الطب والأعمال في منطقة الخليج الكبرى. يحتاج طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليون إلى تقرير CSCA مع HSK أو درجات الإنجليزية حسب البرنامج.

about.en:
Founded by Dr Sun Yat-sen in 1924, SYSU is one of southern China's leading universities, with campuses in Guangzhou, Zhuhai and Shenzhen. It is particularly strong in medicine (with several affiliated hospitals), business, marine sciences, chemistry, and the social sciences.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, a CSCA report and HSK for Chinese-taught programmes (or English scores for English-taught ones such as clinical medicine). CSC, Guangdong and university scholarships are offered.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: Common App
deadline_note: First-year deadlines: Early Action 5 Nov 2026; Regular Decision 15 Jan 2027 (Common App opens 1 Aug).

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded.

tests.en: Holistic review; English proficiency test requirements apply to international applicants (see UMass's English Proficiency Test Requirements page). SAT/ACT policy and minimum English scores could not be verified automatically.

summary.en: The flagship of the UMass system in western Massachusetts, ranked 260th by QS 2026, known for computer science, engineering and sport management. Early Action closes 5 November 2026 and Regular Decision 15 January 2027.
summary.ka: UMass-ის სისტემის წამყვანი უნივერსიტეტი დასავლეთ მასაჩუსეტსში, QS 2026-ში 260-ე, ცნობილი კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებით, ინჟინერიითა და სპორტის მენეჯმენტით. Early Action 2026 წლის 5 ნოემბერს იხურება, Regular Decision კი 2027 წლის 15 იანვარს.
summary.ar: الجامعة الرئيسية في منظومة UMass غرب ماساتشوستس، تحتل المرتبة 260 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بعلوم الحاسوب والهندسة وإدارة الرياضة. يُغلق القبول المبكر في 5 نوفمبر 2026 والقرار العادي في 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
UMass Amherst, founded in 1863, is a large public research university in the Pioneer Valley and part of the Five College Consortium with Amherst, Smith, Mount Holyoke and Hampshire. It is known for its Manning College of Information and Computer Sciences, engineering, the Isenberg School of Management (including sport management), nursing, and polymer science.

International first-years apply via the Common App by 5 November (Early Action) or 15 January (Regular Decision), with holistic review of academics, essays and English proficiency.

Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa

platform: Direct online application and/or uni-assist (for international qualifications)
deadline_note: Winter-semester (October) applications for bachelor's programmes at German universities usually close on 15 July (some restricted programmes earlier); a few programmes also admit for the summer semester with a 15 January deadline. Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: No tuition fees; students pay only the semester contribution (covering administration, student services and usually a public-transport ticket).

aid_intl.en: No tuition fees at most public German universities; DAAD scholarships and the Deutschlandstipendium (merit, partial) are open to international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Bachelor's programmes are taught mostly in German and require proof of German at C1 level (e.g. DSH-2, TestDaF 4x4, Goethe C2/telc C1 Hochschule). Applicants whose school certificate does not give direct university access in Germany must attend a Studienkolleg and pass the Feststellungsprüfung. Restricted programmes (e.g. medicine) select by grade and tests.

summary.en: A historic research university in central Germany founded in 1737, ranked 261st by QS 2026 and associated with more than 40 Nobel laureates. Bachelor's study is mostly in German and tuition-free.
summary.ka: ისტორიული კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ცენტრალურ გერმანიაში, დაარსებული 1737 წელს, QS 2026-ში 261-ე, რომელიც 40-ზე მეტ ნობელიანტთანაა დაკავშირებული. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية تاريخية في وسط ألمانيا تأسست عام 1737، تحتل المرتبة 261 في QS 2026، ويرتبط بها أكثر من 40 من حائزي نوبل. الدراسة بالألمانية غالباً ومجانية.

about.en:
The University of Göttingen (Georg-August-Universität) is a classic German university town institution with a long tradition in mathematics (Gauss, Hilbert) and the natural sciences, plus strong agricultural and forest sciences, law, theology and humanities, alongside several Max Planck institutes.

International applicants apply online (some via uni-assist), need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes, and pay only a semester contribution.

summary.en: Founded by Thomas Jefferson in 1819, UVA in Charlottesville is a leading 'Public Ivy', ranked 268th by QS 2026, with elite business, humanities and politics programmes. Admission for international students is highly selective.
summary.ka: თომას ჯეფერსონის მიერ 1819 წელს დაარსებული UVA შარლოტსვილში წამყვანი „საჯარო აივია“, QS 2026-ში 268-ე, ელიტური ბიზნესის, ჰუმანიტარული და პოლიტიკის პროგრამებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტების მიღება ძალიან შერჩევითია.
summary.ar: أسسها توماس جيفرسون عام 1819، وجامعة فيرجينيا في شارلوتسفيل من أبرز «جامعات آيفي الحكومية»، وتحتل المرتبة 268 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج نخبوية في الأعمال والإنسانيات والسياسة. القبول للطلاب الدوليين انتقائي جداً.

about.en:
The University of Virginia is a flagship public university whose Academical Village is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It is known for the McIntire School of Commerce, the Frank Batten School of Leadership and Public Policy, history, English and politics, engineering, nursing and medicine, and a strong student self-governance tradition.

International students apply through the Common App with essays, recommendations and English proficiency evidence; admission is very competitive and need-based aid is limited for non-US citizens.

summary.ka: გერმანიის ერთ-ერთი უდიდესი უნივერსიტეტი კელნში, QS 2026-ში 269-ე, ძლიერი ეკონომიკაში, ბიზნესში, სამართალსა და მედიცინაში. ბაკალავრიატი ძირითადად გერმანულადაა და უფასოა.
summary.ar: إحدى أكبر الجامعات الألمانية، في كولونيا، تحتل المرتبة 269 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الاقتصاد والأعمال والقانون والطب. الدراسة بالألمانية غالباً ومجانية.

about.en:
The University of Cologne was founded in 1388, re-established in 1919, and today enrols around 45,000 students. It is known for its Faculty of Management, Economics and Social Sciences, law, medicine and ageing research (CECAD), and holds Excellence University status.

International applicants apply online or via uni-assist, need German C1 for most bachelor's programmes, and pay only a semester contribution including a regional transport ticket.

platform: Direct (Charles University online application, per faculty)
deadline_note: No rolling admissions: most programmes open in late January/early February, and bachelor's/master's deadlines are 28 February or 31 March depending on the programme (some faculties to June/July). Each of the 17 faculties sets its own procedure.

tuition_intl.note: Programmes taught in Czech are tuition-free for all nationalities; programmes in English (or other foreign languages) cost from €40 up to €30,620 a year depending on the programme.

aid_intl.en: Czech-taught study is free; limited faculty scholarships and Czech government scholarships for some countries.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Most programmes use faculty entrance exams (some online), and foreign secondary diplomas need recognition (nostrification). English-taught programmes require proof of English; Czech-taught programmes require Czech. Medicine has its own entrance tests.

summary.en: Central Europe's oldest university, founded in Prague in 1348 and ranked 273rd by QS 2026. Study in Czech is free for everyone, while English-taught programmes charge fees, and most applications close on 28 February or 31 March 2027.
summary.ka: ცენტრალური ევროპის უძველესი უნივერსიტეტი, დაარსებული პრაღაში 1348 წელს, QS 2026-ში 273-ე. ჩეხურ ენაზე სწავლა ყველასთვის უფასოა, ინგლისურენოვანი პროგრამები კი ფასიანია; განაცხადების უმეტესობა 2027 წლის 28 თებერვალს ან 31 მარტს იხურება.
summary.ar: أقدم جامعة في وسط أوروبا، تأسست في براغ عام 1348 وتحتل المرتبة 273 في QS 2026. الدراسة بالتشيكية مجانية للجميع، بينما البرامج بالإنجليزية برسوم، ويُغلق معظم التقديم في 28 فبراير أو 31 مارس 2027.

about.en:
Charles University is the Czech Republic's largest and most prestigious university, with 17 faculties across Prague and in Hradec Králové and Plzeň. It is strong in medicine (five medical faculties), natural sciences, mathematics and physics, law, social sciences and the humanities.

International students choose between tuition-free Czech-language study and fee-paying English-taught programmes (notably general medicine, dentistry and selected social-science and humanities bachelor's). Applications go to individual faculties, typically by the end of February or March, with entrance exams and diploma recognition.

label.en: Proof of funds for the Czech long-term visa

gpa_note.en: Admission mainly through faculty entrance exam results; some programmes also weigh school grades.

platform: Direct (UAntwerp admission application via Mobility Online)
deadline_note: Admission applications for 2027-28 open 4 Nov 2026. Objective 1: upload all electronic documents by 28 Feb 2027 (recommended, especially for visa applicants); final deadline 31 May 2027, also the deadline for sending legalised documents.

tuition_intl.note: Flemish tuition; non-EEA students pay a higher rate set by UAntwerp.

aid_intl.en: Limited; UAntwerp scholarships mainly target master's students from developing countries.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Most bachelor's programmes are taught in Dutch (B2 Dutch needed); the Bachelor of Social-Economic Sciences is taught in English and requires proof of English. Medicine and dentistry require the Flemish entrance exam.

summary.en: A young, research-driven university in the port city of Antwerp, ranked 277th by QS 2026. Most bachelor's are taught in Dutch, with an English-taught Social-Economic Sciences bachelor; 2027-28 documents should be uploaded by 28 February 2027.
summary.ka: ახალგაზრდა, კვლევაზე ორიენტირებული უნივერსიტეტი საპორტო ქალაქ ანტვერპენში, QS 2026-ში 277-ე. ბაკალავრიატის უმეტესობა ნიდერლანდურადაა, ინგლისურად კი ისწავლება სოციალურ-ეკონომიკური მეცნიერებები; 2027-28 წლის დოკუმენტები 2027 წლის 28 თებერვლამდე უნდა აიტვირთოს.
summary.ar: جامعة حديثة ذات توجه بحثي في مدينة أنتويرب الساحلية، تحتل المرتبة 277 في QS 2026. تُدرَّس معظم برامج البكالوريوس بالهولندية، مع بكالوريوس العلوم الاجتماعية والاقتصادية بالإنجليزية؛ ويجب رفع وثائق 2027-28 بحلول 28 فبراير 2027.

about.en:
The University of Antwerp was formed in 2003 from three Antwerp institutions and has campuses in the city centre and the south of Antwerp. It is known for business and economics, pharmaceutical and biomedical sciences, medicine, law, applied engineering and port/logistics research, and is closely linked to the Antwerp Management School.

Almost all bachelor's programmes are Dutch-taught; the main English-taught option is Social-Economic Sciences. International applicants apply online from 4 November, uploading documents by 28 February (final deadline 31 May), and medicine requires the Flemish entrance exam.

label.en: Secondary school diploma (legalised/certified copy to the registrar)
Dutch B2 for Dutch-taught programmes; English proficiency for English-taught programmes
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa
