deadline_note: Pitt uses rolling admission for first-year applicants with priority dates for scholarships and some programmes; international dates are listed on admissions.pitt.edu (not verified automatically).

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Need-based federal aid is not available to international students; limited merit scholarships may be awarded.

tests.en: Pitt is test optional for most programmes (some guaranteed-admission programmes may differ). International applicants must show English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS/Duolingo). Minimum scores could not be verified automatically.

summary.en: A major public research university in Pittsburgh, ranked 279th by QS 2026, renowned for health sciences, philosophy and its medical centre. It admits first-years on a rolling basis.
summary.ka: დიდი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი პიტსბურგში, QS 2026-ში 279-ე, ცნობილი ჯანდაცვის მეცნიერებებით, ფილოსოფიითა და სამედიცინო ცენტრით. პირველკურსელებს უწყვეტად იღებს.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حكومية كبرى في بيتسبرغ، تحتل المرتبة 279 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالعلوم الصحية والفلسفة ومركزها الطبي. تقبل طلاب السنة الأولى بنظام القبول المتجدد.

about.en:
Founded in 1787, the University of Pittsburgh is a state-related research university in the Oakland neighbourhood, next to Carnegie Mellon and the UPMC medical centre. It is known for medicine, nursing, pharmacy, health sciences, philosophy and history of science, and engineering.

First-year applicants are reviewed on a rolling basis, with guaranteed-admission pathways into some professional programmes. International applicants need English proficiency evidence and should apply early for merit scholarship consideration.

label.en: Common App essay and any supplements
Certification of finances for the I-20/F-1 visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Studielink plus Radboud application portal
deadline_note: Numerus fixus bachelor's: 15 Jan 2027 for all students. Other bachelor's: 1 Apr 2027 for non-EU/EEA students; EU/EEA 1 May (with housing lottery) or 1 July.

tuition_intl.note: Non-EU/EEA students pay the institutional fee (varies by programme).

aid_intl.en: Radboud Scholarship Programme and Holland Scholarship (partial), mainly for non-EEA students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. English (bachelor's): IELTS Academic 6.0 with all sub-scores 6.0 (IELTS Online not accepted; One Skill Retake accepted); TOEFL iBT 80 with all sub-scores 20 (or 4.5 on the new scale; Home Edition not accepted); Cambridge C1 Advanced 169.

summary.en: A campus university in Nijmegen, the Netherlands' oldest city, ranked 283rd by QS 2026 and well known for psychology, neuroscience, medicine and AI. English-taught bachelor's require IELTS 6.0 (all bands 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 80.
summary.ka: კამპუსური უნივერსიტეტი ნაიმეხენში, ნიდერლანდების უძველეს ქალაქში, QS 2026-ში 283-ე, ცნობილი ფსიქოლოგიით, ნეირომეცნიერებით, მედიცინითა და ხელოვნური ინტელექტით. ინგლისურენოვან ბაკალავრიატს სჭირდება IELTS 6.0 (ყველა კომპონენტი 6.0) ან TOEFL iBT 80.
summary.ar: جامعة ذات حرم في نايميخن، أقدم مدن هولندا، تحتل المرتبة 283 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بعلم النفس وعلوم الأعصاب والطب والذكاء الاصطناعي. تتطلب برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية IELTS 6.0 (6.0 لكل مهارة) أو TOEFL iBT 80.

about.en:
Radboud University, founded in 1923, has a green campus in Nijmegen alongside the Radboud university medical center and the Donders Institute for brain research. It offers bachelor's programmes in psychology, artificial intelligence, communication science, international business, economics, law, philosophy, theology, sciences and arts, a growing number in English.

International students apply through Studielink; numerus fixus programmes close on 15 January and other programmes on 1 April for non-EU/EEA students. English requirements are firm (IELTS 6.0 with every band 6.0, or TOEFL 80 with every section 20).

label.en: Secondary school diploma comparable to Dutch VWO
English test (IELTS 6.0, all sub-scores 6.0 / TOEFL iBT 80, all 20 / Cambridge C1 169)
Studielink registration; selection for numerus fixus programmes
Proof of funds for the residence permit

gpa_note.en: Diploma comparable to Dutch VWO with subject requirements; numerus fixus programmes rank applicants.

platform: Direct (Waikato online application)
deadline_note: Rolling admission for international undergraduates; apply well before the A Semester (late February/March 2027) to allow for the visa.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see Fees and costs.

aid_intl.en: International merit scholarships (e.g. Vice-Chancellor's International Excellence Scholarship) offering partial tuition.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general; entry by secondary qualification. English proficiency evidence required for non-native speakers (IELTS/TOEFL or equivalent at the programme's level).

summary.en: A university in Hamilton, New Zealand, ranked 293rd by QS 2026, known for its triple-accredited management school, computing and environmental sciences. International students can start in February/March or July.
summary.ka: უნივერსიტეტი ჰამილტონში (ახალი ზელანდია), QS 2026-ში 293-ე, ცნობილი სამმაგად აკრედიტებული მენეჯმენტის სკოლით, კომპიუტინგითა და გარემოს მეცნიერებებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტებს შეუძლიათ სწავლის დაწყება თებერვალ-მარტში ან ივლისში.
summary.ar: جامعة في هاميلتون بنيوزيلندا تحتل المرتبة 293 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بكلية الإدارة الحاصلة على اعتماد ثلاثي وبالحوسبة والعلوم البيئية. يمكن للطلاب الدوليين البدء في فبراير/مارس أو يوليو.

about.en:
The University of Waikato, founded in 1964, has its main campus in Hamilton and another in Tauranga, plus a joint institute in Hangzhou, China. It is known for computer science (including cybersecurity and the WEKA machine-learning tools), its triple-accredited Waikato Management School, environmental and marine sciences, education and Māori studies.

International students apply directly online with their school results and English evidence, and are considered for international excellence scholarships. Intakes are in February/March and July.

label.en: English test (programme level; IELTS 6.0 with no band below 5.5 is typical)
Proof of funds for the New Zealand student visa

gpa_note.en: Entry equivalent to NZ University Entrance.

platform: Direct (VUB online application)
deadline_note: Applications for 2027-28 open 15 Nov 2026. For 2026-27, non-EEA citizens (incl. UK) needing a visa had to apply before 1 April; expect a similar deadline (around 31 March 2027).

tuition_intl.note: Non-EEA example (2026-27): Bachelor in Social Sciences €2,200 fixed + €52 per credit = €5,320 for 60 credits; non-EEA students meeting certain residence conditions pay the EEA rate.

aid_intl.en: Limited bachelor's-level scholarships for international students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. You need a secondary diploma that gives university access in your home country (plus any entrance exam certificate required there). Dutch-taught programmes require Dutch at B2 (e.g. CNaVT or ITNA); English-taught bachelor's (e.g. Social Sciences, Business and Economics) require English at B2 via an accepted test.

summary.en: A Dutch-language university in Brussels, ranked 295th by QS 2026, offering a handful of English-taught bachelor's alongside its Dutch programmes. Non-EEA fees are moderate (about €5,320 a year for the Social Sciences bachelor).
summary.ka: ნიდერლანდურენოვანი უნივერსიტეტი ბრიუსელში, QS 2026-ში 295-ე, რომელიც ნიდერლანდურ პროგრამებთან ერთად რამდენიმე ინგლისურენოვან ბაკალავრიატს გთავაზობს. ევროკავშირის გარეთ მყოფთათვის საფასური ზომიერია (სოციალურ მეცნიერებებში დაახლოებით €5,320 წელიწადში).
summary.ar: جامعة ناطقة بالهولندية في بروكسل، تحتل المرتبة 295 في QS 2026، وتقدم عدداً من برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية إلى جانب برامجها الهولندية. الرسوم لغير الأوروبيين معتدلة (نحو 5,320 يورو سنوياً لبكالوريوس العلوم الاجتماعية).

about.en:
VUB was founded in 1834 (as part of the Free University of Brussels, splitting into Dutch- and French-language universities in 1969) and has campuses in Etterbeek, Jette (medicine) and Anderlecht. It values free inquiry, and its location in the EU capital supports strong programmes in social and political sciences, business and economics, law, engineering and medicine.

International students apply online from mid-November; non-EEA applicants needing a visa face an early-spring deadline. English-taught bachelor's require B2 English, Dutch-taught ones B2 Dutch, and fees for non-EEA students are a fixed amount plus a per-credit charge.

label.en: Secondary diploma granting university access in your home country (plus entrance exam certificate if required there)
Proof of funds for the Belgian student visa

gpa_note.en: Open admission with a qualifying diploma and language proof.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.

summary.en: A C9 university in the ancient capital Xi'an, ranked 296th by QS 2026, strong in energy, electrical and mechanical engineering. International undergraduates need a CSCA report and HSK, or English scores for English-taught programmes such as MBBS.
summary.ka: C9-ის უნივერსიტეტი ძველ დედაქალაქ სიანში, QS 2026-ში 296-ე, ძლიერი ენერგეტიკულ, ელექტრო და მექანიკურ ინჟინერიაში. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებს სჭირდებათ CSCA-ის ანგარიში და HSK, ან ინგლისურის ქულები ინგლისურენოვან პროგრამებზე (მაგ. MBBS).
summary.ar: جامعة في رابطة C9 بالعاصمة القديمة شيآن، تحتل المرتبة 296 في QS 2026، وتتميز في هندسة الطاقة والكهرباء والميكانيك. يحتاج طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليون إلى تقرير CSCA مع HSK، أو درجات الإنجليزية للبرامج الإنجليزية مثل MBBS.

about.en:
Xi'an Jiaotong University traces its roots to Nanyang Public School founded in Shanghai in 1896 and moved to Xi'an in the 1950s. It is a top engineering university in energy and power, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and materials, with a large medical school and a strong management school.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught MBBS and other programmes) and a CSCA report. CSC and Silk Road scholarships are available.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: Direct (Dalhousie online application)
deadline_note: September 2027: 15 Feb 2027 for Nursing, Health Sciences, Medical Sciences and Social Work, and the recommended date for general entrance-award consideration; 1 Mar 2027 for Environmental Design Studies (Architecture). Other programmes accept applications until classes start if space remains; residence guarantee deadline 15 May.

tuition_intl.note: International tuition varies by programme; use Dalhousie's fee calculator.

aid_intl.en: Entrance scholarships for high-achieving applicants (apply by 15 Feb), plus the McCall MacBain international fellowship and other awards.

tests.en: SAT/ACT not required; admission is based on high-school grades and country-specific requirements. English proficiency required for non-native speakers (IELTS, TOEFL, CAEL, Duolingo or equivalent; minimums are listed on Dalhousie's requirements page).

summary.en: Atlantic Canada's leading research university in Halifax, ranked 298th by QS 2026 and known for ocean sciences, health professions and engineering. Most programmes accept applications on a rolling basis, but 15 February 2027 is the key date for scholarships and health programmes.
summary.ka: ატლანტიკური კანადის წამყვანი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ჰალიფაქსში, QS 2026-ში 298-ე, ცნობილი ოკეანის მეცნიერებებით, ჯანდაცვის პროფესიებითა და ინჟინერიით. პროგრამების უმეტესობა განაცხადებს უწყვეტად იღებს, თუმცა 2027 წლის 15 თებერვალი მთავარი ვადაა სტიპენდიებისა და ჯანდაცვის პროგრამებისთვის.
summary.ar: الجامعة البحثية الرائدة في كندا الأطلسية بمدينة هاليفاكس، تحتل المرتبة 298 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بعلوم المحيطات والمهن الصحية والهندسة. تقبل معظم البرامج الطلبات بشكل متواصل، لكن 15 فبراير 2027 هو الموعد الأهم للمنح وبرامج الصحة.

about.en:
Founded in 1818, Dalhousie is a U15 research university with campuses in Halifax and an agricultural campus in Truro. It is particularly strong in ocean and marine sciences, medicine, dentistry, nursing and health professions, engineering, law (Schulich School of Law), management and architecture.

International students apply directly online; high-school grades and country-specific requirements drive admission, and SAT/ACT are not required. Applying by 15 February secures consideration for entrance awards, while health programmes and architecture have fixed deadlines.

label.en: Supplemental requirements for some programmes (e.g. nursing, architecture, music)
Proof of funds for the Canadian study permit

gpa_note.en: Minimum grade averages by programme (typically 70%+; higher for health and engineering).

name.ka: ულსანის მეცნიერებისა და ტექნოლოგიის ეროვნული ინსტიტუტი (UNIST)

platform: Direct (UNIST international undergraduate admission)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Scholarships for many international undergraduates (UNIST and GKS), often covering tuition.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement stated; selection by document review and interview, with strong maths and science expected. Courses are taught in English, so English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent) is required; minimums are set in UNIST's admission guideline.

summary.en: A young science and technology institute in Ulsan, Korea's industrial capital, ranked 299th by QS 2026, teaching entirely in English with strengths in energy, batteries and materials.
summary.ka: ახალგაზრდა მეცნიერებისა და ტექნოლოგიის ინსტიტუტი ულსანში, კორეის სამრეწველო დედაქალაქში, QS 2026-ში 299-ე, სწავლება მთლიანად ინგლისურადაა, ძლიერი ენერგეტიკაში, ბატარეებსა და მასალებში.
summary.ar: معهد حديث للعلوم والتكنولوجيا في أولسان، العاصمة الصناعية لكوريا، يحتل المرتبة 299 في QS 2026، ويدرّس بالكامل بالإنجليزية ويتميز في الطاقة والبطاريات والمواد.

about.en:
UNIST opened in 2009 as a national research university in Ulsan, home to Hyundai and major petrochemical and shipbuilding industries. It teaches all courses in English and is known for energy and battery research, materials science, biomedical engineering, AI and mechanical engineering.

International undergraduates apply online with transcripts, essays and recommendations, followed by interviews; scholarships are widely available.

about.en:
Sichuan University, with roots in 1896, is one of western China's largest research universities, with campuses in Chengdu. Its West China School of Stomatology and West China Hospital are among the best in China, and it is also strong in polymer materials, mathematics, Chinese literature and history.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, a CSCA report and HSK for Chinese-taught degrees (or English scores where English-taught options exist). CSC and Sichuan provincial scholarships are available.

summary.en: A coastal university in Xiamen, often called China's most beautiful campus, ranked 303rd by QS 2026 and strong in economics, accounting, chemistry and marine science. It also runs a campus in Malaysia; China-campus applicants need a CSCA report.
summary.ka: სანაპირო უნივერსიტეტი სიამენში, ხშირად ჩინეთის ყველაზე ლამაზ კამპუსად წოდებული, QS 2026-ში 303-ე, ძლიერი ეკონომიკაში, ბუღალტერიაში, ქიმიასა და საზღვაო მეცნიერებაში. მას კამპუსი მალაიზიაშიც აქვს; ჩინეთის კამპუსზე აპლიკანტებს CSCA-ის ანგარიში სჭირდებათ.
summary.ar: جامعة ساحلية في شيامن، يُطلق عليها غالباً أجمل حرم في الصين، تحتل المرتبة 303 في QS 2026 وتتميز في الاقتصاد والمحاسبة والكيمياء وعلوم البحار. لديها أيضاً فرع في ماليزيا، ويحتاج المتقدمون لحرم الصين إلى تقرير CSCA.

about.en:
Xiamen University was founded in 1921 by overseas Chinese philanthropist Tan Kah Kee and sits on the sea in Xiamen, Fujian. It is especially strong in economics, finance and accounting, chemistry, marine and oceanographic science, and Chinese language teaching, and operates Xiamen University Malaysia near Kuala Lumpur.

International undergraduates on the China campus apply with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught options) and a CSCA report. CSC and Fujian scholarships are available.

summary.ar: جامعة رائدة في العلوم والهندسة في ووهان، تحتل المرتبة 307 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالإلكترونيات البصرية والهندسة الميكانيكية وكلية تونغجي الطبية. يحتاج طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليون إلى تقرير CSCA مع HSK أو درجات الإنجليزية.

about.en:
HUST was formed in 1952 and merged with Tongji Medical University in 2000, creating one of China's largest research universities on a green campus in eastern Wuhan. It is renowned for the Wuhan National Laboratory for Optoelectronics, mechanical and electrical engineering, computing, and medicine.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, a CSCA report and HSK (or English scores for English-taught MBBS and engineering options). CSC and university scholarships are offered.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: University Admissions in Sweden (universityadmissions.se)
deadline_note: Autumn 2027 first admissions round (for international students) via University Admissions in Sweden: opens 16 Oct 2026, apply and rank programmes by 15 Jan 2027; application fee, fee-exemption proof and supporting documents due 1 Feb 2027; bachelor's results 8 Apr 2027.

tuition_intl.note: Citizens of non-EU/EEA countries and Switzerland pay tuition (set per programme) plus a SEK 900 application fee; EU/EEA students study free.

aid_intl.en: Few or no bachelor's-level scholarships; Swedish Institute scholarships are for master's students. Some universities offer partial tuition waivers to fee-paying students.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT. Swedish-taught programmes require Swedish 3; English-taught programmes require English 6 (typically IELTS Academic 6.5 with no section below 5.5, or TOEFL iBT 90 with writing 20). Programme-specific maths/science prerequisites apply.

summary.en: An innovative Swedish university in Linköping and Norrköping, ranked 308th by QS 2026, known for engineering, computer science and problem-based medical education. A few bachelor's programmes are taught in English, with applications due 15 January 2027.
summary.ka: ინოვაციური შვედური უნივერსიტეტი ლინჩეპინგსა და ნორჩეპინგში, QS 2026-ში 308-ე, ცნობილი ინჟინერიით, კომპიუტერული მეცნიერებითა და პრობლემაზე დაფუძნებული სამედიცინო განათლებით. რამდენიმე ბაკალავრიატი ინგლისურადაა; განაცხადის ვადაა 2027 წლის 15 იანვარი.
summary.ar: جامعة سويدية مبتكرة في لينشوبينغ ونورشوبينغ، تحتل المرتبة 308 في QS 2026 وتشتهر بالهندسة وعلوم الحاسوب والتعليم الطبي القائم على حل المشكلات. يُدرَّس عدد قليل من برامج البكالوريوس بالإنجليزية، والموعد النهائي للتقديم 15 يناير 2027.

about.en:
Linköping University (LiU) was founded in 1975 and has campuses in Linköping, Norrköping and Stockholm (Solna). It pioneered interdisciplinary research themes and problem-based learning in medicine, and is strong in engineering, computer science, visualisation, materials and teacher education.

Most bachelor's programmes are taught in Swedish; international students without Swedish typically choose one of the English-taught bachelor's options or come for a master's. Applications are made through universityadmissions.se, with the first round closing on 15 January.

label.en: English 6 (e.g. IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 90) or Swedish 3, depending on the programme
Proof of funds for the Swedish residence permit

gpa_note.en: Selection mainly by upper-secondary grades (merit rating) when programmes are oversubscribed.

platform: Direct (Kyung Hee international admission)
deadline_note: Exact dates for the next intake could not be verified on the official site at the time of checking; confirm on the university's admissions page.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by programme; see the university's fee schedule.

aid_intl.en: Admission and merit scholarships for international students plus the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS).

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement (international results may support an application). Korean-taught programmes require TOPIK (usually level 3–4+); English-taught tracks require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. Exact minimums are set in each semester's admission guideline.

summary.en: A private Seoul university with a famously grand campus, ranked 309th by QS 2026, known for hospitality and tourism, Korean medicine and international studies. International students apply in spring and fall rounds.
summary.ka: კერძო სეულის უნივერსიტეტი ცნობილი დიდებული კამპუსით, QS 2026-ში 309-ე, ცნობილი სასტუმრო და ტურიზმის მართვით, კორეული მედიცინითა და საერთაშორისო კვლევებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები გაზაფხულისა და შემოდგომის რაუნდებში აკეთებენ განაცხადს.
summary.ar: جامعة خاصة في سيول بحرم مهيب مشهور، تحتل المرتبة 309 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بالضيافة والسياحة والطب الكوري والدراسات الدولية. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون في جولتي الربيع والخريف.

about.en:
Kyung Hee University, founded in 1949, has campuses in Seoul and Global Campus in Yongin. It is known for hospitality and tourism management, traditional Korean medicine, international studies, music and dance, and physics, and it has a strong tradition of peace and global engagement.

International applicants apply for March or September entry with school records, a study plan and TOPIK or English scores. Merit scholarships are available.

label.en: Passport and nationality documents of applicant and parents
Bank statement for the D-2 visa

gpa_note.en: Strong secondary or pre-university results are expected; competitive programmes require top grades.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

tests.en: From the 2026/27 intake every international undergraduate applicant to Chinese universities must submit a CSCA (China Scholastic Competency Assessment) report (national requirement run by the China Scholarship Council; tests held several times a year). Chinese-taught programmes require an HSK certificate (typically HSK 4–5 with 180+ depending on the major); English-taught programmes require TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent. SAT/ACT/IB/A-level results can support an application but are not required. Exact thresholds are set in the university's annual admissions guide.

summary.en: A large comprehensive university in Jinan and Qingdao, ranked 309th by QS 2026, strong in mathematics, chemistry, medicine and Chinese classics. International undergraduates must submit a CSCA report and usually HSK.
summary.ka: დიდი მრავალპროფილიანი უნივერსიტეტი ძინანსა და ცინგდაოში, QS 2026-ში 309-ე, ძლიერი მათემატიკაში, ქიმიაში, მედიცინასა და ჩინურ კლასიკაში. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებმა CSCA-ის ანგარიში და ჩვეულებრივ HSK უნდა წარადგინონ.
summary.ar: جامعة شاملة كبيرة في جينان وتشينغداو، تحتل المرتبة 309 في QS 2026، وتتميز في الرياضيات والكيمياء والطب والكلاسيكيات الصينية. يجب على طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين تقديم تقرير CSCA وعادةً HSK.

about.en:
Shandong University, founded in 1901, is one of China's oldest modern universities, with campuses in Jinan, Qingdao and Weihai in Confucius's home province. It is strong in mathematics, chemistry and crystal materials, medicine, and Chinese literature, history and philosophy.

International undergraduates apply with school records, HSK (or English scores for English-taught options such as MBBS) and a CSCA report. CSC and Shandong provincial scholarships are available.

label.en: High school diploma or expected graduation certificate
Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.

platform: Rutgers application or Common App
deadline_note: Fall 2027 first-year: Early Action 1 Nov 2026 (decision by 31 Jan 2027), Regular Decision 1 Dec 2026 (decision by 28 Feb 2027); apply by 1 Dec to be considered for honors and merit scholarships. Later applications are rolling, space permitting.

tuition_intl.note: Out-of-state/international tuition applies; see Rutgers Costs and Aid.

aid_intl.en: Merit-based scholarships (consideration requires applying by 1 December); no federal need-based aid for international students.

tests.en: SAT/ACT optional for most programmes. English proficiency required if schooling was outside an English-speaking country: TOEFL iBT 79 (tests to 21 Jan 2026) or 4.5 on the new scale; IELTS 6.5 (6.0 for some schools); MET 56; or SAT EBRW 550 / ACT English; Duolingo also accepted. Waivers possible for English-medium schools.

summary.en: New Jersey's flagship public research university, ranked 314th by QS 2026, with large programmes in business, engineering, pharmacy and computer science near New York City. Early Action closes 1 November 2026 and Regular Decision 1 December 2026.
summary.ka: ნიუ-ჯერსის წამყვანი საჯარო კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი, QS 2026-ში 314-ე, დიდი პროგრამებით ბიზნესში, ინჟინერიაში, ფარმაციასა და კომპიუტერულ მეცნიერებაში, ნიუ-იორკთან ახლოს. Early Action 2026 წლის 1 ნოემბერს იხურება, Regular Decision კი 1 დეკემბერს.
summary.ar: الجامعة البحثية الحكومية الرائدة في نيوجيرسي، تحتل المرتبة 314 في QS 2026، ولديها برامج كبيرة في الأعمال والهندسة والصيدلة وعلوم الحاسوب قرب مدينة نيويورك. يُغلق القبول المبكر في 1 نوفمبر 2026 والقرار العادي في 1 ديسمبر 2026.

about.en:
Chartered in 1766, Rutgers is one of the oldest universities in the US and a Big Ten member. The New Brunswick campus is the largest of its three, with schools of arts and sciences, engineering, business, pharmacy, nursing, environmental and biological sciences, and the arts, about an hour from New York City.

International first-years apply online with transcripts (self-reported via STARS) and English proficiency evidence; tests are optional. Applying by 1 December ensures merit-scholarship consideration, though need-based aid is not available to internationals.

label.en: Self-reported academic record (STARS), official transcripts if admitted
English test (TOEFL iBT 79 / IELTS 6.5 / Duolingo / MET 56) unless waived
Portfolio/audition for Mason Gross School of the Arts
Financial documents for the I-20/F-1 visa

gpa_note.en: Holistic academic review; competitive schools (engineering, business, pharmacy) expect strong maths and science grades.

platform: UCAS
deadline_note: UCAS equal-consideration date for 2027 entry: 13 Jan 2027, 18:00 UK time (medicine, dentistry and veterinary courses: 15 Oct 2026, now passed). Later applications are considered only if places remain; final UCAS date 23 Sept 2027.

tuition_intl.note: International fees vary by course (listed on each degree page).

aid_intl.en: International Citizens of Change Scholarships (for 2026 entry: 10 awards of up to £10,000 a year for up to three years; 2027 details to be confirmed) and other merit discounts.

tests.en: No SAT/ACT requirement in general. English: every degree page specifies a minimum IELTS score; other tests and qualifications are accepted at equivalent levels (tests must be under two years old at course start). Medicine requires the UCAT.

summary.en: A research university in the English Midlands, ranked 314th by QS 2026, famous as the birthplace of DNA fingerprinting and for space science. International students apply via UCAS by 13 January 2027 and can compete for Citizens of Change scholarships.
summary.ka: კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი ინგლისის მიდლენდსში, QS 2026-ში 314-ე, ცნობილი როგორც დნმ-ის ანაბეჭდის დაბადების ადგილი და კოსმოსური მეცნიერებით. საერთაშორისო სტუდენტები UCAS-ით 2027 წლის 13 იანვრამდე აკეთებენ განაცხადს და შეუძლიათ Citizens of Change სტიპენდიაზე იასპარეზონ.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية في منطقة ميدلاندز الإنجليزية، تحتل المرتبة 314 في QS 2026، وتشتهر بأنها مهد بصمة الحمض النووي وبعلوم الفضاء. يتقدم الطلاب الدوليون عبر UCAS حتى 13 يناير 2027 ويمكنهم التنافس على منح Citizens of Change.

about.en:
The University of Leicester, chartered in 1957, has a compact campus close to Leicester city centre. It is known for the discovery of genetic fingerprinting by Sir Alec Jeffreys, the identification of Richard III's remains, a strong space research centre, medicine, law, criminology, and museum studies.

International undergraduates apply through UCAS; each degree page lists its IELTS minimum, and medicine needs the UCAT. Leicester offers competitive merit scholarships for international-fee-paying undergraduates.

label.en: English test at the degree's IELTS level (or equivalent)
Proof of funds for the UK Student visa (CAS)

gpa_note.en: Typical offers around AAB–BBB at A-level depending on the course; medicine is higher.

platform: Direct (university online application system for international students)
deadline_note: The 2027 undergraduate admissions guide for international students had not been published or could not be verified; September-entry applications in China usually run from late autumn/winter to spring. A CSCA report is required.

tuition_intl.note: Set per programme in the university's annual admissions guide (Chinese university tuition for internationals is typically in the low tens of thousands of RMB a year).

aid_intl.en: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC) and university/provincial scholarships for international students; English-taught and self-funded programmes may have separate awards.

summary.en: A young, fast-rising research university in Shenzhen founded in 2011, ranked 317th by QS 2026, focused on science and engineering with much English-medium teaching. International undergraduates must submit a CSCA report.
summary.ka: ახალგაზრდა, სწრაფად მზარდი კვლევითი უნივერსიტეტი შენჟენში, დაარსებული 2011 წელს, QS 2026-ში 317-ე, ორიენტირებული მეცნიერებასა და ინჟინერიაზე, ბევრი ინგლისურენოვანი სწავლებით. საერთაშორისო ბაკალავრებმა CSCA-ის ანგარიში უნდა წარადგინონ.
summary.ar: جامعة بحثية حديثة سريعة الصعود في شنتشن تأسست عام 2011، تحتل المرتبة 317 في QS 2026، وتركز على العلوم والهندسة مع تدريس كثير بالإنجليزية. يجب على طلاب البكالوريوس الدوليين تقديم تقرير CSCA.

about.en:
SUSTech is a public research university founded by the Shenzhen government in 2011 to pioneer reform in Chinese higher education. Located in China's tech capital, it focuses on physics, materials, computer science, biomedical engineering, mathematics and earth sciences, with small classes and a high share of English-taught courses.

International undergraduates apply online with school records, English proficiency and a CSCA report; selection may include interviews. Scholarships are available for strong applicants.

Interview or written test if required

gpa_note.en: Selection on senior-high record, language level, CSCA results and (where used) interview or written test.
